sql_infos.sql: SELECT l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.court ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_per_act_pattern, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actyear RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 526.15 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2020.41 AND 2012.81 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind, l.judge, p.name), (l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 910.35 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 317.88 AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 613.93 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT lp.actid FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.peopleid = p.personid)) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 60 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 91 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 21 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 35 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 87 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 13 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_value, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 9) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_act_processing_years FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND (l.casenumber IS NULL OR l.casenumber > '0') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) BETWEEN 0.66 AND 14.15 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, avg_act_processing_years DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 48 ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 0 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT personid) > 3 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 AND MAX(l.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS acts_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 15 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 9 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 679 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.court = l.court ) AND l.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 438.14 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.79 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_linked_acts_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS latest_startdate_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 5 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_jury_members, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 6 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) <= 37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 17 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 224.76 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2005.1 AND 2011.26 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 18.01 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_startdate_by_court DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 4.57 ) ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN 7.49 AND 811.14 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 25.16 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_act FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 401.42 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2.9 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 876.12 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 35.66 ORDER BY people_rank, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag_count, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_by_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_people_per_case_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 227.49 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.61 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_case_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_start_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, MIN(l.motivedate) AS earliest_motive_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 77 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_act_links, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > 2016.46 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS recent_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_court_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN 1994.82 AND 1994.06 AND l.actnumber > 673.38 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 12.37 ORDER BY total_people_linked DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS case_status_avg_people, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS judge_year_max_startdate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.outnumber > '0' OR l.outnumber IS NULL) AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 528686 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 983375 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, l.startdate ASC, l.id ASC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;
SELECT l.id, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 6155 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = 2021 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 900309) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge FROM legalacts l WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE lp.actid = l.id AND p.jury = 0 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.actnumber DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 861.85 AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) > 6.52 ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(personid) >= 70.84 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14.66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 334.35 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.fix_description) AS distinct_fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) + COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_activity_score, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 470.24 AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1.4 ORDER BY court_year_activity_score DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 180.94 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.7 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT lla.actid1 FROM legalact_link lla JOIN legalacts l2 ON lla.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY lla.actid1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) >= 20 ) AND l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear = '2000' ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC LIMIT 967 OFFSET 7452 ) ) AND l.casenumber IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.casenumber FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.court = l.court AND l2.actnumber > '0' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000') ) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AND p.court = l.court GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.87 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 906.39 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 15.95 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS avg_jury_value, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS latest_senddate_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id OR ll2.actid2 = l.id ) AND l.judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) < 10 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_senddate_by_court_year DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_linked_acts_running, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_max_startdate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2020-01-01')) AS subquery_linked_future_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2011-01-01' AND l.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 11 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 6 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.actlink = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, l1.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 11 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.legaldate > l2.legaldate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 71 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) >= 2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_legal_date;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, la.actyear DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19 ORDER BY la.court, people_rank_in_court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 4 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 48 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumbers, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 87 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 76 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.fix_description) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 74 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS p75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 100 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS p75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 718 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 1) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 32 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 845 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = 1889 ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 34 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) AS start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) - la.actyear) <= 10 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 88 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, start_month;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_actnumber_count, AVG(la.casenumber) AS avg_casenumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court, la.actkind), (la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court), (la.actyear), (la.actkind), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 59 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_per_court_casekind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE legaldate < la.legaldate AND court = la.court)) AS linked_prior_acts_count, (SELECT SUM(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS scrapefix_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.outnumber, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 48 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, rolling_30day_people DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_date) FROM (SELECT MAX(sf.actid) AS max_id, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_date FROM legalacts la2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la2.court, la2.actyear) sub) AS max_legaldate_in_court_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 154.78 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2012.47 AND 2020.94 AND (p.court = la.court OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 18.19 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 3125.64 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_higher_court_year, MIN(la.motivedate) AS earliest_motive_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > 12082.41 OR la.outnumber < 16521.54) AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR la.motivedate IS NOT NULL) AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind), (la.court, la.casekind), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 966495.69 AND AVG(la.outnumber) BETWEEN 32031.95 AND 22464.83 ORDER BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_out_numbers FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 OR la.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, distinct_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_since_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS jury_members_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.senddate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_both_dates FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.legaldate IS NULL OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 49 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.actyear DESC;
