SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_case_status, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS earliest_startdate_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND p.jury > 903698 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 917 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 9495 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.resultofappeal) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_result, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 85.75 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 6913.27 AND 694.94 AND (la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' OR la.status = 'Active') AND la.actyear IN (2015.13, 2010.02, 2001.22) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor != 'System') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 31.24 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 93.77 ORDER BY court_year_linked_total DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 749.53 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44.32 ORDER BY total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.yearhighercourt ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.yearhighercourt, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 14 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY la.court, cumulative_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, SUM(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_case_total FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link lp1 ON la.id = lp1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 6) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.hash, la.typeofdocument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 9 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY running_case_total DESC, linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 545;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) + 1 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_scrapefix_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND la.status IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury = 0 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 16 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS total_people_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS row_num_by_year_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 80 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, rank_by_linked_acts;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_actkind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE ( la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND ( la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND actyear = la.actyear - 1 AND actnumber > '1' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 AND court = la.court ) ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 2 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) + COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) + COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distinct_counts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 426.28 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 18.15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 284.53 AND la.outnumber < 25.79 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2008.22 AND 2022.37 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 3.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 5.97 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 730.87 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 4.07 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_active_by_court_kind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_by_court_casekind, CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1996' THEN 'Period_A' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2001' AND '2006' THEN 'Period_B' ELSE 'Other_Period' END AS actyear_period, CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt > '2010' THEN 'High_Year_Court' WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NULL THEN 'No_Higher_Court_Year' ELSE 'Standard_Year_Court' END AS highercourt_year_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21 THEN 'High_People_Involvement' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) = 0 THEN 'No_People_Involved' ELSE 'Moderate_People_Involvement' END AS people_involvement_category FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1995-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '10') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 4 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '50' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear ORDER BY la.casenumber ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 20;

SELECT la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.judge AS judge1, la2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS acts_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS acts_count_year2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actnumber > la2.actnumber THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_number_greater_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year2, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_start_year1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_start_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fixes_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fixes_count_year2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds_year1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds_year2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.judge = la2.judge AND la1.actyear < la2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 816.6 AND la2.actnumber < 670.79 GROUP BY la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court, la1.judge, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 86.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 68.87 AND AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) < AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear DESC, acts_number_greater_count DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS root_act_id, la1.actnumber AS root_act_number, la1.startdate AS root_start_date, la1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 8742.52 AND la2.actyear = 2019.74 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35.67 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, root_start_date;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ra1.id AS act_id1, ra2.id AS act_id2, ra1.court AS court1, ra2.court AS court2, ra1.legaldate AS date1, ra2.legaldate AS date2, ABS(ra1.num_people - ra2.num_people) AS people_diff FROM ranked_acts ra1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON ra1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra2 ON ll.actid2 = ra2.id WHERE ra1.court <> ra2.court AND ra1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(ra.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.num_fixes) AS max_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = '{{p5}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_act_count FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra ON la.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court AND p.jury = 2 WHERE la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7764 AND AVG(ra.num_people) >= 13.75 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) AS cross_court_links, AVG(la.people_diff) AS avg_people_difference, MAX(ra.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 6 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fix_acts FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cm.court = l.court LEFT JOIN ranked_acts ra ON l.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN linked_acts la ON l.id = la.act_id1 WHERE l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND l.outnumber >= '1' GROUP BY cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) > 334 AND AVG(la.people_diff) <= 12.67 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cross_court_links DESC LIMIT 431;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ) AS total_people_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.casenumber ) AS avg_actnumber_per_case FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_per_act_pattern, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actyear RANGE BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 590.93 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2005.13 AND 2017.13 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind, l.judge, p.name), (l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 146.33 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 933.21 AND p.jury > 6.21 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury), (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 41.67 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;
