SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 13 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_actyear) FROM (SELECT la.court, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_actyear FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY la.court) sub WHERE sub.court = l.court) AS max_actyear_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id AND l2.actyear > '1990' LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l2.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid2 = l3.id AND l3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' WHERE l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND l.legaldate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 91 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_legal_acts_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS earliest_startdate_per_highcourt, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS latest_senddate_per_highcourt FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 177.09 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2000.72 AND 2004.69 AND l.outnumber < 50.4 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 18.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.17 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 51 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND s.fix_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(s.actid) >= 43 ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS court_actnumber_running_total FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l.id AND lp.peopleid > 2470) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(sf.fix_description) > 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 3395 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (l.legaldate < '2000-01-01') AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2005') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_outnumber, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS total_acts_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.typeofdocument LIKE '%Decision%' OR l.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND l.status = 'Final' AND l.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE name LIKE '%John%') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, l.outnumber, l.court, l.actyear, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND SUM(l.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 918.71 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2001.48 AND 2006.6 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.64 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) > 41 ) AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 70 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_act_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 288.57 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.53 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 7 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 920804) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.fix_description) AS distinct_fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) + COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_activity_score, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 209.69 AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8.09 ORDER BY court_year_activity_score DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '1990-01-01') AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2.48 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 480.81 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.casenumber > 49.9 ORDER BY l2.casenumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 731.92 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) >= 9.27 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2.32 AND AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear > 2015.16) > 96.83 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.startdate <= l.startdate AND l2.actnumber > '1' ORDER BY l2.startdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 6250 ) AND p.jury > 62 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_rolling, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 578.54 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 9382.97 AND 593.17 AND l.actyear IN (2018.82, 2014.46, 1993.72) AND (l.status = 'Active' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 12.35 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 125.61 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = '' AND jury > 2 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 70236) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.yearhighercourt, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.yearhighercourt) AS highcourt_year_max_outnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lpe ON l.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON ll1.actid2 = lp2.actid1 AND ll2.actid1 = lp2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') OR (l.senddate IS NOT NULL AND l.senddate < '2000-01-01') ) AND ( (l.actnumber > '1' AND l.outnumber < '1') OR (l.yearhighercourt = '2000' AND l.casenumber <> '1') OR (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) ) AND NOT ( l.typeofdocument = 'Decree' OR l.casekind IN ('Civil', 'Civil') OR (l.resultofappeal = 'Upheld' AND l.status = 'Active') ) AND p.jury > 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.yearhighercourt, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, l.casekind, l.highcourt, l.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) >= 48 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber < '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '5' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS recent_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_outnumber_by_judge_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_motivedate_in_court, MIN(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.status) AS earliest_senddate_by_judge_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > '0' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND AVG(l.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 8;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 807.33 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4.27 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 927.57 AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.91 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l1.startdate DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_court_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number2, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date1, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l1.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l2.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear > l2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON (l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2) OR (l1.id = ll.actid2 AND l2.id = ll.actid1) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 694.12 AND l2.actnumber > 230.39 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.actyear, l2.actyear, l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 41.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 23.24 ORDER BY l1.actyear DESC, l2.actyear DESC, unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS descendant_count, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_descendant_date, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_descendant_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 27 ORDER BY descendant_count DESC, root_act_id;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 4459 ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01') AND la.actnumber > 796.78 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.id = ll1.actid2 AND la2.actyear > 2001.12) AND la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 8.42)) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id, la.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 41.15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 5.34 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_actlink_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY num_people DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_actlink_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY num_people DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, AVG(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_fixes_per_act_by_court_year, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 869.04 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2003.87 AND 2000.86 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40.33 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(la.legaldate, la.startdate))) AS avg_processing_days FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear BETWEEN 1 AND 5 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 817 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS yearly_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 352.99 AND p.jury = 0.08 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 6.38 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury = 0 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 153 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1 || '|' || ll.actid2) AS distinct_link_pairs, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '1' ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, distinct_people DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 744 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 1.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_act_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 65 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 414.95 AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 352.55 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) = 10 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 895 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.actid IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 88) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 319 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear < '1990')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 55 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 592 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 80 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '0' OR la.actnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 98 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 2) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 97 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS judge_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 19 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 594 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, court_year_total DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date, MIN(la.legaldate) AS earliest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 929 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 28.4 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, latest_start_date DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id OR ll2.actid1 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear AND court = la.court) ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_start_date DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear = '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND ( la.id IN ( SELECT lal_inner.actid1 FROM legalact_link lal_inner WHERE lal_inner.actid2 IN ( SELECT la_inner.id FROM legalacts la_inner WHERE la_inner.court = la.court AND la_inner.actyear = la.actyear AND la_inner.actnumber > '1' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT lp_inner.actid FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.peopleid IN ( SELECT p_inner.personid FROM people p_inner WHERE p_inner.jury > 7 AND p_inner.court = la.court ) ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 27 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_max_casenumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 451.95 AND la.casenumber < 6491.73 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2004.34 AND 2009.51 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 6.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 88.65 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.actkind) AS max_casenumber_by_year_kind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.actyear IN ('2000', '2000', '2000') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = la.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate < la.startdate ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 17 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(lal.actid2) AS max_linked_actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 928.05 AND la.outnumber < 132.7 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2007.46 AND 2001.8 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 2.38 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 305.12 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_actyear_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 209.07 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2009.8 AND 2001.8 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 14.0 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_actkind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 672.05 AND p.jury > 4.9 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 18.33 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS avg_act_per_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.actyear > '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p1.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 32 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court ORDER BY la3.legaldate) AS avg_act_per_court FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.actyear < '1990' AND la3.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND p2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.legaldate HAVING SUM(sf2.actid) < 271773 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 420 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_members, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM court_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts l ON ca.court = l.court AND ca.actyear = l.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19 ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC LIMIT 181;
