'final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 73 ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT p.court, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_people, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 26 ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT la1.court, la1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_links, AVG(la2.actnumber - la1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.casekind = la2.casekind THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_casekind_links, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.highcourt, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_judges, ca.avg_act_number, ca.final_acts, ca.latest_legal_date, ca.court_rank, NULL::integer AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'court_aggregates' AS source_type FROM court_aggregates ca WHERE ca.court_rank <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT pa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, NULL::smallint AS actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, pa.acts_involved, pa.total_people, pa.avg_act_number_people, pa.latest_send_date, pa.granted_appeals, 'people_aggregates' AS source_type FROM people_aggregates pa UNION ALL SELECT laa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, laa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, laa.total_links AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, laa.avg_act_number_diff AS avg_act_number_people, laa.max_linked_legal_date AS latest_send_date, laa.same_casekind_links AS granted_appeals, 'linked_acts' AS source_type FROM linked_acts_analysis laa WHERE laa.total_links > 5 UNION ALL SELECT sa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, sa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, sa.total_fixes AS acts_involved, sa.unique_contributors AS total_people, sa.avg_fix_length AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'scrapefix_analysis' AS source_type FROM scrapefix_analysis sa WHERE sa.total_fixes >= 8 ORDER BY court, source_type, actyear DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS distinct_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), people_activity AS ( SELECT lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS activity_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_num_participated, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_participation, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_participation FROM legalact_people lp JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court ), act_link_network AS ( SELECT l1.id AS source_act, l2.id AS target_act, l1.court AS source_court, l2.court AS target_court, l1.legaldate AS source_date, l2.legaldate AS target_date, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link ll JOIN legalacts l1 ON ll.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.legaldate, l2.legaldate, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT s.actid, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(s.fix_description) AS fix_count, LENGTH(s.fix_description) AS fix_length, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(s.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid, l.court, l.judge ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_acts, cjs.distinct_years, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.granted_appeals, pa.involved_acts, pa.activity_years, pa.avg_act_num_participated, aln.source_act, aln.target_act, aln.source_court, aln.target_court, aln.act_number_diff, aln.common_people_count, sf.fix_count, sf.fix_length, sf.unique_contributors, sf.avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank, LAG(cjs.total_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.latest_legal_date) AS prev_total_acts, LEAD(pa.involved_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.court ORDER BY pa.last_participation) AS next_involved_acts FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN people_activity pa ON cjs.court = pa.court AND cjs.judge = pa.name LEFT JOIN act_link_network aln ON cjs.court = aln.source_court LEFT JOIN scrapefix_analysis sf ON cjs.court = sf.court AND cjs.judge = sf.judge WHERE cjs.total_acts > 88 AND pa.involved_acts >= 57 ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC, pa.involved_acts DESC, aln.common_people_count DESC LIMIT 309;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.casenumber DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS actkind_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 85 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY ra.num_people DESC, ra.num_related_acts DESC ) AS complexity_rank, LAG(ra.casenumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS prev_case_number, LEAD(ra.startdate) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actkind, ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS next_start_date FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.court_rank <= 82 AND ra.num_people >= 5 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind, COUNT(*) AS high_complexity_acts, SUM(ca.num_people) AS total_people_involved, SUM(ca.num_related_acts) AS total_related_acts, AVG(ca.complexity_rank) AS avg_complexity, MAX(ca.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.num_people) AS median_people FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.complexity_rank <= 303 AND ca.total_acts > 110 GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) >= 26 AND SUM(ca.num_people) > 74 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, high_complexity_acts DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_people_1year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_act_rank <= 69 AND cumulative_people > 879 GROUP BY court, actkind HAVING AVG(people_count) > 41.01 AND COUNT(*) >= 441 ) SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act AS court_avg_people, cs.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked, cs.total_fixes AS court_total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.avg_people_per_act DESC) AS court_importance_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.people_count DESC) AS people_percentile, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.court, ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.legaldate) AS prev_people_count FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actkind = cs.actkind WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 21 AND ra.avg_people_1year > 14.57 ORDER BY court_importance_rank, ra.court_act_rank, ra.people_count DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), fixed_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2018' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'fixed' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, fix_count AS metric_value FROM fixed_acts WHERE fix_count > 1 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS fiscal_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate < '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate), l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 50 ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter, act_count DESC;
SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 9 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_judge_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS max_judge_count FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN (SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear) GROUP BY lp.actid) sub) AS max_people_per_act_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.outnumber > '1') AND l.court IS NOT NULL AND l.actkind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 23 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, court_year_total DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_legal_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2010' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 8))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS yearly_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6652.15 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35.95 ORDER BY l.court, people_rank_in_court;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 691.3 AND l.outnumber < 14.46 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 1.16 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate UNION ALL SELECT sf.actid AS legalact_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, COUNT(*) AS people_count, 0 AS recent_act_flag FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 10730) GROUP BY sf.actid ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.court = l.court ) AND l.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ORDER BY ll.actid2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 92 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 175.57 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 19.97 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 686.99 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1.04 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS avg_jury_score FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') ) AND l.casenumber > 391.46 AND (l.typeofdocument = 'Decision' OR l.casekind = 'Civil') AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1.13 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.id IN ( SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) )) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 8 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 820 ) ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 79.8 AND (l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 4.26 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_kind, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS avg_outnumber_by_highcourt, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.actid = l.id AND lp_sub.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS count_people_in_jury, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 = l.id AND ll_sub.actid2 IN (SELECT l2.id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear > l.actyear AND l2.court = l.court)) AS count_linked_future_acts_same_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actnumber > 26096.73 AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2093.9 AND 2021.43 AND l.outnumber >= 27693.33 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.outnumber, l.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 430.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 124.62 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 8 ) GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 8 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_actkind_total_links, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_fixes_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2240.09 AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND l.actkind IS NOT NULL AND p.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 37.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 2.2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 905 ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2010' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_linked_acts_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people p_sub WHERE p_sub.court = l.court))) AS total_linked_acts_in_court_network FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 463.93 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 83.4 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 489.77 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 6.21 EXCEPT SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber <= 319.05 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) <= 45.79 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 1.32 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court_judge DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 615.25 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 13.17 EXCEPT SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber <= 676.85 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) <= 5.5 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 13.31 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court_judge DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actkind = l.actkind AND l2.id <> l.id AND l2.startdate < l.startdate ORDER BY l2.startdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 579 ) AND l.outnumber < ( SELECT AVG(l3.outnumber) FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.startdate BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 15 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.actlink = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, l1.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.actnumber || '|' || l1.actyear) AS distinct_act_identifiers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS distinct_people_in_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS distinct_people_in_court2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.fix_description) AS distinct_fix_descriptions, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear > l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_court1_newer, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear < l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_court2_newer FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '1900' AND l2.actyear <= '1900' AND l1.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND l2.startdate <= '1900-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '0' AND l2.actnumber < '0' GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.actnumber || '|' || l1.actyear) > 900804.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) < 328038.47 ORDER BY distinct_act_identifiers DESC, distinct_people_in_court1 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 85 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id AS act_id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l4.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid2 = l4.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.actyear >= '2000' AND l3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p2.jury > 8 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 64 ORDER BY actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 99 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 8 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id AS act_id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l4.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid2 = l4.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.actyear >= '2000' AND l3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p2.jury > 46 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 44 ORDER BY actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_root_legal_date, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_linked_start_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 13 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 1 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 10) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL AND la.senddate < '2000-01-01') AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 34 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) AS send_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_year, MIN(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS min_outnumber_per_judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor = 'admin') AS fix_count_by_contributor, (SELECT STRING_AGG(p.name, ', ') FROM people p INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid WHERE lp.actid = la.id AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY lp.actid) AS people_names_from_court FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber = '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, la.id, la.startdate, la.senddate, la.legaldate, la.actnumber, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 67 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, start_year ASC, send_month ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 28 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 160 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 71 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_actnumber_count, AVG(la.casenumber) AS avg_casenumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court, la.actkind), (la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court), (la.actyear), (la.actkind), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 31 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 6 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 431.64 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, court, actyear;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(sub.people_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub WHERE sub.people_count > 49) ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear AND court = la.court)) AS linked_acts_same_year_court, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 545.49 AND la.outnumber < 844.1 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10.0 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < 2094.92 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE (la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.startdate <= '2000-01-01') AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (la.yearhighercourt = '2000' AND la.outnumber = '1') AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury != 1) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) <= 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_count FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY cumulative_people_count DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, la.resultofappeal, la.status, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS latest_startdate_per_highcourt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.resultofappeal IS NOT NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS non_null_appeals_per_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id OR ll2.actid1 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 698.92 AND (la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.highcourt LIKE '%High%') AND la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%' AND p.name LIKE '%A%' AND (sf.fix_description LIKE '%error%' OR sf.contributor LIKE '%admin%') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, la.resultofappeal, la.status, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 8.56 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 365.04 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_year, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS judge_latest_startdate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.casekind = 'Civil') AND la.legaldate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_after_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id AND la2.actyear >= '2000' LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_acts_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '1900' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_after_year, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_act_number, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.yearhighercourt) AS percentile_75_yearhighercourt, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_90_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 619 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 220 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) < 15 ORDER BY act_id DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), act_link_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1 ), people_contribution AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON lp.actid = sf.actid WHERE p.jury > 6 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = cjs.court AND l3.judge = cjs.judge AND l3.legaldate > cjs.latest_legal_date AND l3.actnumber > '100') AS recent_high_number_cases, (SELECT AVG(sf2.fix_description_length) FROM (SELECT actid, LENGTH(fix_description) AS fix_description_length FROM scrapefix WHERE actid IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = pc.personid) AND LENGTH(fix_description) > 4982) sf2) AS avg_fix_length FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN act_link_analysis ala ON l.id = ala.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people_contribution pc ON lp2.peopleid = pc.personid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 805 AND cjs.unique_people_count >= 33 AND (ala.linked_acts_count IS NULL OR ala.linked_acts_count > 9) GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, pc.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 14 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '500' ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, cjs.unique_people_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS judge_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '51' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.num_people) AS total_people, AVG(ra.num_links) AS avg_links, MAX(ra.running_people_count) AS max_running_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.actnumber) AS median_actnumber FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 30 AND ra.judge_avg_actnumber > 30.71 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 844 AND SUM(ra.num_people) >= 4293 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.total_people DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.total_acts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cs.court, cs.actkind) AS prev_court_acts FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court AND cs.actkind = ra.actkind JOIN legalact_people lp ON ra.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 0 WHERE ra.num_people >= 11 AND ra.num_links > 4 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber ORDER BY activity_rank, cs.court, cs.actkind;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ) AS total_people_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.casenumber ) AS avg_actnumber_per_case FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_links, SUM(ra.has_fix) AS fixed_acts_count, AVG(ra.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_links_per_act, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people_count, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(ra.people_count) DESC ) AS people_rank FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 27 AND ra.total_people_per_court_year > 160 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 30 AND AVG(ra.avg_actnumber_per_case) > 16.0 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.fixed_acts_count, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.max_links_per_act, ca.median_people_count, ca.people_rank, (ca.total_people * 1.0 / ca.total_acts) AS people_per_act_ratio, (ca.fixed_acts_count * 1.0 / ca.total_acts) AS fix_ratio, LAG(ca.total_acts, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actkind ORDER BY ca.actyear ) AS prev_year_acts, LEAD(ca.total_people, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actkind ORDER BY ca.actyear ) AS next_year_people FROM complex_aggregates ca WHERE ca.people_rank <= 10 ORDER BY ca.people_rank, ca.court, ca.actyear DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value, 'people_count' AS metric_type FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 2 UNION ALL SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value, 'link_count' AS metric_type FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count > 4 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.startdate) AS start_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS highcourt_year_avg, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number, MIN(l.actnumber) AS min_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6088.8 AND (l.highcourt IS NOT NULL OR 0.1 = 1) AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) BETWEEN 2008.21 AND 2020.37 GROUP BY CUBE ( l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.startdate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 743.89 AND (SUM(l.actnumber) IS NULL OR SUM(l.actnumber) < 656262.78) ORDER BY act_count DESC, start_year ASC, start_month ASC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate > l.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_legal_after_start, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 7 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 80 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 3 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

avg_actnumber_per_year, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 8 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l1.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 12 AND COUNT(*) > 48 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_in_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN l3.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.judge) AS active_cases_per_judge, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON l3.id = lp3.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid1 = l4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON l4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp4.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l3.outnumber > '1' AND p2.jury > 4 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.judge, l3.legaldate, l3.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) > 27 AND COUNT(*) > 38 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, actyear DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, AVG(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_fixes_per_act_by_court_year, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 36.49 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2021.86 AND 2005.55 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.89 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 14 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 89 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS aggregated_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 904.92 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 463.25 AND 435.01 AND la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 79.54 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19.53 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 857.4 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, earliest_startdate;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS yearly_court_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 4 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_actnumber_positive, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names_agg FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '0' AND (la.outnumber < '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 817 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, start_quarter, legal_month, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;
