SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, (SELECT SUM(sf2.actid) FROM legalact_link lal JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON lal.actid2 = sf2.actid WHERE lal.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_fix_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf_outer ON la.id = sf_outer.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY rolling_30day_people DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_act_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 571.65 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 5.96 AND 66.14 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = 2001.42 GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 939.51 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 46.42 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.outnumber) AS sum_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY SUM(la.outnumber) DESC) AS outnumber_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > 586.37 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1990.38 AND 2011.71 GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 66.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.05 AND SUM(la.outnumber) < 51150.57 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '1') AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_actkind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS max_actnumber_per_court_status, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS earliest_startdate_per_court_actkind FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 984.5 AND la2.actnumber < 1752.51 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 0.24) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47.36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 9.18 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11 ORDER BY la.court, cumulative_people_by_court DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 665.35 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 3903.73 AND 625.14 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32.89 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 16.68 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS recent_acts_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') OR (la.senddate IS NULL AND la.status = 'pending') ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND la.court IN ('Supreme Court', 'Appeals Court', 'District Court') AND (la.casekind = 'civil' OR la.actkind = 'judgment') AND NOT (la.resultofappeal = 'dismissed' AND la.highcourt = 'Federal') AND p.jury > 0 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 47 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, recent_acts_by_court ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 343.62 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2001.3 AND 2001.95 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 42.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 7.59 ORDER BY total_people DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_act_number_by_court, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_year_higher_court, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid1 = la.id) AS link_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) AS linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt < '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 6 ORDER BY link_count DESC, unique_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 679.76 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 51.6 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_status, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_yearhighercourt_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND p.jury > 94 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 41 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_outnumber_by_judge, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS min_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 906.54 AND la.outnumber < 759.72 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2043.4 AND 1960.85 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 26.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 5.61 ORDER BY total_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS total_people_per_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS linked_act_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_la1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS median_actnumber_la2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_year_count, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la1.startdate)) AS p75_startyear_la1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS max_fix_description FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 125.02 AND la2.actnumber > 813.84 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la1.startdate) BETWEEN 2023.95 AND 2012.03 GROUP BY la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) > 52.99 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 298.89 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) > 54.91 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, court1, court2;

SELECT la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS act_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 51 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < '1' INTERSECT SELECT la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) AS act_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, AVG(la3.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(la3.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la4.outnumber > '1' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) > 80 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY court, actyear DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id_1, la2.id AS act_id_2, la1.court AS court_1, la2.court AS court_2, la1.actyear AS actyear_1, la2.actyear AS actyear_2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count_1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count_2, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year_1, SUM(la2.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_outnumber_court_2, MIN(la1.startdate) AS earliest_startdate_1, MAX(la2.senddate) AS latest_senddate_2, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS all_people_names FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.actyear = la2.actyear AND la1.id <> la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON (lp1.peopleid = p.personid OR lp2.peopleid = p.personid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid OR la2.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 AND la2.id = ll.actid2 WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 256.84 AND la2.outnumber < 270.1 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.outnumber, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 41.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 57.4 ORDER BY earliest_startdate_1 DESC, latest_senddate_2 ASC;

WITH aggregated_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ), court_analysis AS ( SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, aa.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS court_total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC) AS people_rank FROM aggregated_acts aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE la.senddate <= '1990-01-01' ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ca.*, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_in_range FROM court_analysis ca LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON ca.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id GROUP BY ca.id, ca.num_people, ca.num_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.recent_acts_count, ca.court, ca.judge, ca.court_total_acts, ca.people_rank ), people_stats AS ( SELECT la.*, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, MAX(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_jury FROM linked_acts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY la.id, la.num_people, la.num_fixes, la.avg_act_number, la.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, la.court_total_acts, la.people_rank, la.num_linked_acts, la.linked_acts_in_range ) SELECT court, judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(num_people) AS total_people_involved, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, MAX(num_linked_acts) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(linked_acts_in_range) AS total_linked_in_range, SUM(recent_acts_count) AS total_recent_acts, AVG(avg_act_number) AS overall_avg_act_number, SUM(has_jury) AS jury_cases_count FROM people_stats WHERE num_fixes > 12 AND linked_acts_in_range >= 23 GROUP BY court, judge HAVING SUM(num_people) > 869 AND COUNT(*) >= 60 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_acts DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 34 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casenumber > '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_case_number_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts la ON cjs.court = la.court AND cjs.judge = la.judge LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt > '2000' GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number ), people_network AS ( SELECT lla.court, lla.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS network_size, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_experience, MAX(lla.avg_linked_act_number) AS max_linked_act_num, SUM(lla.high_case_number_count) AS total_high_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.court != lla.court THEN p.personid END) AS external_court_connections FROM linked_act_analysis lla JOIN legalacts l ON lla.court = l.court AND lla.judge = l.judge JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY lla.court, lla.judge ) SELECT pn.court, pn.judge, pn.network_size, pn.avg_jury_experience, pn.max_linked_act_num, pn.total_high_cases, pn.external_court_connections, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, cjs.granted_appeals, lla.linked_acts_count, lla.avg_linked_act_number, lla.high_case_number_count, lla.unique_contributors, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC) AS network_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pn.court ORDER BY pn.avg_jury_experience DESC) AS court_jury_rank FROM people_network pn JOIN court_judge_stats cjs ON pn.court = cjs.court AND pn.judge = cjs.judge JOIN linked_act_analysis lla ON pn.court = lla.court AND pn.judge = lla.judge WHERE pn.network_size > 473 AND pn.total_high_cases >= 12 ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC LIMIT 79;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2019-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value, 'people_count' AS metric_type FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 3 UNION ALL SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value, 'link_count' AS metric_type FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count >= 0 ORDER BY startdate DESC, metric_value DESC;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 18 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 24796) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY l.actyear;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court AS people_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 283.93 AND l.outnumber < 338.7 GROUP BY CUBE(l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 416.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 52.61 ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.actyear, l.court;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(COALESCE(sq2.avg_people_per_act, 0)) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lp.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 64.97 GROUP BY lp.actid, p.court ) sq2 ON l.id = sq2.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN 2076.26 AND 1958.17 AND l.startdate >= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 354.8 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 3 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 27 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND sf.actid IS NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) < 63 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 88 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND sf.actid IS NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) < 68 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 780 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 91 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actyear AS year, l.court AS court_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court UNION ALL SELECT p.personid AS act_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS year, p.court AS court_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.actid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS active_acts FROM people p LEFT JOIN legalact_people ap ON p.personid = ap.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON ap.actid = sf.actid WHERE p.jury > 3 GROUP BY p.personid, p.court;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 2 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 334;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 6 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 620;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS max_actyear_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 720.28 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2009.81 AND 2015.3 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 17.81 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court DESC, legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE ( l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 8) ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.update) AS latest_update FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_motivedate_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - 2 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ORDER BY ll.actid2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 970 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 41 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 308.54 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25.45 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_links_as_first, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_links_as_second, AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS avg_jury_score, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(l.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS involved_people_names, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) AND (l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 9)) OR l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE legaldate < '2000-01-01'))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 35 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27 ORDER BY l.court, people_rank_in_court, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_jury_members, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND l.actyear IN ('2000', '2000', '2000') AND l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge IS NOT NULL AND p.jury IN (1, 1) AND (l.highcourt = 'Supreme Court' OR l.highcourt IS NULL) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 > 279082 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC LIMIT 5578;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 9 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 48 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_motivedate DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fix_descriptions, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_case, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS avg_casenumber_per_highcourt_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 58.9 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 763.57 AND 1930.98 AND l.actyear >= 2009.87 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4.77 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.07 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 728.42 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_senddate_by_court_judge, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.senddate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_judge, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber < '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 7 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 862.53 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 13.66 UNION ALL SELECT p.personid AS legalact_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, NULL AS legaldate, p.court, NULL AS judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court ORDER BY p.personid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(CAST(p.jury AS DECIMAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM people p LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE p.jury > 4.0 AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court, p.jury, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 10.73 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate NULLS LAST;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.id IN ( SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) )) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 33 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_avg_scrapefix, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS max_actnumber_per_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 182.65 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2020.14 AND 1994.92 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 8.44 ORDER BY rolling_30day_people_count DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, s.fix_description, s.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS max_outnumber_by_highcourt_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = 2009 AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 130 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.yearhighercourt > '0' AND l.casenumber < '1' AND l.outnumber >= '0' AND l.actlink IS NOT NULL AND l.motivelink IS NOT NULL AND l.hash IS NOT NULL AND l.typeofdocument IN ('TypeA', 'TypeA', 'TypeA') AND l.court LIKE 'Court%' AND l.casekind = 'KindA' AND l.resultofappeal <> 'ResultA' AND l.status = 'StatusA' AND l.judge LIKE 'Judge%' AND l.actkind = 'ActKindA' AND l.highcourt LIKE 'HighCourt%' AND p.jury = 1 AND p.court = 'CourtA' AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, s.fix_description, s.contributor, l.court, l.actyear, l.casekind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 60 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS reverse_link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_act_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_actnumber_by_court_status, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.casekind) AS max_legaldate_per_judge_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 750.73 AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt < 2006.53) AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 4.86) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 47.48 OR MAX(l2.actyear) < 2001.41 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) AS max_year_higher_court, MIN(l.casenumber) AS min_case_number, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt < '1990' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '100' AND MAX(l.yearhighercourt) >= '2000' ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND SUM(s.actid) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 6976 ) ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_fix_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_to_date, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS total_acts_per_judge_court, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS max_outnumber_per_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 94 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, l.legaldate, l.casekind, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 16 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, moving_fix_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.yearhighercourt > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_court_cases, MAX(l.actyear) AS max_act_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) > 1.09 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 34.41 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = l.court AND actyear = 2020.47) ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 352.55 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.59 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_act_by_case FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ORDER BY id LIMIT 3029 OFFSET 814 ) ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(personid) > 670 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS active_court_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 906 ) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 25647)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) + 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 4 OR COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND l.actnumber > 894.99 AND (l.casenumber IN (SELECT l2.casenumber FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = 2007.49 AND l2.court = l.court) OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT p2.personid FROM people p2 WHERE p2.jury > 7.97)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45.7 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 259.67 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.actyear = l.actyear AND l3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY l3.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 513 ) AND p.jury > 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Active') AS active_status_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND p2.jury > 1 ) AND l.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 93) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_fixes_per_judge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_actyear) FROM (SELECT la.court, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_actyear FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear > '1900' GROUP BY la.court) sub WHERE sub.court = l.court) AS max_actyear_in_court_filtered FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = l.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 188558 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 481010 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;
