SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_total_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS latest_senddate_in_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 789.02 AND p.jury > 5.1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.actyear, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 16.82 ORDER BY court_judge_total_fixes DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = 2008 AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 93 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_related_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS total_contributors, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS judge_act_recency_rank, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 686.11 AND l.outnumber BETWEEN 235.99 AND 429.68 AND l.yearhighercourt >= 2016.49 AND l.casenumber < 8136.94 AND l.actyear = 2009.64 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 90.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) < 37.29 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 41;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 2 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 10;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.actnumber || '|' || l1.actyear) AS distinct_act_identifiers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS distinct_people_in_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS distinct_people_in_court2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.fix_description) AS distinct_fix_descriptions, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear > l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_court1_newer, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear < l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_court2_newer FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '1900' AND l2.actyear <= '1900' AND l1.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND l2.startdate <= '1900-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '0' AND l2.actnumber < '0' GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.actnumber || '|' || l1.actyear) > 5379.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) < 836495.18 ORDER BY distinct_act_identifiers DESC, distinct_people_in_court1 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, l1.court AS court, l1.actkind AS act_kind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, start_date DESC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 INTERSECT SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l2.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) < 19;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 11 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 47 ORDER BY startdate DESC, actnumber;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_fixes_per_act_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.status, la.resultofappeal, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, SUM(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.status ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_outnumber_by_judge_status, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt, MIN(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS min_casenumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate IS NOT NULL AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.actkind = la.actkind AND la2.yearhighercourt > '1900' ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.status, la.resultofappeal, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC, num_fixes ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear = '1900' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_year_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 477124 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.legaldate ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS latest_startdate_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_after_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap2 WHERE lap2.actid = la.id) >= 22 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 92 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 534;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 39 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 351 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 23 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) = 2 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 176 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) AS send_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_quarter, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_act_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 59.86 AND la.outnumber < 952.48 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2021.89 AND 2022.73 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) = 2006.69 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 64.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 49.73 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 517.05 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_quarter ASC, send_month ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear) AS running_total_court_case, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_volume FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 927 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND MAX(la.legaldate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send_date, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_act_kinds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.resultofappeal, ', ') AS aggregated_appeal_results FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge), (la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind), (la.actyear, la.court), (la.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 552 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 180 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 913 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 13 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < '0' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 IN (SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear)) AS court_year_link_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_act_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY AVG(la.outnumber) DESC) AS global_outnumber_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.yearhighercourt <= '1990' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.actnumber < '1' AND p.jury > 3 GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29 AND AVG(la.outnumber) BETWEEN '0' AND '10' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 37 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 379 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear < '1990')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 42 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 23 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 120.79 AND p.jury = 0.1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 3.48 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_3year_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 609.33 AND p.jury = 0.83 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 0.61 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_3year_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS avg_active_actnumber, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 795.61 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2007.03 AND 2006.42 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 27.79 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 331.83 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, rolling_30day_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lpp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_court_case FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 AND ll.actid2 <> lp.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpp ON la.id = lpp.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 534.07 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 0.66 AND 185.45 AND la.senddate <= '2001-01-01' AND p.jury > 4.15 GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 886.57 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 96.77 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank_in_actkind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 856.41 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 31.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3.15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN la2.actyear ELSE 0 END) AS sum_linked_act_years, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_act_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) AS median_linked_act_year, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) AS percentile_75_linked_act_year, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS total_scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_act_types FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear > '1990' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 93 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 485 AND AVG(la2.actyear) < '1990' AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, sum_linked_act_years DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_linked_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_casekind_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS latest_startdate_per_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind) AS total_acts_per_actkind FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ll.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 290.15 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2017.43 AND 2017.92 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 3.21 ORDER BY court_year_total_linked_people DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = la.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS jury_people_count, (SELECT MAX(sf2.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 777.67 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 597.43 AND 806.38 AND la.actyear = 2019.84 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' AND la.casekind = 'Civil' AND la.status = 'Pending' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 0.74 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 3.32 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year ASC LIMIT 80.9;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 627.08 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 47.06 ORDER BY total_actnumber DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_in_future_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 10 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS casekind_outnumber_avg, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS date_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 831.08 AND la.outnumber < 226.04 AND (la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.highcourt LIKE '%High%') AND (la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%' OR la.resultofappeal LIKE '%Granted%') AND la.status NOT LIKE '%Draft%' AND p.name LIKE '%John%' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 2.09 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > 417.04 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS total_people_per_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Αρείου Πάγου' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.judge AS linked_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS primary_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS primary_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS primary_fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS linked_fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_primary_actnumber, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.resultofappeal = la2.resultofappeal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_result_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 72 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 9 ORDER BY primary_act_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS act_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 56 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < '1' INTERSECT SELECT la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) AS act_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, AVG(la3.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(la3.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la4.outnumber > '1' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) > 72 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY court, actyear DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actkind ORDER BY la1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la1.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS max_outnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 741.21 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 46.8 UNION SELECT la2.id AS act_id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.actkind ORDER BY la2.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la2.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS max_outnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll.actid2 = la3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la2.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND la3.actyear = 2019.77 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 91.36 ORDER BY act_id DESC, startdate;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la1.actnumber) AS median_actnumber1, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber2, AVG(la1.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber1, AVG(la2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber2, MIN(la1.startdate) AS earliest_startdate1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_startdate2, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS scrapefix_count1, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS scrapefix_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals1, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 341.25 AND la2.actnumber < 202.93 AND la1.outnumber >= 97.88 AND la2.outnumber <= 59.77 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 46.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 26.64 AND AVG(la1.outnumber) >= 73.95 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) <= 88.13 ORDER BY unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 ASC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.legaldate, la.actnumber ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(aa.num_people) AS total_people, SUM(aa.num_links) AS total_links, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, AVG(aa.moving_avg_actnumber) AS avg_moving_actnumber, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY aa.num_people) AS median_people_per_act, MAX(aa.num_links) AS max_links_per_act FROM act_aggregates aa WHERE aa.num_people > 34 AND aa.moving_avg_actnumber >= 111.99 GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN lap.actid END) AS granted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number, SUM(ca.total_links) AS total_court_links FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id JOIN court_metrics ca ON p.court = ca.court AND la.actyear = ca.actyear WHERE p.jury = 1 AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act, COUNT(pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.granted_appeals) AS total_granted_appeals, CORR(cm.total_links, pa.total_court_links) AS links_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cm.total_links DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON cm.court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_acts > 4343 AND cm.total_links >= 2480 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act HAVING COUNT(pa.personid) > 56 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 1.83 ORDER BY court_rank, cm.total_acts DESC;

WITH aggregated_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, MAX(la.actnumber) AS max_act_number, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 26 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < '1990' ) SELECT aa.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actkind, aa.num_people, aa.num_related_acts, aa.max_act_number, aa.avg_higher_court_year, aa.num_fixes, p.name AS primary_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) AS total_references, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_related_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM aggregated_acts aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY aa.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actkind, aa.num_people, aa.num_related_acts, aa.max_act_number, aa.avg_higher_court_year, aa.num_fixes, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) > 64 AND MAX(la.outnumber) < '1' ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_related_acts DESC, court_rank LIMIT 1434;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ra1.id AS act_id1, ra2.id AS act_id2, ra1.court AS court1, ra2.court AS court2, ra1.legaldate AS date1, ra2.legaldate AS date2, ABS(ra1.num_people - ra2.num_people) AS people_diff FROM ranked_acts ra1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON ra1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra2 ON ll.actid2 = ra2.id WHERE ra1.court <> ra2.court AND ra1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(ra.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.num_fixes) AS max_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = '{{p5}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_act_count FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra ON la.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court AND p.jury = 2 WHERE la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 6598 AND AVG(ra.num_people) >= 18.51 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) AS cross_court_links, AVG(la.people_diff) AS avg_people_difference, MAX(ra.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 7 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fix_acts FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cm.court = l.court LEFT JOIN ranked_acts ra ON l.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN linked_acts la ON l.id = la.act_id1 WHERE l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND l.outnumber >= '1' GROUP BY cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) > 373 AND AVG(la.people_diff) <= 13.57 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cross_court_links DESC LIMIT 180;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court AS people_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 716.22 AND l.outnumber < 117.96 GROUP BY CUBE(l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 11.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.35 ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.actyear, l.court;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 544.08 AND l.outnumber BETWEEN 29.37 AND 79.22 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate) = 2018.55 GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 94.44 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 21.01 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 89 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 149 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actnumber > '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_actnumber_count, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate, MIN(l.legaldate) AS earliest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS motivated_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court), (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 551804 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 540 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, 0 AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 3 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 50 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_startdate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 72 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 49 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, earliest_startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.contributor IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contributed_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 880.72) OR (l.senddate < '1990-01-01' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court') ) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') AND (l.actyear BETWEEN 2002.12 AND 2016.65) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16.77 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 48 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, AVG(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_scrapefix_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_actkind, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 413.7 AND l.casenumber < 1330.4 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.96 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.update) AS latest_update FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.casenumber > '0' OR l.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fix_descriptions, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_case, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS avg_casenumber_per_highcourt_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 18.56 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 180.88 AND 1374.35 AND l.actyear >= 2000.32 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 17.45 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > 334.17 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.casekind = l.casekind AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > 3102.67 ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 655.91 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 39.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 29.74 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS active_cases_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 646.07 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 49.39 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 1810.67 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.14 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 80 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.yearhighercourt > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_court_cases, MAX(l.actyear) AS max_act_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 16 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) > 3.09 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, court_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_outnumber, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS total_acts_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.typeofdocument LIKE '%Decision%' OR l.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND l.status = 'Final' AND l.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE name LIKE '%John%') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, l.outnumber, l.court, l.actyear, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND SUM(l.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) > 37 ) AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_act_sum_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_act_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE ( l.actnumber > '1' OR l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN ( SELECT p2.personid FROM people p2 WHERE p2.jury > 5 ) ) OR l.id IN ( SELECT sf2.actid FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE LENGTH(sf2.fix_description) > 3322 GROUP BY sf2.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 23 ) ) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '0' ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > 2021.61)) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 378.78 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.15 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 EXCEPT SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2010' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate ORDER BY startdate DESC, id;
