SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.casekind = 'civil' OR l.judge = 'Judge A') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 17 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.casekind = 'civil' OR l.judge = 'Judge A') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 14 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 31178)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 27 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 6 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.id IN ( SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) )) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(sf.actid) AS sum_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND SUM(sf.actid) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actnumber AS actnumber1, l2.actnumber AS actnumber2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_diff FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actnumber > 14677.4 AND l2.actnumber > 21002.76 AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber, l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 74.28 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, avg_actnumber_diff;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge2 FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 27 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge2 FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 16 ORDER BY act_id1, act_id2;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS actyear1, l2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.senddate) AS latest_senddate1, MAX(l2.senddate) AS latest_senddate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS common_people_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 739.82 AND l2.actnumber > 474.54 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 41.92 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 490.45 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < 58.7 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, l1.id, l2.id;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 1 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 3;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 65 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_out_number, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) AS min_year_higher_court, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_scrape_fixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS involved_people_names, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_case_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 946.1 AND la.outnumber < 808.69 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2071.38 AND 1951.74 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) >= 2021.56 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) IN (3.92, 1.72) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12.39 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 3.73 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 387 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 242 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 96 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, la.id ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_3year_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_legalizations, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_out_number, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_send_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 100 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 8 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, avg_act_number ASC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS scrapefix_descriptions, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 7 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 471 ) )) OR (la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) )) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 7 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpe2 ON la2.id = lpe2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lpe2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.typeofdocument LIKE '%Act%' OR la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND la.status NOT LIKE '%Draft%' AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.court LIKE '%Supreme%') AND la.actnumber > 781.11 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 21.86 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > 474.48 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_kind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid1 = la.id AND lal.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND startdate <= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_in_date_range, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_by_court, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id AND la2.actyear = la.actyear WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 20.3 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.16 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 32.76 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actyear, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2015' THEN 'Recent' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2005' AND '2005' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Old' END AS age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actyear, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2015' THEN 'Recent' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2005' AND '2005' THEN 'Medium' ELSE 'Old' END AS age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 814.19 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.05 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_casenumber_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 512.14 AND la.casenumber < 6731.42 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 19.3 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id ) AS num_links, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_scrapefix FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 8898.8 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44.65 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 532.96 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2017.61 AND 1991.06 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 19.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3.91 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_outnumber_by_judge, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS min_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 39.97 AND la.outnumber < 539.15 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2029.74 AND 2003.75 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 67.15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19.71 ORDER BY total_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2015' THEN 'RECENT' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2005' AND '2005' THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'OLD' END AS age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_number_1, la1.actyear AS act_year_1, la1.court AS court_1, la1.judge AS judge_1, la1.startdate AS start_date_1, la2.actnumber AS act_number_2, la2.actyear AS act_year_2, la2.court AS court_2, la2.judge AS judge_2, la2.startdate AS start_date_2, p.name AS person_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_act_number_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.startdate, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 11 UNION SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_number_1, la1.actyear AS act_year_1, la1.court AS court_1, la1.judge AS judge_1, la1.startdate AS start_date_1, la2.actnumber AS act_number_2, la2.actyear AS act_year_2, la2.court AS court_2, la2.judge AS judge_2, la2.startdate AS start_date_2, p.name AS person_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_act_number_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid1 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.startdate, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 46 ORDER BY fix_count DESC, act_year_1 DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ) SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, AVG(avg_processing_years) AS avg_processing_time FROM act_aggregates WHERE num_people > 10 AND num_related_acts >= 5 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(num_fixes) > 0.3 ORDER BY court, actyear DESC;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT la.judge) AS unique_judges, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 96 ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT p.court, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_people, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 38 ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT la1.court, la1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_links, AVG(la2.actnumber - la1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.casekind = la2.casekind THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_casekind_links, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.highcourt, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_judges, ca.avg_act_number, ca.final_acts, ca.latest_legal_date, ca.court_rank, NULL::integer AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'court_aggregates' AS source_type FROM court_aggregates ca WHERE ca.court_rank <= 10 UNION ALL SELECT pa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, NULL::smallint AS actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, pa.acts_involved, pa.total_people, pa.avg_act_number_people, pa.latest_send_date, pa.granted_appeals, 'people_aggregates' AS source_type FROM people_aggregates pa UNION ALL SELECT laa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, laa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, laa.total_links AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, laa.avg_act_number_diff AS avg_act_number_people, laa.max_linked_legal_date AS latest_send_date, laa.same_casekind_links AS granted_appeals, 'linked_acts' AS source_type FROM linked_acts_analysis laa WHERE laa.total_links > 15 UNION ALL SELECT sa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, sa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, sa.total_fixes AS acts_involved, sa.unique_contributors AS total_people, sa.avg_fix_length AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'scrapefix_analysis' AS source_type FROM scrapefix_analysis sa WHERE sa.total_fixes >= 4 ORDER BY court, source_type, actyear DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS distinct_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), people_activity AS ( SELECT lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS activity_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_num_participated, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_participation, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_participation FROM legalact_people lp JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court ), act_link_network AS ( SELECT l1.id AS source_act, l2.id AS target_act, l1.court AS source_court, l2.court AS target_court, l1.legaldate AS source_date, l2.legaldate AS target_date, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link ll JOIN legalacts l1 ON ll.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.legaldate, l2.legaldate, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT s.actid, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(s.fix_description) AS fix_count, LENGTH(s.fix_description) AS fix_length, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(s.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid, l.court, l.judge ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_acts, cjs.distinct_years, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.granted_appeals, pa.involved_acts, pa.activity_years, pa.avg_act_num_participated, aln.source_act, aln.target_act, aln.source_court, aln.target_court, aln.act_number_diff, aln.common_people_count, sf.fix_count, sf.fix_length, sf.unique_contributors, sf.avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank, LAG(cjs.total_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.latest_legal_date) AS prev_total_acts, LEAD(pa.involved_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.court ORDER BY pa.last_participation) AS next_involved_acts FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN people_activity pa ON cjs.court = pa.court AND cjs.judge = pa.name LEFT JOIN act_link_network aln ON cjs.court = aln.source_court LEFT JOIN scrapefix_analysis sf ON cjs.court = sf.court AND cjs.judge = sf.judge WHERE cjs.total_acts > 923 AND pa.involved_acts >= 13 ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC, pa.involved_acts DESC, aln.common_people_count DESC LIMIT 3258;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) as court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge ), court_summary AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(people_count) AS max_people_per_act FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_rank <= 24 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 7 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_people_per_act, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT id FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court = cs.court)) AS fixed_acts_count FROM court_summary cs ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, AVG(s.fix_description_length) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT actid, LENGTH(fix_description) AS fix_description_length FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 7030 ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18 ORDER BY num_people DESC;
