SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 10 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) < 1.06 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS running_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 79879) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 0 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) >= 8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (l.legaldate < '2000-01-01') AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2005') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > 203.17 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 40641.27)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 40.37 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > 964.96 OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 19770.95)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 41.98 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id LIMIT 2 OFFSET 0 ) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 563.95 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2.87 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 864.85 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.14 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 3 ORDER BY people_count ASC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_flag_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.actyear < '1990' AND l.actnumber > '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 3 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 0 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.actkind = l.actkind AND l3.legaldate > l.legaldate ORDER BY l3.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 263 ) AND p.jury > 8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 795.72 AND l.outnumber < 691.01 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1990.82 AND 2011.5 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40.61 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 22.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 24.7 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_avg_actnumber, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS act_link_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 740.43 AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt < 2022.19) AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury = 0.11) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 9.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.65 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 375.69 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2009.16 AND 2017.31 AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 80.53 ORDER BY num_linked_acts DESC, l.startdate ASC LIMIT 612.36;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 10 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actnumber AS linked_act_number, l2.startdate AS linked_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l1.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 2226.46 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 10.25 ORDER BY l1.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, l1.judge AS root_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ') AS linked_courts, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear > l1.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_year_links, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS total_fix_contributors, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l2.actnumber) AS median_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '1900' AND l1.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND l1.court LIKE '%' AND l2.court LIKE '%' AND l1.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 532397 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 687863 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_year ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS root_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_linked_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p1.name, ', ' ORDER BY p1.name) AS root_people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS court_total_linkages FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND (l2.actyear IS NULL OR l2.actyear >= '2000') AND (p1.court IS NULL OR p1.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 4 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY root_people_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 408;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, l2.legaldate AS linked_legaldate FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l2.actnumber, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY l1.legaldate DESC, l2.legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT sf.actid FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IS NOT NULL AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL AND sf.contributor = 'A' ) AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2.15 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT sf.actid FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IS NOT NULL AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL AND sf.contributor = 'A' ) AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 93.23 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.actnumber DESC) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 660.53 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 66.97 AND 58.73 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 2012.34 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casekind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 12.53 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_actkind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.yearhighercourt < '0' AND la.casenumber >= '0' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, la.legaldate, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 364274 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 254899 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < 15724 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, running_actnumber_sum ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL AND la.senddate < '2000-01-01') AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 5) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 19 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS aggregated_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 835.48 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 179.56 AND 199.68 AND la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 4.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 28.61 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 652.39 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, earliest_startdate;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 114 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 35.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000') ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 18 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 969 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 578 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 595 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 54 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_date) FROM (SELECT MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_date FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.legaldate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la2.court, la2.actyear) sub) AS latest_legaldate_in_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 AND la2.actyear >= '2000' AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 15 ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 0) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court) ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 21 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 961 ) )) OR (la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) )) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.casekind) AS max_casenumber_per_year_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 206.91 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 2453.99 AND 5749.87 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 14.05 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_start_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.typeofdocument LIKE '%Act%' OR la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND la.actnumber > 257.98 AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.court LIKE '%Supreme%') AND (sf.fix_description LIKE '%fix%' OR sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4.52 AND AVG(la2.actnumber) > 372.82 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_actkind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 724.64 AND p.jury > 8.72 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 15.58 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_actkind, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.status ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_by_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 640.84 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 7.1 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people_4period, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 319.0 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 11.85 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 190.87 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.21 AND p.court = la.court ) AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 46.83 ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 93.22 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_case, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_per_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 734.73 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 434.92 AND 146.97 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND casekind = la.casekind) AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 2.86 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 0 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 1 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_status, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_yearhighercourt_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND p.jury > 1000 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 41 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, lal.actid2, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.id) AS recency_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON lal.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 261.61 AND (la.typeofdocument LIKE '%Decree%' OR la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND la.status NOT LIKE '%Draft%' AND p.name LIKE '%Smith%' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, lal.actid2, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) >= 24.78 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > 0.99 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la2.actyear >= '2000' AND p1.jury = 45 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 20 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < '1000' INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la4.actyear <= '2000' AND p2.jury = 89 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 5 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) > '1000' ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_act_sum ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, p.name, sf.fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, SUM(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, la1.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank, AVG(la2.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS avg_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 83.51 AND la2.outnumber IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 0.36) GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.outnumber, p.name, p.personid, sf.fix_description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) >= 39.03 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) > 33.93 ORDER BY la1.court, la1.actyear DESC, act_rank;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT la1.id AS root_act_id, la1.actyear AS root_year, la1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MAX(la2.actyear) AS max_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON la1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la2.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actyear, la1.court ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT an.root_court, COUNT(*) AS total_networks, SUM(an.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(an.involved_people_count) AS total_people, AVG(an.avg_linked_act_number) AS court_avg_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY an.max_linked_year) AS court_75p_linked_year FROM act_networks an GROUP BY an.root_court ), people_activity AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed, MIN(la.startdate) AS first_activity_date, MAX(la.legaldate) AS last_activity_date FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid::text = sf.contributor WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.fixes_contributed) AS total_fixes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.acts_participated) AS people_90p_activity FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people_activity pa ON cm.root_court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_linked_acts > 8673 AND cm.court_75p_linked_year >= '2000' GROUP BY cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 15 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) > 27 ORDER BY cm.total_linked_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT lal.actid1, lal.actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.fix_description) AS shared_fixes_count FROM legalact_link lal JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON lal.actid1 = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON lal.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON lal.actid1 = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON lal.actid2 = sf2.actid GROUP BY lal.actid1, lal.actid2 ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.judge) AS unique_judges, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ), people_networks AS ( SELECT p.personid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT an.actid2) AS network_connections, COUNT(DISTINCT la.court) AS courts_worked_in, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actkind) AS act_kinds_handled, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN act_networks an ON la.id = an.actid1 WHERE p.jury > 7 AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 29 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) AS active_network_people, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.network_connections) AS distinct_network_sizes, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.courts_worked_in) AS court_mobility_levels, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.act_kinds_handled) AS expertise_diversity, AVG(pn.involved_acts) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pn.avg_higher_court_year) AS max_avg_higher_court_year FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people p ON cm.court = p.court JOIN people_networks pn ON p.personid = pn.personid WHERE cm.total_acts > 108 AND cm.unique_people >= 475 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) > 2 AND AVG(pn.involved_acts) < 72 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, active_network_people DESC;

WITH court_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber < '50' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.act_count, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_act_number, la.linked_acts_count, la.fixed_acts_count, la.max_act_number, (ca.act_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.unique_people, 0)) AS acts_per_person FROM court_acts ca FULL OUTER JOIN linked_acts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear WHERE (ca.act_count > 724 OR la.linked_acts_count > 457) AND (ca.avg_act_number < '10' OR la.max_act_number > '100') ORDER BY ca.actyear DESC, ca.act_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_year_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.typeofdocument ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.motivedate DESC ) AS doc_type_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_links, SUM(ra.fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(ra.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_links_per_act, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 90 AND ra.doc_type_sequence <= 40 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 23 AND SUM(ra.people_count) > 440 AND AVG(ra.people_count) > 2.87 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.typeofdocument, ca.actkind, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.max_links_per_act, ca.median_people, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM complex_aggregates ca ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC, overall_rank;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value, 'people_count' AS metric_type FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 1 UNION ALL SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value, 'link_count' AS metric_type FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count > 9 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 90670) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS judge_names, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 64 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subsequent_acts_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_popularity_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 15 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal, MAX(la.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 310 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 650 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC LIMIT 9000;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS running_total FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_case, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_per_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 257.06 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 170.84 AND 187.36 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND casekind = la.casekind) AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 8.78 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_year_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid1 = la.id AND actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) AND (la.status = 'active' OR la.casekind = 'civil') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 12 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.senddate) AS last_send_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2010' AND l.outnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.legal_year, SUM(ca.total_acts) AS yearly_acts, SUM(ca.total_people_involved) AS yearly_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.avg_act_number) AS median_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.judge) AS active_judges FROM court_activity ca GROUP BY ca.court, ca.legal_year HAVING SUM(ca.total_acts) > 144 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.legal_year, cs.yearly_acts, cs.yearly_people, cs.median_act_number, cs.active_judges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.legal_year ORDER BY cs.yearly_acts DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year) AS prev_year_acts, (cs.yearly_acts - LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year)) AS yoy_growth FROM court_stats cs WHERE cs.yearly_people >= 433 ORDER BY cs.legal_year DESC, activity_rank ASC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 68 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Active') AS avg_active_act_number, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 7 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '500' UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court ORDER BY l2.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(l2.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l2.status = 'Closed') AS avg_closed_act_number, MAX(s2.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll.actid2 = l3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s2 ON l3.id = s2.actid WHERE l2.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actnumber < '1' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l2.court, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) > 45 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate > l.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_legal_after_start, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 9 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 78 AND SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 40 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > '1') AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.contributor, '; ' ORDER BY sf.contributor) AS contributors FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.actnumber > '0' OR l.outnumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name), (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 33 AND MAX(l.startdate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY total_people DESC, latest_startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS acts_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 97 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 46 AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 19 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.startdate;
