SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 8 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 8;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND la.actnumber > 309.71 AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND NOT (la.status = 'StatusA') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 15.55 AND SUM(la.outnumber) < 77.03 ORDER BY total_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 39 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) > 7.86 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 17.12 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, avg_processing_years DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 56 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 65 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS yearly_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 240.03 AND p.jury = 0.45 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 12.98 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) = 12 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 703 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 70 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court, legal_quarter;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear) AS running_total_court_case, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_volume FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 903 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18 AND MAX(la.legaldate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, ', ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 39.55 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, '; ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 22.92 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) = 3 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 52 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 967 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) AS total_people_linked FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 734 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MIN(sf.fix_description) AS sample_fix, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY rolling_30day_people DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 6 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 74 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 20.96 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_act_number DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', la.legaldate) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_outnumber_per_judge_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND p.jury > 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.legaldate, la.id, la.actnumber, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 27 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_month;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, lp.peopleid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actyear >= '2000') AS avg_actnumber_recent, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), lp.peopleid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 620 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(sub.people_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub WHERE sub.people_count > 29) ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fix_descriptions, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_casekind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_year_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 922.41 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 254.44 AND 1598.48 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 6.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 62.53 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC LIMIT 176.73;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_highcourt_actkind, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 4954.17 AND la.casenumber > 1665.68 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 13.37 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS highcourt_actkind_avg_links, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casenumber) AS max_actnumber_per_case FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON lal.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 772.89 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 11.85 AND 84.03 AND (la.highcourt = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 27.07 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 11.77 ORDER BY linked_people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_case_status, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS earliest_startdate_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND p.jury > 492494 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 948 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 9415 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.resultofappeal) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_result, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 740.82 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 9014.51 AND 8302.01 AND (la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' OR la.status = 'Active') AND la.actyear IN (2001.04, 2003.49, 2013.48) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor != 'System') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 29.47 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 385.71 ORDER BY court_year_linked_total DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_linked_avg FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear > '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 33 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_actnumber_excluding_current, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_year_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON lal2.actid1 = la3.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 159.11 AND la.yearhighercourt < 2001.75 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 33.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 16.28 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_yearhighercourt_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 174.28 AND la.outnumber < 161.23 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 47.64 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 624.05 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id ) SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, la.court, la.actkind FROM act_aggregates aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE aa.num_people > 2 AND aa.num_fixes >= 0 ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_fixes DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id ) SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, la.court, la.actkind FROM act_aggregates aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE aa.num_people > 5 AND aa.num_fixes >= 1 ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_fixes DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) as court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge ), court_summary AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(people_count) AS max_people_per_act FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_rank <= 22 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_people_per_act, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT id FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court = cs.court)) AS fixed_acts_count FROM court_summary cs ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), fixed_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2018' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'fixed' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, fix_count AS metric_value FROM fixed_acts WHERE fix_count > 2 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actnumber <= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 9 UNION ALL SELECT 'linked' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count >= 4 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) AS fixed_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 90 AND SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) < 19 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 773.05 AND p.jury > 5.66 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury), (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 65.19 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate >= (SELECT MIN(legaldate) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_after_min_year_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 176.07 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 94 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(COALESCE(sf_counts.fix_count, 0)) AS avg_fixes_per_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT la.actid1 FROM legalact_link la WHERE la.actid1 > 331188 ) GROUP BY sf.actid ) sf_counts ON l.id = sf_counts.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 62 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 73 ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 45 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 79 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND sf.actid IS NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) < 53 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_act_processing_years FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND (l.casenumber IS NULL OR l.casenumber > '0') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) BETWEEN 5.92 AND 5.84 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, avg_act_processing_years DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS active_cases_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) >= 38 AND (l.motivedate IS NULL OR l.motivedate < l.legaldate - INTERVAL '284 days') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 73 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_scrapefix FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 43 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 = l.id AND ll_sub.actid2 > 817146 ) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE ( l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 8) ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 378.27 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18.84 ORDER BY people_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_scrapefix_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_actnumber_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l2.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid2 = l3.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, p.name, p.court, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_casekind DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id) AS recency_rank_in_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_by_judge_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 917.65 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14.4 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court_year DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 237.65 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2022.28 AND 2008.91 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 9.36 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_startdate_by_court DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 0 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS earliest_startdate_per_casekind FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 450.23 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 4.72 AND 21.48 AND (l.status = 'active' OR l.resultofappeal = 'granted') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 0.6 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS earliest_startdate_per_casekind FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 762.98 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 23.2 AND 99.04 AND (l.status = 'active' OR l.resultofappeal = 'granted') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 49.48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 7.73 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 447.64 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 26.22 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 20 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid) FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14 ORDER BY num_people DESC, num_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS latest_startdate_in_court_year, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_in_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000' AND startdate < '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = l.court WHERE l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 0)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 13 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, MAX(l.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_actyear_per_court, p.name, p.jury FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.court LIKE 'Supreme%' AND l.judge LIKE 'J%' AND l.actkind LIKE 'Ruling%' AND l.actnumber > 230.27 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2014.72 AND 2016.8 AND (l.status = 'Active' OR l.resultofappeal = 'Affirmed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 37.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 9.14 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 237.2 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 17 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 EXCEPT SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2010' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate ORDER BY startdate DESC, id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6651.87 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.88 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 879.21 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.5 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 99796)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 607.34 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.25 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS year_flag_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.actyear < '1990' AND l.actnumber > '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 47917)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6.74 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.casenumber > 12.34 ORDER BY l2.casenumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 456.03 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) >= 25.69 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.3 AND AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear > 2003.3) > 368.39 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_case_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 869.0 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear AND la.casenumber > 431.68 ) ) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.6 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 383.76 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 506.0 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 1293.46 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.92 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS max_jury_involved, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT l2.id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.court = l.court ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS total_links_as_first, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links_as_second, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_with_startdate, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date, MIN(l2.motivedate) AS min_linked_motive_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank_by_date, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.actyear, l.casenumber) AS overall_dense_rank, LAG(l.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS prev_actnumber_in_court_year, LEAD(l.legaldate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS next_legaldate_in_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear, l.court) AS total_actnumber_per_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON (ll.actid1 = l2.id AND ll.actid1 != l.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND ll.actid2 != l.id) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 843.1 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 27.19 AND 92.93 AND p.jury = 0.99 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) + COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 2.25 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND SUM(sf.actid) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_people DESC, fix_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 24 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear > l1.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_linked_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 11 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS acts_count_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS acts_count_court2, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_court2, SUM(CASE WHEN lp1.peopleid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_people_linked_court1, SUM(CASE WHEN lp2.peopleid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_people_linked_court2, MAX(l1.senddate) AS latest_senddate_court1, MAX(l2.senddate) AS latest_senddate_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 949.33 AND l2.actnumber > 990.52 GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 584.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 678.41 ORDER BY acts_count_court1 DESC, acts_count_court2 DESC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 25 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 27 ORDER BY startdate DESC, actnumber;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 UNION SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS fix_contributors, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) < 9;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 66 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_highercourt_by_highcourt_actkind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_act_sequence FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 45 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) > '0' ORDER BY link_rank, court_act_sequence;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 36 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 20 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) AS people_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 96 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;
