SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 164 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 481 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, distinct_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) AS send_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) ORDER BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_quarterly_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 484.94 AND la.outnumber < 499.46 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1992.08 AND 2019.32 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) = 2010.26 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 34.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22.2 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < 1141.98 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC, court_act_rank;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2000' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(*) > 21 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear < '1990')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 88 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear < '1990')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 97 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 93 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS p75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'CourtA' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 479 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 0 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 33) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 335 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN la.actnumber END) AS avg_final_act_number, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 448 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 74 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30_acts_people_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_case_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 899.67 AND la.outnumber < 199.39 AND la.senddate <= '2001-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 9.14) GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.name, p.court, sf.contributor ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 45.84 AND AVG(la.outnumber) BETWEEN 46.05 AND 116.03 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, lp.peopleid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actyear >= '2000') AS avg_actnumber_recent, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), lp.peopleid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 84 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 1339.61 AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 9.69 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_casekind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_year_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 190.22 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 424.82 AND 552.73 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 46.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 63.93 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.casekind) AS max_casenumber_per_year_casekind FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 843.63 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1.84 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp1 ON la.id = lp1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON lp1.actid2 = lp2.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 960.77 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 40.32 AND 38.51 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 15.15 ORDER BY cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, MAX(la.actyear) FILTER (WHERE la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS max_actyear_with_highercourt, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt >= '2000') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 94.91 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS count_linked_acts_as_source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS count_fixes_with_description, MAX(la.outnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.outnumber IS NOT NULL) AS max_outnumber_in_group, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 5.08 AND la.outnumber < 793.91 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41.4 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) BETWEEN 2049.11 AND 2023.12 ORDER BY running_actnumber_sum_by_court DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS cumulative_fixes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, COUNT(sf.actid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 5 ORDER BY court_rank, cumulative_fixes DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, SUM(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_case_total FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link lp1 ON la.id = lp1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.hash, la.typeofdocument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 6 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY running_case_total DESC, linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 651;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 166.01 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 6.05 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_year_status, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 76 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank_by_kind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 3854.24 AND la.casenumber < 2691.4 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 1996.15 AND 1993.47 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 17.9 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 15 ) ) AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 514.25 AND (la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND la.typeofdocument IS NOT NULL AND la.status IN ('final', 'appealed') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 12.51 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.actid = la.id AND lp_inner.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS count_jury_people_in_act, (SELECT MAX(sf_inner.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf_inner WHERE sf_inner.actid = la.id AND LENGTH(sf_inner.fix_description) > 10) AS longest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 545.44 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 143.7 AND 1324.32 AND la.actyear >= 2011.29 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 6.44 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_casenumber_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 83.74 AND la.casenumber < 3084.56 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1.15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) + COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) + COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distinct_counts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 510.71 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43.41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 3.46 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor = 'A') AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'A' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 874.52 AND la.outnumber < 24.73 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1999.07 AND 2008.6 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 16.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 7.0 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '1900')) AS linked_acts_in_later_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id OR ll2.actid1 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 262764 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 960542 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal NOT IN ('GRANTED', 'DENIED') OR la.resultofappeal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS latest_startdate_per_court_casekind, MIN(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS earliest_legaldate_per_court_casekind, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS count_per_court_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 572.03 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 384.21 AND 810.41 AND la.actyear >= 2000.9 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14.62 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 2.81 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN la.actnumber ELSE 0 END) AS sum_actnumber_after_year, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_yearhighercourt, MAX(CASE WHEN la.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN la.motivedate ELSE la.startdate END) AS latest_motive_or_start_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ') AS all_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 0 AND MAX(la.yearhighercourt) BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_num1, la2.actnumber AS act_num2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.startdate AS start_date1, la2.startdate AS start_date2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS scrape_fix_count1, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS scrape_fix_count2, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_actnumber_court2, MAX(la1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS max_actyear_per_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND la2.actyear < '2000' AND la1.court = 'Supreme Court' AND p1.jury > 9 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la2.actnumber, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.startdate, la2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 81 AND COUNT(sf1.actid) >= 42 ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, la2.startdate DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actlink) AS avg_actlink FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND p1.jury = 57 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 16 AND SUM(sf1.actid) < 860419 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actlink) AS avg_actlink FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear < '2000' AND p2.jury = 58 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) < 39 AND SUM(sf2.actid) > 88041 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.judge, la2.id AS linked_act_id, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.startdate AS linked_startdate, la2.legaldate AS linked_legaldate, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.casekind AS linked_casekind, p.personid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_linked_act, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_case, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, la1.actnumber DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS acts_per_court_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 763.05 AND la2.actyear >= 2011.8 AND p.jury = 0.81 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.judge, la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.casekind, p.personid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 8.29 ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, recency_rank_in_court;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l2.id AS linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS network_size FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON l1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON lal.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.court = p.court THEN la.id END) AS same_court_acts FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.personid, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 10 ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT an.root_act_id, an.network_size, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS unique_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT la.highcourt) AS high_court_variety, AVG(an.shared_people_count) AS avg_shared_people, SUM(pc.total_acts) AS total_network_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_fix_contributors FROM act_networks an JOIN legalacts la ON an.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people_contributions pc ON lp.peopleid = pc.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND an.network_size > 3 GROUP BY an.root_act_id, an.network_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) >= 1 ) SELECT ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS direct_links, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes FROM complex_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 5 GROUP BY ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 10 ORDER BY ca.network_size DESC, ca.unique_contributors DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS cross_references, AVG(ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber)) AS avg_act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.court) AS referenced_courts_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actyear ), people_engagement AS ( SELECT p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS activity_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS active_people, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS acts_per_person_avg, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_members FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id WHERE l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) ), scrape_fix_metrics AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_processing_years, ca.granted_appeals, ca.max_act_number, COALESCE(laa.cross_references, 0) AS cross_references, COALESCE(laa.avg_act_number_diff, 0) AS avg_act_number_diff, COALESCE(laa.referenced_courts_count, 0) AS referenced_courts_count, COALESCE(pe.active_people, 0) AS active_people, COALESCE(pe.acts_per_person_avg, 0) AS acts_per_person_avg, COALESCE(pe.jury_members, 0) AS jury_members, COALESCE(sfm.fixes_count, 0) AS fixes_count, COALESCE(sfm.unique_contributors, 0) AS unique_contributors, COALESCE(sfm.avg_fix_length, 0) AS avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_activity ca LEFT JOIN linked_acts_analysis laa ON ca.court = laa.court AND ca.actyear = laa.actyear LEFT JOIN people_engagement pe ON ca.court = pe.court AND ca.actyear = pe.activity_year LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_metrics sfm ON ca.court = sfm.court AND ca.actyear = sfm.actyear WHERE ca.total_acts > 492 AND ca.avg_processing_years < 2.07 ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, court_rank ASC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 83 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casenumber > '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_case_number_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts la ON cjs.court = la.court AND cjs.judge = la.judge LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt > '2000' GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number ), people_network AS ( SELECT lla.court, lla.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS network_size, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_experience, MAX(lla.avg_linked_act_number) AS max_linked_act_num, SUM(lla.high_case_number_count) AS total_high_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.court != lla.court THEN p.personid END) AS external_court_connections FROM linked_act_analysis lla JOIN legalacts l ON lla.court = l.court AND lla.judge = l.judge JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY lla.court, lla.judge ) SELECT pn.court, pn.judge, pn.network_size, pn.avg_jury_experience, pn.max_linked_act_num, pn.total_high_cases, pn.external_court_connections, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, cjs.granted_appeals, lla.linked_acts_count, lla.avg_linked_act_number, lla.high_case_number_count, lla.unique_contributors, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC) AS network_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pn.court ORDER BY pn.avg_jury_experience DESC) AS court_jury_rank FROM people_network pn JOIN court_judge_stats cjs ON pn.court = cjs.court AND pn.judge = cjs.judge JOIN linked_act_analysis lla ON pn.court = lla.court AND pn.judge = lla.judge WHERE pn.network_size > 87 AND pn.total_high_cases >= 12 ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC LIMIT 90;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) as court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2020-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge ), court_summary AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(people_count) AS max_people_per_act FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_rank <= 7 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_people_per_act, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT id FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court = cs.court)) AS fixed_acts_count FROM court_summary cs ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(sub.avg_people_per_act) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts l JOIN ( SELECT lap.actid, AVG(inner_sub.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalact_people lap JOIN ( SELECT actid, COUNT(peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid ) inner_sub ON lap.actid = inner_sub.actid GROUP BY lap.actid ) sub ON l.id = sub.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 58 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 484 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 99 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '0' OR l.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 350 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2182.03 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10.8 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear >= '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = ll1.actid2 AND l2.actyear < '1900')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY people_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18.53 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_max_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.startdate IS NOT NULL AND l.startdate < '1990-01-01') ) AND ( l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT ( l.status = 'Active' AND l.resultofappeal = 'Granted' ) AND l.actnumber > 731.28 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 9.18) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 42.03 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 3288.32 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.93 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 17 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1606 ) AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 4 ORDER BY num_linked_acts DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, lp.peopleid, lp.actid, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, s.actid AS scrape_actid, s.fix_description, s.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS judge_act_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = 2018 AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 58 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber > '0' AND l.casenumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, lp.peopleid, lp.actid, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, s.actid, s.fix_description, s.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 19 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 1 = 1) GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 69 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS avg_active_actnumber, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = la.id AND lp.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS jury_involved_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 AND ll1.actid2 IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 AND ll2.actid1 IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = la.court WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.status = 'Active' OR la.casekind = 'Civil') AND la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 89 AND MAX(la.legaldate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 232 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_involved, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la3.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 46 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 222.79 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank_in_actkind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 250.13 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 91.54 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind, la.highcourt) AS avg_linked_acts_per_actkind_highcourt, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.court) AS max_casenumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 70 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 561.33 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.36 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS highcourt_actkind_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_court_startdate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND ( la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.highcourt LIKE '%High%' OR (la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.judge NOT LIKE '%Test%') ) AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.status = 'Active' OR la.resultofappeal = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_count_30_days, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_linked_acts_10_rows, MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt ORDER BY la.motivedate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_scrape_fixes_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber >= '1' AND la.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 8 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.outnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.outnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND AVG(la.outnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.outnumber IS NOT NULL) < 81.06 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal NOT IN ('GRANTED', 'DENIED') OR la.resultofappeal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_highercourt, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(la.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 64.47 AND (la.yearhighercourt > 2002.93 OR la.yearhighercourt IS NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'Supreme' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 40.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 17.07 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 23.52 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, latest_senddate DESC LIMIT 884.35;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, judge_act_recency_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND
