SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 1 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND la.actnumber > 670.52 AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND NOT (la.status = 'StatusA') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 21.19 AND SUM(la.outnumber) < 993.42 ORDER BY total_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '1' AND (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > 36.43 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.startdate IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 2 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 49 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) FILTER (WHERE sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_fixed_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 AND ll.actid2 != lp.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 332 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) >= 0 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, distinct_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 532 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 235 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, distinct_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, '; ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 88.52 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.name IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS actkind_list, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'CourtA' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 9 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 249.31 AND p.jury = 0.09 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > ( SELECT AVG(sub.act_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la_sub.id) AS act_count FROM legalacts la_sub WHERE la_sub.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la_sub.court ) sub ) ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_higher_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND p.jury > 64 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 427.69 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19.45 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_in_future_year, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id AND la2.actyear < la.actyear WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.jury > 1) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind, la.highcourt ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_rolling_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 827.25 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 88.62 AND 79.22 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 5.14 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS count_linked_acts_as_source, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS count_fixes_with_description, MAX(la.outnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.outnumber IS NOT NULL) AS max_outnumber_in_group, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 563.72 AND la.outnumber < 352.43 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.89 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) BETWEEN 1943.11 AND 2081.64 ORDER BY running_actnumber_sum_by_court DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS total_linked_acts_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.id DESC) AS row_num_by_court_startdate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber < '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 881754 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 440984 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_linked_acts_by_court_year DESC, rank_by_linked_acts;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, la.casenumber, la.actyear FROM legalacts la WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.actnumber ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_table_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 79.38 AND la.outnumber < 76.11 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 27.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 37.1 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 712.73 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS recency_rank, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt < '1900') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind, la.highcourt, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 10 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS active_status_count_per_group FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la2.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lap2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 50.82 AND p.jury = 0.71 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 23.88 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') >= 92.82 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS avg_people_3row, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 845.34 AND p.jury > 5.25 GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.78 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_number_1, la1.actyear AS act_year_1, la1.court AS court_1, la1.judge AS judge_1, la1.startdate AS start_date_1, la2.actnumber AS act_number_2, la2.actyear AS act_year_2, la2.court AS court_2, la2.judge AS judge_2, la2.startdate AS start_date_2, p.name AS person_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_act_number_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.startdate, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 85 UNION SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_number_1, la1.actyear AS act_year_1, la1.court AS court_1, la1.judge AS judge_1, la1.startdate AS start_date_1, la2.actnumber AS act_number_2, la2.actyear AS act_year_2, la2.court AS court_2, la2.judge AS judge_2, la2.startdate AS start_date_2, p.name AS person_name, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_act_number_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid1 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.startdate, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 2 ORDER BY fix_count DESC, act_year_1 DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_act1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count_act1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count_act2, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate_act1, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate_act2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 233.46 AND la2.actnumber > 195.18 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 45.68 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 857.78 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate_act1 DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_linked_acts_3year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(people_count) AS total_people_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY linked_acts_count) AS median_linked_acts FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_year_rank <= 20 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(people_count) > 7.69 AND COUNT(*) >= 99 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_people_involved, cs.median_linked_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actyear ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people DESC, ra.people_count DESC ) AS yearly_people_rank, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate ) AS prev_year_people_count, (ra.people_count - LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate )) AS people_count_change FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.avg_linked_acts_3year > 3.17 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.id, ca.actnumber, ca.startdate, ca.legaldate, ca.people_count, ca.linked_acts_count, ca.has_fix, ca.court_year_rank, ca.cumulative_people, ca.avg_linked_acts_3year, ca.total_acts, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.total_people_involved, ca.median_linked_acts, ca.yearly_people_rank, ca.prev_year_people_count, ca.people_count_change, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.people_count DESC, ca.linked_acts_count DESC ) AS court_importance_rank, SUM(ca.people_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.actyear, ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS court_cumulative_people, AVG(ca.linked_acts_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actyear ORDER BY ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_linked_acts FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.yearly_people_rank <= 87 AND ca.people_count_change > 4 ORDER BY ca.court, ca.actyear DESC, ca.yearly_people_rank;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2019-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value, 'people_count' AS metric_type FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 3 UNION ALL SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value, 'link_count' AS metric_type FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count >= 4 ORDER BY startdate DESC, metric_value DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 13 AND SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) < 8 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_after_year, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990') AS avg_actnumber_in_period FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 1 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_scrapefix_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_actnumber_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l2.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid2 = l3.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, p.name, p.court, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_casekind DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.highcourt LIKE '%High%') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.46 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 319.06 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38.97 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > l.yearhighercourt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS year_diff_count_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_judge_status, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_senddate_by_court, MIN(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS earliest_legaldate_by_actkind, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS total_acts_by_court_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 927.63 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 922.75 AND 1537.04 AND l.actyear >= 2007.81 AND l.yearhighercourt <= 2001.03 AND l.outnumber >= 180.34 AND (l.motivedate IS NULL OR l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01') AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 13.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19.32 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 246.34 AND MAX(l.senddate) >= '2010-01-01' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN (SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear <= '1990')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 4 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 37.56 AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 5.83 ) GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 29.22 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 44.77 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 3 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actyear, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actyear, la2.actnumber, la2.court, la2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 70 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 39 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.court, la3.judge, la3.actyear, la4.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la4.court AS linked_court, la4.actyear AS linked_actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la3.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court, la3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < '1' AND la4.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.court, la3.judge, la3.actyear, la4.actnumber, la4.court, la4.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 62 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 50 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, linked_actnumber ASC;

SELECT la1.court AS court_name, la1.actyear AS act_year, la1.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_involved, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.casekind, ', ') AS case_kinds FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 56 AND MAX(la1.legaldate) <= '2000-01-01' UNION SELECT la3.court AS court_name, la3.actyear AS act_year, la3.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_involved, MAX(la3.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la3.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(la3.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la3.casekind, ', ') AS case_kinds FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN people p3 ON lp3.peopleid = p3.personid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p4 ON lp4.peopleid = p4.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear >= '2000' AND la3.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) > 18 AND MAX(la3.legaldate) <= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY act_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_act_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2011-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ), court_yearly_stats AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(aa.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(aa.num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, SUM(aa.high_act_count) AS high_act_total, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.court ORDER BY aa.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr_acts FROM act_aggregates aa GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid = sf.contributor::integer WHERE p.jury > 5 GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts, MAX(pc.acts_involved) AS max_acts_per_person, AVG(pc.fixes_contributed) AS avg_fixes_per_contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS active_people_count FROM court_yearly_stats cys LEFT JOIN people_contributions pc ON cys.court = pc.court WHERE cys.total_acts > 916 AND cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts > 137.35 GROUP BY cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 34 ORDER BY cys.total_acts DESC, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 25 AND SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) < 41 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear UNION ALL SELECT l.court, NULL AS actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND sf.actid IS NULL GROUP BY l.court;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_judge_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS max_judge_count FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN (SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear) GROUP BY lp.actid) sub) AS max_people_per_act_in_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.outnumber > '1') AND l.court IS NOT NULL AND l.actkind IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 13 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, court_year_total DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17 ORDER BY people_rank, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) > 1 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY total_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_with_description, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 4515.26 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) BETWEEN 2010.69 AND 2016.67 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 9.84 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, avg_years_between_start_legal DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 = l.id AND ll_sub.actid2 > 537253 ) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 7391.68 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 58.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 44.32 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) = l.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS yearly_court_case_match, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_quarter, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) = 4 AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 5 ORDER BY recency_rank, linked_act_count DESC, scrapefix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS court_actnumber_running_total FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' AND l2.court = 'Supreme Court' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 24 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS max_actnumber_in_court_case FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > '500' AND l2.startdate <= '2010-01-01' ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) >= 12 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 AND AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.status IS NOT NULL) > '10' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY num_people DESC, total_actnumber ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 72 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 77 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 716.65 AND p.jury = 0.19 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > ( SELECT AVG(sub.act_count) FROM ( SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la_sub.id) AS act_count FROM legalacts la_sub WHERE la_sub.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la_sub.court ) sub ) ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 55.82 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 38.41 AND 72.17 AND la.startdate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 86.75 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 56.41 ORDER BY act_count DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_act_number_by_court, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_year_higher_court, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 3 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, SUM(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_case_total FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_link lp1 ON la.id = lp1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 7) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.hash, la.typeofdocument HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.actid2) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 17 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY running_case_total DESC, linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 928;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_count FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY cumulative_people_count DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 5901.46 AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 48.78 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT MAX(sf.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 20 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_people_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = la.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate > '2020-01-01')) AS count_linked_future_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 431.94 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 196.35 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, lal1.actid1, lal1.actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON lal1.actid2 = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.motivedate) = 2002 AND (la.senddate - la.startdate) > 108 AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, lal1.actid1, lal1.actid2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 266.27 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la1.actnumber AS act_number1, la1.legaldate AS legal_date1, la1.court AS court1, la2.id AS act_id2, la2.actnumber AS act_number2, la2.legaldate AS legal_date2, la2.court AS court2, p.personid AS person_id, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description AS scrape_fix, sf.contributor AS fix_contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(la1.actnumber + la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_actnumbers, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumbers, MAX(la1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind) AS max_actyear_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '1' AND la1.actyear >= '1990' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.casekind, la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 18 ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.legaldate, la.actnumber ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(aa.num_people) AS total_people, SUM(aa.num_links) AS total_links, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, AVG(aa.moving_avg_actnumber) AS avg_moving_actnumber, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY aa.num_people) AS median_people_per_act, MAX(aa.num_links) AS max_links_per_act FROM act_aggregates aa WHERE aa.num_people > 50 AND aa.moving_avg_actnumber >= 658.67 GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN lap.actid END) AS granted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number, SUM(ca.total_links) AS total_court_links FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id JOIN court_metrics ca ON p.court = ca.court AND la.actyear = ca.actyear WHERE p.jury = 1 AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act, COUNT(pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.granted_appeals) AS total_granted_appeals, CORR(cm.total_links, pa.total_court_links) AS links_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cm.total_links DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON cm.court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_acts > 7548 AND cm.total_links >= 3127 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act HAVING COUNT(pa.personid) > 66 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 15.18 ORDER BY court_rank, cm.total_acts DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_case_date, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_case_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 12 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, l1.actnumber AS actnum1, l2.actnumber AS actnum2, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrape_fix_summary AS ( SELECT s.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, STRING_AGG(s.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.senddate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 9 ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) AS linked_cases_count, AVG(laa.act_number_diff) AS avg_act_number_diff, MAX(laa.common_people_count) AS max_common_people, COUNT(sfs.actid) AS fixed_cases_count, SUM(sfs.fix_count) AS total_fixes_applied FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN linked_act_analysis laa ON l.id IN (laa.actid1, laa.actid2) LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_summary sfs ON l.id = sfs.actid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 339 AND (cjs.granted_appeals >= 26 OR cjs.unique_people_involved > 73) AND NOT (cjs.court LIKE '%Supreme%' AND cjs.avg_act_number < '1') GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) > 1 AND SUM(sfs.fix_count) >= 6 ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, avg_act_number_diff DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE people_count >= 44 AND linked_acts_count > 16 GROUP BY court ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ra.has_fix = 1 THEN lap.actid END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(ra.linked_acts_count) AS avg_linked_per_act FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN ranked_acts ra ON lap.actid = ra.id WHERE ra.court_rank <= 123 AND ra.people_count BETWEEN 5 AND 4 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pa.acts_with_fixes) AS max_fixes_by_person, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people_count FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court JOIN people_analysis pa ON cs.court = pa.court WHERE cs.total_acts > 9674 AND cs.avg_people_per_act >= 4.59 AND pa.acts_participated > 84 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 96 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 27.54 AND SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) > 51580 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 29402) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(*) > 55 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;
