SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 97 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 264 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 29 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 5 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 9742.39 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37.63 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 543.33 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.91 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_scrapefix_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 1173.27 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 532.37 AND 139.36 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.4 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 7.68 ) ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN 640.98 AND 611.6 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10.08 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 688.94 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 11.32 UNION ALL SELECT p.personid AS legalact_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, NULL AS legaldate, p.court, NULL AS judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court ORDER BY p.personid ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(CAST(p.jury AS DECIMAL)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM people p LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE p.jury > 5.02 AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court, p.jury, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 18.15 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate NULLS LAST;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 9507.85 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1.08 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_people_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6522.2 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16.92 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_in_year, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 72 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) AS max_year_higher_court, MIN(l.casenumber) AS min_case_number, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt < '1990' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '100' AND MAX(l.yearhighercourt) >= '2000' ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN (SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear <= '1990')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'None' ) ) AND l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_year_flag_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, court_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 570639) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY l.court, court_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 32629)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_casekind, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND (l.casekind = 'Civil' OR l.casekind IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_recent_act_flag_sum, SUM(CASE WHEN l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS is_sent_after_date_flag_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS total_jury_members, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, SUM(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_total_outnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1001' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 AND SUM(l.outnumber) < '0' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS min_startdate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON (ll1.actid2 = lp2.actid OR ll2.actid1 = lp2.actid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate) AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 94 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 432 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_legal_acts_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 34 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, l1.court AS court, l1.actkind AS act_kind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13.77 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, start_date DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 59 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id AS act_id, l3.actnumber, l3.legaldate, l3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l4.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid2 = l4.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actnumber < '1' AND p2.jury < 85 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.legaldate, l3.court, l3.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) >= 10 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 UNION SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS fix_contributors, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) < 14;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) = 12 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 87 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS act_kinds_list, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 6) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 87 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_volume_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_highcourt_actkind, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 90 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 865.83 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 18.51 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 5358.27 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2017.86 AND 2005.03 AND la.outnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 99.25 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_judge, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS min_startdate_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.casekind = 'Civil') AND la.status IN ('Active', 'Active', 'Active') AND la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.actkind <> 'TypeA' AND (la.motivedate IS NULL OR la.motivedate > '2000-01-01') AND (la.senddate IS NULL OR la.senddate < '2000-01-01') AND (la.hash IS NULL OR la.hash = 'A') AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury = 0) AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'ContributorA') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 21 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS acts_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 600.04 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.actid = la.id AND lp_inner.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS count_jury_people_in_act, (SELECT MAX(sf_inner.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf_inner WHERE sf_inner.actid = la.id AND LENGTH(sf_inner.fix_description) > 10) AS longest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 198.51 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 380.76 AND 1425.99 AND la.actyear >= 2006.59 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.99 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 10.18 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 135.91 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2004.25 AND 2009.02 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 22.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 15.15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_year_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 0) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid1 = la.id AND actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) AND (la.status = 'active' OR la.casekind = 'civil') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 18 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 774.19 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 41.15 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < 15693.83 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < 154.16 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 23.84 AND AVG(la4.actyear) > 2011.93 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, actyear;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 8 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 23 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

WITH act_relationships AS ( SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS related_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, CASE WHEN l1.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_act_link, CASE WHEN l1.motivelink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_motive_link FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 OR l1.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON (ll.actid1 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.actlink, l1.motivelink ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT lp.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT p.jury) AS unique_juries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS people_names FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 88 GROUP BY lp.actid ), scrape_metrics AS ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS max_fix_length FROM scrapefix sf WHERE LENGTH(sf.fix_description) > 117 GROUP BY sf.actid ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ar.act_id, ar.actnumber, ar.legaldate, ar.court, ar.actyear, ar.related_acts_count, ar.involved_people_count, ar.has_act_link, ar.has_motive_link, COALESCE(pa.unique_people, 0) AS unique_people, COALESCE(pa.unique_juries, 0) AS unique_juries, pa.people_names, COALESCE(sm.fix_count, 0) AS fix_count, COALESCE(sm.unique_contributors, 0) AS unique_contributors, COALESCE(sm.max_fix_length, 0) AS max_fix_length, SUM(ar.related_acts_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court, ar.actyear) AS court_year_total_relations, AVG(ar.involved_people_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court ORDER BY ar.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court ORDER BY ar.related_acts_count DESC, ar.involved_people_count DESC) AS court_rank FROM act_relationships ar LEFT JOIN people_aggregates pa ON ar.act_id = pa.actid LEFT JOIN scrape_metrics sm ON ar.act_id = sm.actid WHERE ar.related_acts_count > 8 AND ar.involved_people_count >= 2 ) SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(related_acts_count) AS total_relations, SUM(involved_people_count) AS total_people_involved, AVG(unique_people) AS avg_unique_people, AVG(unique_juries) AS avg_unique_juries, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(max_fix_length) AS avg_max_fix_length, MAX(court_rank) AS max_court_rank, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY moving_avg_people) AS median_moving_avg_people FROM window_analysis WHERE court_year_total_relations > 363 AND moving_avg_people > 8.18 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 50 AND SUM(related_acts_count) >= 117 ORDER BY total_relations DESC, total_people_involved DESC LIMIT 46;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), act_link_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1 ), people_contribution AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON lp.actid = sf.actid WHERE p.jury > 1 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = cjs.court AND l3.judge = cjs.judge AND l3.legaldate > cjs.latest_legal_date AND l3.actnumber > '100') AS recent_high_number_cases, (SELECT AVG(sf2.fix_description_length) FROM (SELECT actid, LENGTH(fix_description) AS fix_description_length FROM scrapefix WHERE actid IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = pc.personid) AND LENGTH(fix_description) > 735) sf2) AS avg_fix_length FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN act_link_analysis ala ON l.id = ala.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people_contribution pc ON lp2.peopleid = pc.personid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 435 AND cjs.unique_people_count >= 94 AND (ala.linked_acts_count IS NULL OR ala.linked_acts_count > 5) GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, pc.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 15 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '500' ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, cjs.unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS fiscal_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate < '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate), l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 37 ORDER BY fiscal_year DESC, fiscal_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS yearly_total_scrapefix FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 4 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_total, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_distinct_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 450.84 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8.8 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6007.54 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28.71 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 58.32 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(l.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_by_court, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_dense_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 6 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37 ORDER BY l.court, people_rank_in_court, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_act_links, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > 2013.8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS recent_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_court_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN 1996.2 AND 2007.14 AND l.actnumber > 341.4 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 1.41 ORDER BY total_people_linked DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 3 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'None' ) ) AND l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.yearhighercourt > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_court_cases, MAX(l.actyear) AS max_act_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) > 3.64 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COALESCE(sf_counts.fix_count, 0)) AS avg_fixes_per_act, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear > '2000' ) GROUP BY sf.actid ) sf_counts ON l.id = sf_counts.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 29.23 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 62.02 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.34 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp_outer ON l.id = lp_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_case_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 1 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 18 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_case_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 170.12 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear AND la.casenumber > 193.63 ) ) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.2 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 523.67 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 515.86 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 1106.26 AND 1987.81 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 3.15 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS min_startdate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON (ll1.actid2 = lp2.actid OR ll2.actid1 = lp2.actid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate) AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 932 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 662 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS cross_link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_act_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_avg_cross_link, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS judge_year_max_startdate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid AND lp2.peopleid != p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber > '0' AND p.jury = 151969 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 74893 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 8840.08 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 1 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 799.28 AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 100.65 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 49 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS judge_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_higher_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND p.jury > 936 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 42 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '1') AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 7 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 385.45 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 4932.15 AND 7295.38 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23.57 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 3.51 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, court_rank;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS recency_rank, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt < '1900') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind, la.highcourt, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 4 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS count_linked_acts_as_source, (SELECT AVG(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid > la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS avg_scrapefix_id_higher FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

28.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19.33 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.casenumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear ORDER BY la1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people_10_acts, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind ORDER BY la1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber_5_days, MAX(la1.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.highcourt, la1.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_highcourt_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 766.05 AND la2.actyear >= 2002.01 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.casenumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 2.39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 6.48 ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.judge, la2.id AS linked_act_id, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.startdate AS linked_startdate, la2.legaldate AS linked_legaldate, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.casekind AS linked_casekind, p.personid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_linked_act, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_case, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, la1.actnumber DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS acts_per_court_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 433.64 AND la2.actyear >= 2018.57 AND p.jury = 0.13 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.judge, la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.casekind, p.personid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 15.88 ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, recency_rank_in_court;

WITH act_hierarchy AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actnumber AS linked_act_number, l2.legaldate AS linked_legal_date, l2.motivedate AS linked_motive_date, CASE WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate > 116 THEN 'LONG_DELAY' WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate < 10 THEN 'SHORT_DELAY' ELSE 'NORMAL_DELAY' END AS processing_delay_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) AS years_between_acts FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2011-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2011' ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS jury_members_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ';
