') AS involved_people_names FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON ah.linked_act_id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), scrape_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(sf.fix_description, 50), ' | ') AS fix_previews FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON ah.linked_act_id = sf.actid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.*, pa.total_people_involved, pa.jury_members_count, pa.involved_people_names, sa.fix_count, sa.unique_contributors, sa.fix_previews, AVG(ah.years_between_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court) AS avg_years_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.processing_delay_category, ah.root_court) AS delay_count_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court ORDER BY ah.years_between_acts DESC) AS years_rank_in_court FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON ah.root_act_id = pa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = pa.linked_act_id LEFT JOIN scrape_analysis sa ON ah.root_act_id = sa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = sa.linked_act_id ) SELECT root_court, processing_delay_category, COUNT(*) AS total_linkages, AVG(years_between_acts) AS avg_years_between, MAX(years_between_acts) AS max_years_between, SUM(total_people_involved) AS total_people_across_links, AVG(jury_members_count) AS avg_jury_per_link, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(unique_contributors) AS avg_contributors_per_link, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(involved_people_names, 30), '; ') AS sample_people FROM window_analysis WHERE years_between_acts > 8 AND total_people_involved >= 17 AND fix_count <= 31 GROUP BY root_court, processing_delay_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 77 AND AVG(years_between_acts) > 1.28 ORDER BY total_linkages DESC, avg_years_between DESC;

WITH aggregated_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 ), court_analysis AS ( SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, aa.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS court_total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC) AS people_rank FROM aggregated_acts aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE la.senddate <= '1990-01-01' ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ca.*, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_in_range FROM court_analysis ca LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON ca.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id GROUP BY ca.id, ca.num_people, ca.num_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.recent_acts_count, ca.court, ca.judge, ca.court_total_acts, ca.people_rank ), people_stats AS ( SELECT la.*, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, MAX(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_jury FROM linked_acts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY la.id, la.num_people, la.num_fixes, la.avg_act_number, la.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, la.court_total_acts, la.people_rank, la.num_linked_acts, la.linked_acts_in_range ) SELECT court, judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(num_people) AS total_people_involved, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, MAX(num_linked_acts) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(linked_acts_in_range) AS total_linked_in_range, SUM(recent_acts_count) AS total_recent_acts, AVG(avg_act_number) AS overall_avg_act_number, SUM(has_jury) AS jury_cases_count FROM people_stats WHERE num_fixes > 2 AND linked_acts_in_range >= 39 GROUP BY court, judge HAVING SUM(num_people) > 587 AND COUNT(*) >= 22 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_acts DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_people_1year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_act_rank <= 65 AND cumulative_people > 76 GROUP BY court, actkind HAVING AVG(people_count) > 37.1 AND COUNT(*) >= 347 ) SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act AS court_avg_people, cs.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked, cs.total_fixes AS court_total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.avg_people_per_act DESC) AS court_importance_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.people_count DESC) AS people_percentile, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.court, ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.legaldate) AS prev_people_count FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actkind = cs.actkind WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 34 AND ra.avg_people_1year > 13.32 ORDER BY court_importance_rank, ra.court_act_rank, ra.people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > 2003.14 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_in_group FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= 1911.94 AND l.actyear <= 1976.34 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 67.43 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 39.73 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 0))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS acts_in_year_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_kind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (l.court = 'Court A' OR l.actkind = 'Kind A') AND l.actyear > '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS cross_link_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_with_startdate_count, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_linked_actnumber, MIN(l2.legaldate) AS earliest_linked_legaldate, MAX(l2.motivedate) AS latest_linked_motivedate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS court_case_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) DESC) AS linked_act_density_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.senddate DESC, l.id) AS judge_act_sequence FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 4964.26 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2009.59 AND 1997.89 AND (l.motivedate IS NULL OR l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 98.48 AND AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) < 6834.24 ORDER BY court_case_rank, linked_act_density_rank, judge_act_sequence;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, legalact_id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_people_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC, link_count ASC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 9;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '1' AND (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > 21.86 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 290 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_actkind, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.status ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_by_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 418.87 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 15.96 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_status, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind) AS max_legaldate_by_judge_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 136.33 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1994.8 AND 2014.2 AND la.outnumber < 41.58 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 13.9 ORDER BY total_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ) SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, AVG(avg_processing_years) AS avg_processing_time FROM act_aggregates WHERE num_people > 7 AND num_related_acts >= 3 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(num_fixes) > 1.96 ORDER BY court, actyear DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l2.id AS linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS network_size FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON l1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON lal.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 1 ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.court = p.court THEN la.id END) AS same_court_acts FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.personid, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 13 ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT an.root_act_id, an.network_size, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS unique_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT la.highcourt) AS high_court_variety, AVG(an.shared_people_count) AS avg_shared_people, SUM(pc.total_acts) AS total_network_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_fix_contributors FROM act_networks an JOIN legalacts la ON an.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people_contributions pc ON lp.peopleid = pc.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND an.network_size > 9 GROUP BY an.root_act_id, an.network_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) >= 5 ) SELECT ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS direct_links, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes FROM complex_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 4 GROUP BY ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 3 ORDER BY ca.network_size DESC, ca.unique_contributors DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 28914.85) AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN -24923.21 AND 26943.68 AND l.legaldate >= '1900-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > 12198.79 OR l.outnumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court), (l.actyear), (l.actkind), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 117410.38 AND (GROUPING(l.court) = 0 OR GROUPING(l.actyear) = 0) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, MAX(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.legaldate IS NOT NULL) AS max_actnumber_with_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 20 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, MAX(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.legaldate IS NOT NULL) AS max_actnumber_with_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) < 60 ORDER BY court, actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_scrapefix FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6407.88 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 35.37 ORDER BY people_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%' AND l.judge LIKE '%' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) AS median_jury, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_highercourt, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 227.56 AND (l.yearhighercourt > 2006.1 OR l.yearhighercourt IS NULL) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 12.11 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) > 8.68 ORDER BY people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) AS median_jury, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_highercourt, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 857.71 AND (l.yearhighercourt > 2001.93 OR l.yearhighercourt IS NULL) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 30.68 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 18.71 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) > 3.01 ORDER BY people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS co_participant_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_latest_startdate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid AND lp2.peopleid != lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_start_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actyear AS act_year, l1.court AS court, l1.judge AS judge, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actyear AS linked_act_year, l2.court AS linked_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 50 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, max_linked_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_linked_start, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 68 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_id;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fix_descriptions, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_years_duration, MAX(la.actnumber) AS max_act_number, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_send_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) BETWEEN 3.3 AND 18.59 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, avg_years_duration ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, ', ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 1.05 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.startdate) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2000' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY act_count DESC, month_start;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, MAX(la.actyear) FILTER (WHERE la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS max_actyear_with_highercourt, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt >= '2000') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 30 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 41.03 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_actkind, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_linked_acts_per_judge, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.yearhighercourt) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 448.52 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 2009.14 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32.24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 96.81 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS judge_max_legaldate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la2.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lap2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01') OR (la.senddate < '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1') ) AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND NOT (la.status = 'StatusA' AND la.resultofappeal = 'ResultA') AND (p.jury = 0 OR p.court IN ('CourtA', 'CourtA')) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll1.actid2) > 53 AND AVG(la2.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_case, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 45 AND SUM(la.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear > la.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_year_linked_acts, AVG(la2.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la2.actnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_linked_actnumber, MAX(la2.startdate) AS max_linked_startdate, MIN(la2.legaldate) AS min_linked_legaldate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt < '1900') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.senddate) AS last_send_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2010' AND l.outnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.legal_year, SUM(ca.total_acts) AS yearly_acts, SUM(ca.total_people_involved) AS yearly_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.avg_act_number) AS median_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.judge) AS active_judges FROM court_activity ca GROUP BY ca.court, ca.legal_year HAVING SUM(ca.total_acts) > 760 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.legal_year, cs.yearly_acts, cs.yearly_people, cs.median_act_number, cs.active_judges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.legal_year ORDER BY cs.yearly_acts DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year) AS prev_year_acts, (cs.yearly_acts - LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year)) AS yoy_growth FROM court_stats cs WHERE cs.yearly_people >= 138 ORDER BY cs.legal_year DESC, activity_rank ASC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 48 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, AVG(s.fix_description_length) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN ( SELECT actid, LENGTH(fix_description) AS fix_description_length FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 32995 ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34 ORDER BY num_people DESC;
SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND s.actid > 77659 GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(COALESCE(sf_counts.fix_count, 0)) AS avg_fixes_per_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT la.actid1 FROM legalact_link la WHERE la.actid1 > 733297 ) GROUP BY sf.actid ) sf_counts ON l.id = sf_counts.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 81 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 7 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 248 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 278 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 514 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_with_description, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 7577.06 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) BETWEEN 2001.01 AND 2021.39 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 12.12 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, avg_years_between_start_legal DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 4897.38 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.71 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.actnumber DESC) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.casenumber DESC) AS case_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 12 ORDER BY l.court, l.startdate DESC, cumulative_people_by_court DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS row_num_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 3) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 10 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS row_num_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 7) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 17 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 163.77 AND (l.typeofdocument LIKE '%Act%' OR l.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND (l.judge IS NOT NULL AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%') AND l.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE name LIKE '%A%' GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 14.58) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 37.14 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_by_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 764.27 AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.highcourt LIKE '%High%') AND l.typeofdocument ~ '^Judgment' AND l.status IS NOT NULL AND p.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 6.53 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 160.16 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.25 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 4 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_fixes DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_max_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.startdate IS NOT NULL AND l.startdate < '1990-01-01') ) AND ( l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL ) AND NOT ( l.status = 'Active' AND l.resultofappeal = 'Granted' ) AND l.actnumber > 902.17 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8.78) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 9.88 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 1478.91 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 5.22 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.01 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_casekind, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND (l.casekind = 'Civil' OR l.casekind IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 653.63 AND (l.casenumber < 95.5 OR l.casenumber IS NULL) AND l.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 0.74 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.legaldate > l2.legaldate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 63 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actnumber AS linked_act_number, l2.startdate AS linked_start_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l1.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 7590.12 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 19.03 ORDER BY l1.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(l2.actnumber) AS sum_linked_actnumber FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 364.57 AND l2.actnumber < 1955.5 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 35.52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 16.29 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l1.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, l1.judge AS root_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ') AS linked_courts, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear > l1.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_year_links, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS total_fix_contributors, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l2.actnumber) AS median_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '1900' AND l1.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND l1.court LIKE '%' AND l2.court LIKE '%' AND l1.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 970832 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 557692 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_year ASC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 1 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 12;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 314 ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, la.actyear DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY la.court, people_rank_in_court;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 7) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS total_links, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_legal_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.motivedate >= '2019-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_motive_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt > 0 THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_higher_court_year, MAX(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN la.senddate ELSE NULL END) AS latest_active_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_act_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) DESC) AS global_fix_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 OR la.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND la.outnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 6 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, total_fixes DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 291 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_list, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.contributor, ', ' ORDER BY sf.contributor) AS contributors_list FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 587.24 AND la.outnumber < 893.04 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2007.9 AND 2004.8 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 88.33 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 640.59 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, sum_act_numbers DESC;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2000' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(*) > 59 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) > 2 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 4) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 31 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 33 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_volume_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 34 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;
