SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_acts) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS max_acts FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la2.judge) sub) AS max_judge_acts_in_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la_linked ON ll.actid2 = la_linked.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 94 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = la.id) >= 36 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 11 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 263.34 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.64 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 3008.85 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 15.11 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fix_descriptions, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_casekind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_year_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 400.81 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 975.32 AND 1428.95 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 45.97 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 0.53 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC LIMIT 50.48;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear AND court = la.court)) AS linked_acts_same_year_court, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 64.35 AND la.outnumber < 700.06 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 24.01 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < 2053.42 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ll.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 346.93 AND (la.casenumber < 54.73 OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) >= 35.71 AND COUNT(*) > 2.9 ORDER BY court_year_total_acts DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 447.25 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2000.89 AND 2015.03 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 10.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 2.54 ORDER BY total_people DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 > 3667) AS related_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = la.id AND lp.peopleid > 1231) AS people_count FROM legalacts la WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, related_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 356.71 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND casekind = la.casekind AND actyear >= 2022.24) ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people_4period, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 65.54 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19.43 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 7 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_case, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 11 AND SUM(la.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' THEN la.yearhighercourt ELSE 0 END) AS recent_higher_court_year_sum, AVG(CASE WHEN la.outnumber IS NOT NULL THEN la.outnumber::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(CASE WHEN la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' THEN la.senddate ELSE NULL END) AS latest_senddate_after_threshold, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.motivedate IS NOT NULL) AS acts_with_motivation_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC) AS court_actyear_dense_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 10 AND AVG(CASE WHEN la.outnumber IS NOT NULL THEN la.outnumber::numeric ELSE NULL END) BETWEEN 44.29 AND 166.38 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC LIMIT 3850;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 13;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.fix_count) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lap1 ON la1.id = lap1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lap1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN (SELECT actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count FROM scrapefix GROUP BY actid) sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap1.peopleid) > 12 AND SUM(sf1.fix_count) < 6 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.fix_count) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la2.id = lap2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lap2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN (SELECT actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count FROM scrapefix GROUP BY actid) sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 39 AND SUM(sf2.fix_count) < 32 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.legaldate, la.actnumber ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(aa.num_people) AS total_people, SUM(aa.num_links) AS total_links, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, AVG(aa.moving_avg_actnumber) AS avg_moving_actnumber, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY aa.num_people) AS median_people_per_act, MAX(aa.num_links) AS max_links_per_act FROM act_aggregates aa WHERE aa.num_people > 45 AND aa.moving_avg_actnumber >= 61.18 GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN lap.actid END) AS granted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number, SUM(ca.total_links) AS total_court_links FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id JOIN court_metrics ca ON p.court = ca.court AND la.actyear = ca.actyear WHERE p.jury = 0 AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act, COUNT(pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.granted_appeals) AS total_granted_appeals, CORR(cm.total_links, pa.total_court_links) AS links_correlation, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cm.total_links DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON cm.court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_acts > 208 AND cm.total_links >= 4328 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.total_people, cm.total_links, cm.total_fixes, cm.avg_moving_actnumber, cm.median_people_per_act, cm.max_links_per_act HAVING COUNT(pa.personid) > 17 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 4.83 ORDER BY court_rank, cm.total_acts DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT la1.id AS root_act_id, la1.actyear AS root_year, la1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MAX(la2.actyear) AS max_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON la1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la2.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actyear, la1.court ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT an.root_court, COUNT(*) AS total_networks, SUM(an.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(an.involved_people_count) AS total_people, AVG(an.avg_linked_act_number) AS court_avg_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY an.max_linked_year) AS court_75p_linked_year FROM act_networks an GROUP BY an.root_court ), people_activity AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed, MIN(la.startdate) AS first_activity_date, MAX(la.legaldate) AS last_activity_date FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid::text = sf.contributor WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.fixes_contributed) AS total_fixes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.acts_participated) AS people_90p_activity FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people_activity pa ON cm.root_court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_linked_acts > 8583 AND cm.court_75p_linked_year >= '2000' GROUP BY cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 100 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) > 28 ORDER BY cm.total_linked_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS court_year_rank, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, AVG(ra.fix_count) AS avg_fixes, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 11 AND ra.people_count > 16 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2015' AND '2015' THEN lap.actid ELSE NULL END) AS recent_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT ra.id, ra.actnumber, ra.startdate, ra.legaldate, ra.court, ra.judge, ra.people_count, ra.fix_count, ra.linked_acts_count, ra.court_year_rank, ra.avg_people_per_court_year, ra.cumulative_people_court, cm.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cm.total_people AS court_total_people, cm.avg_fixes AS court_avg_fixes, cm.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked_acts, cm.median_people AS court_median_people, pa.acts_involved, pa.recent_acts, pa.overall_rank, pa.court_rank, CASE WHEN ra.people_count > cm.median_people * 1.66 THEN 'HIGH_PEOPLE' WHEN ra.fix_count > cm.avg_fixes * 4.83 THEN 'HIGH_FIXES' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS complexity_category FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_metrics cm ON ra.court = cm.court AND ra.actyear = cm.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ra.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON lap2.peopleid = pa.personid WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 7 AND ra.people_count >= 8 ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people_court DESC, ra.court_year_rank, pa.overall_rank LIMIT 630;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid IN ( SELECT l2.id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) AS total_people_links FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 94 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 27 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 603 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 658.16 AND l.yearhighercourt < 2061.03 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 39.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 19.09 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_with_case FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '1990-01-01') ) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' OR l.actyear IS NULL) AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.actkind = 'Final Judgment') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 5 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_case_status, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.actkind) AS judge_actkind_latest_start FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 1826.42 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 33.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.87 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.13 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_legal_acts_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MIN(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS earliest_startdate_per_highcourt, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS latest_senddate_per_highcourt FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 905.06 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2005.5 AND 2018.62 AND l.outnumber < 91.24 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 1.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.83 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(s.actid) AS avg_scraped_act, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_start FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid > 3241 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_act_by_case FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ORDER BY id LIMIT 4212 OFFSET 97311 ) ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 0 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(personid) > 400 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS active_court_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 491 ) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 346.49 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.9 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_people_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '1990-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 655.32 AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.status = 'Final') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7.42 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 3.82 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 99.69 AND (l.casenumber < 23.63 OR l.casenumber IS NULL) AND l.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 6.47 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ORDER BY ll.actid2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 77 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30days, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge ORDER BY l1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_linked_acts_10rows, MAX(l1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS max_actyear_court FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1 ORDER BY l1.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.startdate AS root_start_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_start_date;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury = 1 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 842 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS yearly_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, ', ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people_list, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 1 = 1) GROUP BY CUBE (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.casekind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_case_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 869.13 AND la.outnumber < 225.98 AND la.senddate <= '2001-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 1.51) GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.name, p.court, sf.contributor ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 15.81 AND AVG(la.outnumber) BETWEEN 76.24 AND 171.83 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS judge_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '51' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.num_people) AS total_people, AVG(ra.num_links) AS avg_links, MAX(ra.running_people_count) AS max_running_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.actnumber) AS median_actnumber FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 25 AND ra.judge_avg_actnumber > 26.71 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 392 AND SUM(ra.num_people) >= 1349 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.total_people DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.total_acts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cs.court, cs.actkind) AS prev_court_acts FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court AND cs.actkind = ra.actkind JOIN legalact_people lp ON ra.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 1 WHERE ra.num_people >= 1 AND ra.num_links > 2 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber ORDER BY activity_rank, cs.court, cs.actkind;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS court_year_rank, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, AVG(ra.fix_count) AS avg_fixes, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 70 AND ra.people_count > 36 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2015' AND '2015' THEN lap.actid ELSE NULL END) AS recent_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT ra.id, ra.actnumber, ra.startdate, ra.legaldate, ra.court, ra.judge, ra.people_count, ra.fix_count, ra.linked_acts_count, ra.court_year_rank, ra.avg_people_per_court_year, ra.cumulative_people_court, cm.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cm.total_people AS court_total_people, cm.avg_fixes AS court_avg_fixes, cm.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked_acts, cm.median_people AS court_median_people, pa.acts_involved, pa.recent_acts, pa.overall_rank, pa.court_rank, CASE WHEN ra.people_count > cm.median_people * 1.51 THEN 'HIGH_PEOPLE' WHEN ra.fix_count > cm.avg_fixes * 2.62 THEN 'HIGH_FIXES' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS complexity_category FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_metrics cm ON ra.court = cm.court AND ra.actyear = cm.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ra.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON lap2.peopleid = pa.personid WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 7 AND ra.people_count >= 20 ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people_court DESC, ra.court_year_rank, pa.overall_rank LIMIT 484;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 22769.03) AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN 32408.86 AND 25999.26 AND l.legaldate >= '1900-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > 8544.11 OR l.outnumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court), (l.actyear), (l.actkind), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 871988.85 AND (GROUPING(l.court) = 0 OR GROUPING(l.actyear) = 0) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 842.83 AND l.outnumber < 14.87 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0.05 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_actnumber_in_court FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > 594.65 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2007.34 AND 2012.56 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29.93 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 5.55 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_by_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS legaldate_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1)) AS jury_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_after_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND l.actyear IN (SELECT actyear FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '1990' GROUP BY actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 944) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 3 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.yearhighercourt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_court_cases FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 29 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) > 6.32 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 732.34 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = l.court AND actyear = 2020.53) ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_related_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS total_contributors, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS judge_act_recency_rank, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 167.58 AND l.outnumber BETWEEN 227.09 AND 233.54 AND l.yearhighercourt >= 2018.94 AND l.casenumber < 706.92 AND l.actyear = 2012.79 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 88.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) < 15.03 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY DATE_TRUNC('month', la.legaldate) RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_outnumber_per_judge_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND p.jury > 6 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.legaldate, la.id, la.actnumber, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 39 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_month;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_actyear_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 906.48 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2001.78 AND 2002.12 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20.35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 11.58 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la1.actnumber) AS median_actnumber_la1, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber_la2, SUM(la1.outnumber) AS sum_outnumber_la1, AVG(la2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber_la2, MAX(la1.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_la1, MIN(la2.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt_la2, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS people_names FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON (lp1.peopleid = p.personid OR lp2.peopleid = p.personid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON (la1.id = sf.actid OR la2.id = sf.actid) WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2005-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '100' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 45 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) < '0' ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, sum_outnumber_la1 DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actnumber > '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_actnumber_count, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate, MIN(l.legaldate) AS earliest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS motivated_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, p.court), (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 464979 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 360 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court LIKE 'A' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = l.actlink AND l2.actnumber > '1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 32 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 3 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 0 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 366.78 AND p.jury > 9.75 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 24.13 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_30day_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 855.67 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AND p.jury > 8.37 AND la2.court = la.court AND la3.court = la.court GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18.72 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS recent_acts_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') OR (la.senddate IS NULL AND la.status = 'pending') ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND la.court IN ('Supreme Court', 'Appeals Court', 'District Court') AND (la.casekind = 'civil' OR la.actkind = 'judgment') AND NOT (la.resultofappeal = 'dismissed' AND la.highcourt = 'Federal') AND p.jury > 3 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 25 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, recent_acts_by_court ASC;
