SELECT la1.actnumber AS act_num1, la2.actnumber AS act_num2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.startdate AS start_date1, la2.startdate AS start_date2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS scrape_fix_count1, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS scrape_fix_count2, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_actnumber_court2, MAX(la1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS max_actyear_per_court1 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND la2.actyear < '2000' AND la1.court = 'Supreme Court' AND p1.jury > 3 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la2.actnumber, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.startdate, la2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 99 AND COUNT(sf1.actid) >= 29 ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, la2.startdate DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 26;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 28 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < '1000' INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber > '1' AND la4.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 7 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) < '1000' ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.91 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 6 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) < 3.03 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY l.court, court_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > '500' AND l2.startdate <= '2010-01-01' ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 10 OFFSET 5 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) >= 15 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.status IS NOT NULL) > '10' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) > 13 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 48 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_court_actkind, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 5) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 19 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS total_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.actkind) AS max_casenumber_by_year_kind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.actyear IN ('2000', '2000', '2000') AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = la.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate < la.startdate ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC, la.startdate;

WITH act_hierarchy AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actnumber AS linked_act_number, l2.legaldate AS linked_legal_date, l2.motivedate AS linked_motive_date, CASE WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate > 164 THEN 'LONG_DELAY' WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate < 7 THEN 'SHORT_DELAY' ELSE 'NORMAL_DELAY' END AS processing_delay_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) AS years_between_acts FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2011-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2011' ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS jury_members_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS involved_people_names FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON ah.linked_act_id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), scrape_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(sf.fix_description, 50), ' | ') AS fix_previews FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON ah.linked_act_id = sf.actid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.*, pa.total_people_involved, pa.jury_members_count, pa.involved_people_names, sa.fix_count, sa.unique_contributors, sa.fix_previews, AVG(ah.years_between_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court) AS avg_years_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.processing_delay_category, ah.root_court) AS delay_count_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court ORDER BY ah.years_between_acts DESC) AS years_rank_in_court FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON ah.root_act_id = pa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = pa.linked_act_id LEFT JOIN scrape_analysis sa ON ah.root_act_id = sa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = sa.linked_act_id ) SELECT root_court, processing_delay_category, COUNT(*) AS total_linkages, AVG(years_between_acts) AS avg_years_between, MAX(years_between_acts) AS max_years_between, SUM(total_people_involved) AS total_people_across_links, AVG(jury_members_count) AS avg_jury_per_link, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(unique_contributors) AS avg_contributors_per_link, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(involved_people_names, 30), '; ') AS sample_people FROM window_analysis WHERE years_between_acts > 8 AND total_people_involved >= 2 AND fix_count <= 11 GROUP BY root_court, processing_delay_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 73 AND AVG(years_between_acts) > 1.8 ORDER BY total_linkages DESC, avg_years_between DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 18 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%' AND l.actkind LIKE '%' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 95.63 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_legaldate_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt), (l.court, l.actkind), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(COALESCE(sq2.avg_people_per_act, 0)) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN ( SELECT lp.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY p.court) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 37.03 GROUP BY lp.actid, p.court ) sq2 ON l.id = sq2.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN 2087.75 AND 1929.4 AND l.startdate >= '1900-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 45.42 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, total_actnumber ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate UNION ALL SELECT sf.actid AS legalact_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, COUNT(*) AS people_count, 0 AS recent_act_flag FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 64384) GROUP BY sf.actid ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_motivated_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.55 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_scrapefix_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 455.83 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 30.39 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.actnumber DESC) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.casenumber DESC) AS case_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 30 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 19 ORDER BY l.court, l.startdate DESC, cumulative_people_by_court DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 1 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = ll.actid2 AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 4 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = 8229 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS case_status_avg_people, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS judge_year_max_startdate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.outnumber > '0' OR l.outnumber IS NULL) AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 66277 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 639848 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, l.startdate ASC, l.id ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT lla.actid1 FROM legalact_link lla JOIN legalacts l2 ON lla.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY lla.actid1 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) >= 19 ) AND l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge_court, (SELECT MAX(p.jury) FROM people p WHERE p.personid IN (SELECT lp_inner.peopleid FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.actid = l.id) AND p.court = l.court) AS max_jury_involved FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3831.72 AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 1.29)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 7.78 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 435.87 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14.67 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 7 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 12;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(l2.actnumber) AS sum_linked_actnumber FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 957.13 AND l2.actnumber < 1857.76 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 4.12 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l1.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS actyear1, l2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.startdate) AS latest_start1, MAX(l2.startdate) AS latest_start2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 35.61 AND l2.actnumber > 269.47 AND p1.jury > 5.73 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 29.69 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 194.42 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, latest_start1 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) >= 39 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_legal_date;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01') AND la.actnumber > 815.24 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.id = ll1.actid2 AND la2.actyear > 2004.27) AND la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 0.07)) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id, la.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 28.93 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 0.89 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.status, la.resultofappeal, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, SUM(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.status ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_outnumber_by_judge_status, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt, MIN(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS min_casenumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate IS NOT NULL AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.actkind = la.actkind AND la2.yearhighercourt > '1900' ) ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.status, la.resultofappeal, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 9 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC, num_fixes ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 0) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 11 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 1 = 1) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 837 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court, start_quarter;

SELECT la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_act_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 66 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 651 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 13 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = 1155 ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 48 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 84 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actyear >= 2017.6 AND la.actkind IS NOT NULL AND (la.judge LIKE '%Judge%' OR la.judge IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 19.14 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 85 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 571.25 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0.02 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear = '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 50 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 1 ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON lal.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 930.8 AND (la.casenumber < 5.51 OR la.casenumber IS NULL) AND p.jury = 0.54 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) >= 5.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3.65 ORDER BY linked_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank_in_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS acts_per_judge_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpe2 ON la2.id = lpe2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lpe2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 626.64 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 29.57 ORDER BY cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 88.71 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25.4 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 433.25 AND la.outnumber < 978.12 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2007.98 AND 2016.55 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casekind, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 97.6 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 423.93 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.0 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid > 6244) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 43 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_table_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 429.26 AND la.outnumber < 164.69 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 31.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 33.44 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 193.61 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_active_by_court_kind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, CASE WHEN la.legaldate IS NOT NULL AND la.startdate IS NOT NULL AND la.legaldate > la.startdate THEN 'Legal After Start' WHEN la.legaldate IS NOT NULL AND la.startdate IS NOT NULL AND la.legaldate = la.startdate THEN 'Same Date' WHEN la.legaldate IS NOT NULL AND la.startdate IS NOT NULL AND la.legaldate < la.startdate THEN 'Legal Before Start' ELSE 'Date Missing' END AS date_relationship_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 THEN 'High People Involvement' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) BETWEEN 2 AND 5 THEN 'Medium People Involvement' ELSE 'Low People Involvement' END AS people_involvement_level FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 45 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN la.actnumber ELSE 0 END) AS sum_actnumber_after_year, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_yearhighercourt, MAX(CASE WHEN la.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN la.motivedate ELSE la.startdate END) AS latest_motive_or_start_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ') AS all_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 10 AND MAX(la.yearhighercourt) BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.judge AS judge1, la2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS acts_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS acts_count_year2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actnumber > la2.actnumber THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_number_greater_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year2, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_start_year1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_start_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fixes_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fixes_count_year2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.actkind, ', ') AS actkinds_year1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.actkind, ', ') AS actkinds_year2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.judge = la2.judge AND la1.actyear < la2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 925.75 AND la2.actnumber < 800.12 GROUP BY la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court, la1.judge, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 92.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 30.17 AND AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) < AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear DESC, acts_number_greater_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.judge AS judge1, la2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS acts_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS acts_count_year2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actnumber > la2.actnumber THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_number_greater_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year2, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_start_year1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_start_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fixes_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fixes_count_year2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds_year1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds_year2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.judge = la2.judge AND la1.actyear < la2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 266.95 AND la2.actnumber < 336.57 GROUP BY la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court, la1.judge, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 37.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 16.26 AND AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) < AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear DESC, acts_number_greater_count DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 21 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casenumber > '10' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_case_number_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts la ON cjs.court = la.court AND cjs.judge = la.judge LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt > '2000' GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number ), people_network AS ( SELECT lla.court, lla.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS network_size, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_experience, MAX(lla.avg_linked_act_number) AS max_linked_act_num, SUM(lla.high_case_number_count) AS total_high_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.court != lla.court THEN p.personid END) AS external_court_connections FROM linked_act_analysis lla JOIN legalacts l ON lla.court = l.court AND lla.judge = l.judge JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY lla.court, lla.judge ) SELECT pn.court, pn.judge, pn.network_size, pn.avg_jury_experience, pn.max_linked_act_num, pn.total_high_cases, pn.external_court_connections, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, cjs.granted_appeals, lla.linked_acts_count, lla.avg_linked_act_number, lla.high_case_number_count, lla.unique_contributors, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC) AS network_rank, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pn.court ORDER BY pn.avg_jury_experience DESC) AS court_jury_rank FROM people_network pn JOIN court_judge_stats cjs ON pn.court = cjs.court AND pn.judge = cjs.judge JOIN linked_act_analysis lla ON pn.court = lla.court AND pn.judge = lla.judge WHERE pn.network_size > 841 AND pn.total_high_cases >= 33 ORDER BY pn.network_size DESC, pn.total_high_cases DESC LIMIT 51;

SELECT court_stats.court, court_stats.total_acts, court_stats.avg_people_per_act, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC) as court_rank FROM ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) as total_acts, AVG(people_count.people_cnt) as avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts la JOIN ( SELECT lap.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) as people_cnt FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT lal.actid1 FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid2 > 4187 ) GROUP BY lap.actid ) people_count ON la.id = people_count.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND la.legaldate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 47 ) court_stats ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC;

SELECT court_stats.court, court_stats.total_acts, court_stats.avg_people_per_act, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC) as court_rank FROM ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) as total_acts, AVG(people_count.people_cnt) as avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts la JOIN ( SELECT lap.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) as people_cnt FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT lal.actid1 FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid2 > 5672 ) GROUP BY lap.actid ) people_count ON la.id = people_count.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND la.legaldate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 12 ) court_stats ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 6 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND sf.actid IS NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) < 12 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dated_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_start, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_send, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.actkind, ', ') AS act_kinds, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name), (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 26 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3073.86 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.83 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear >= '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = ll1.actid2 AND l2.actyear < '1900')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court LIKE 'A' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = l.actlink AND l2.actnumber > '1' LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0 ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 20 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_actkind, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 20 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 2 OR COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN
