SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.court = 'Supreme Court' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS supreme_court_acts_per_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 727.27 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ORDER BY ll.actid2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 77.84 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0.43 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_fixes, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear > '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 10 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 5167 ) AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 45 ORDER BY num_linked_acts DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 300.27 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0.53 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, lp.peopleid, lp.actid, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, s.actid AS scrape_actid, s.fix_description, s.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT s.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS judge_act_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = 2009 AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 76 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber > '0' AND l.casenumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, lp.peopleid, lp.actid, ll.actid1, ll.actid2, s.actid, s.fix_description, s.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC, total_actnumber ASC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.court = 'Αρείου Πάγου' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 22 ORDER BY l1.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS acts_count_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS acts_count_court2, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_court2, SUM(CASE WHEN lp1.peopleid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_people_linked_court1, SUM(CASE WHEN lp2.peopleid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_people_linked_court2, MAX(l1.senddate) AS latest_senddate_court1, MAX(l2.senddate) AS latest_senddate_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 934.88 AND l2.actnumber > 715.8 GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 187.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 194.33 ORDER BY acts_count_court1 DESC, acts_count_court2 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date_in_hierarchy FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 30 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 0 = 1) GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 96 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.startdate IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 21 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 24 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_sample FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 9) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 98 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_years_duration FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND (la.motivedate IS NULL OR la.motivedate >= '2010-01-01') GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 14.2 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.fix_description) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 405 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_per_court_casekind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE legaldate < la.legaldate AND court = la.court)) AS linked_prior_acts_count, (SELECT SUM(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS scrapefix_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.outnumber, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, rolling_30day_people DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.startdate) AS month_start, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear = '2000' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, DATE_TRUNC('month', la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 52 ORDER BY act_count DESC, month_start;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actyear, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN la.actnumber ELSE 0 END) AS granted_actnumber_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 438.15) AS avg_actnumber_above_threshold, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_send_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.contributor, ', ') AS contributors_list FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN 2007.76 AND 2000.59 AND la.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actyear, la.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 946.45 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 354.7 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON lal2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 787.65 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 4.06) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 24.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 1.38 ORDER BY la.court, recency_rank, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 6233.95 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 64.74 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS active_cases_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS num_links_as_source, (SELECT AVG(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid > la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS avg_scrapefix_id_higher, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll1.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 748.98 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2022.71 AND 2007.75 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 46.72 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY la.court, cumulative_people_by_court DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subsequent_acts_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '1') AND la.casenumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 21 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.casenumber) AS min_casenumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ') AS fix_descriptions, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber BETWEEN '0' AND '10' AND la.yearhighercourt >= '1900' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 76 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 240.62 AND SUM(la.actnumber) BETWEEN 3613 AND 7798 ORDER BY total_people DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_actnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND la.actyear >= '2010' AND (la.status = 'Active' OR la.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 8 AND SUM(la.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 197.92 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 37.09 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 73.82 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal NOT IN ('GRANTED', 'DENIED') OR la.resultofappeal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS latest_startdate_per_court_casekind, MIN(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS earliest_legaldate_per_court_casekind, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS count_per_court_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 261.81 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 564.5 AND 350.08 AND la.actyear >= 2008.45 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 30.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 2.77 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' THEN la.yearhighercourt ELSE 0 END) AS recent_higher_court_year_sum, AVG(CASE WHEN la.outnumber IS NOT NULL THEN la.outnumber::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(CASE WHEN la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' THEN la.senddate ELSE NULL END) AS latest_senddate_after_threshold, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.motivedate IS NOT NULL) AS acts_with_motivation_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC) AS court_actyear_dense_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 11 AND AVG(CASE WHEN la.outnumber IS NOT NULL THEN la.outnumber::numeric ELSE NULL END) BETWEEN 72.51 AND 172.17 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC LIMIT 2535;

AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT lap2.actid FROM legalact_people NULL AND LENGTH(sf2.fix_description) > 6325 ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 10 SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' AND la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Supreme Court' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 20;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS avg_act_per_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.actyear > '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p1.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 88 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court ORDER BY la3.legaldate) AS avg_act_per_court FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.actyear < '1990' AND la3.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND p2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.legaldate HAVING SUM(sf2.actid) < 141170 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS court_total_involved, MAX(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.judge) AS max_act_per_judge_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p1.name, ', ' ORDER BY p1.name) AS people_names, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 39 INTERSECT SELECT la2.id AS act_id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS court_total_involved, MAX(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.judge) AS max_act_per_judge_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p2.name, ', ' ORDER BY p2.name) AS people_names, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la3.motivedate <= '1990-01-01' AND la2.actyear < '1900' GROUP BY la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(sf2.actid) < 12 ORDER BY act_id;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 934 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_members, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM court_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts l ON ca.court = l.court AND ca.actyear = l.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0 ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC LIMIT 460;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ) AS total_people_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.casenumber ) AS avg_actnumber_per_case FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_links, SUM(ra.has_fix) AS fixed_acts_count, AVG(ra.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_links_per_act, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people_count, RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY SUM(ra.people_count) DESC ) AS people_rank FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 77 AND ra.total_people_per_court_year > 354 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 44 AND AVG(ra.avg_actnumber_per_case) > 92.47 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.fixed_acts_count, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.max_links_per_act, ca.median_people_count, ca.people_rank, (ca.total_people * 1.0 / ca.total_acts) AS people_per_act_ratio, (ca.fixed_acts_count * 1.0 / ca.total_acts) AS fix_ratio, LAG(ca.total_acts, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actkind ORDER BY ca.actyear ) AS prev_year_acts, LEAD(ca.total_people, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actkind ORDER BY ca.actyear ) AS next_year_people FROM complex_aggregates ca WHERE ca.people_rank <= 9 ORDER BY ca.people_rank, ca.court, ca.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = l.actyear AND court = l.court)) AS total_people_links FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 901 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear < '1990' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS older_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 10 ORDER BY startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_by_judge_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 558.02 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 13.24 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court_year DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS max_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 461.09 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 10.08 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_fixes DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > 2020.97)) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 40.38 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34.97 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6896.08 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.82 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 4 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate)) AS avg_year_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear > '1990' AND l2.actyear < '1990' AND l1.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT peopleid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY peopleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT actid) > 71 ) ) GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 24 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate)) BETWEEN -39.07 AND -29.75 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, avg_year_diff ASC;

SELECT l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt, l1.actyear, l1.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, SUM(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.highcourt, l1.actyear) AS highcourt_year_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l1.id) AS people_count, (SELECT MAX(sf.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l1.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l1.id OR ll.actid2 = l1.id) AS total_link_count, p.name AS primary_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) AS distinct_people_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON (l1.id = ll.actid1 OR l1.id = ll.actid2) JOIN legalacts l2 ON ((ll.actid1 = l2.id AND ll.actid1 != l1.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND ll.actid2 != l1.id)) JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l1.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid AND p2.court = l1.court WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 604.69 AND l1.actyear BETWEEN 2005.47 AND 2001.29 AND (l1.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l1.highcourt = 'High Court') GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt, l1.actyear, l1.actnumber, l1.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 7.1 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 381.28 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, court_actkind_total DESC LIMIT 758.25;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_acts_per_court_pair, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS max_actnumber_per_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, p.name, p.court, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 44 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_acts_per_court_pair, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS max_actnumber_per_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, p.name, p.court, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) <= 37 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 48 ORDER BY act_id1 DESC, act_id2 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate1, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank, LAG(l1.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.legaldate) AS prev_actnumber1 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 6257.05 AND l2.actnumber > 5895.14 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 260.1 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 27570.24 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate1 DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '1' AND (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > 31.04 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, avg_outnumber DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear) AS avg_year_gap, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) = 6 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 234 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '0' OR la.actnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 35 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 130.72 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2009.64 AND 2005.12 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 20.3 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_years_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 11 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, avg_years_duration ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_indicator, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_yearhighercourt_by_court_actkind, MAX(CASE WHEN la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' THEN la.motivedate ELSE NULL END) AS max_motivedate_filtered, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS jury_member_names, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN la.id ELSE NULL END) AS accepted_appeals_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NOT NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 15 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate DESC LIMIT 1979;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS active_status_count_per_group FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la2.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lap2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 711.03 AND p.jury = 0.93 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 16.95 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') >= 44.26 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_acts_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '1900' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_after_year, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_act_number, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.yearhighercourt) AS percentile_75_yearhighercourt, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_90_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 723 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 137 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 384.6 AND l.yearhighercourt >= 2002.03 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)), (l.court, l.actkind), (l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 359.8 ORDER BY l.court, l.actkind, legal_year DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) > 12 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY total_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge_court, (SELECT MAX(p.jury) FROM people p WHERE p.personid IN (SELECT lp_inner.peopleid FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.actid = l.id) AND p.court = l.court) AS max_jury_involved FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3780.56 AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 6.21)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 13.45 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS num_links, MAX(la.legaldate) AS max_legaldate, MIN(la.motivedate) AS min_motivedate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 4 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '10' ORDER BY num_people DESC, sum_actnumber ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 94 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) = 8 GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 54 ORDER BY act_count DESC, start_year;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_kind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id) AS recency_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (la.highcourt IS NOT NULL OR la.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 6 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;
