SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47 ORDER BY people_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 516.8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27.27 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, 0 AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_outnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_motivedate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON l.court = p.court WHERE l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber < 605.18 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber, l.motivedate, l.senddate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) BETWEEN 11.98 AND 7.21 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' OR l.startdate >= '2000-01-01') AND l.casenumber > '1' AND NOT (l.status = '{{p5}}' AND l.actkind = '{{p6}}') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 941.88 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.78 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC, link_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.actyear = l.actyear AND l3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY l3.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 967 ) AND p.jury > 7 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 29088) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_linked_avg, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_max_startdate, MIN(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS highcourt_year_min_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.actnumber AS actnumber1, l2.actnumber AS actnumber2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_diff FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actnumber > 14872.17 AND l2.actnumber > 27379.7 AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber, l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 86.34 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, avg_actnumber_diff;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 20;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 7 INTERSECT SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l2.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) < 16;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 8 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 59 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_startdate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 336 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 28 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < '0' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 50 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS p75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 64 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 681 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_3year_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 97 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, la.id ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_3year_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind, la.highcourt ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_rolling_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 649.41 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 99.01 AND 85.59 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18.21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 2.61 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 790.44 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 8.64 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS total_people_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS row_num_by_year_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 22 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, rank_by_linked_acts;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor = 'A') AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'A' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la1.actnumber) AS median_actnumber_la1, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber_la2, SUM(la1.outnumber) AS sum_outnumber_la1, AVG(la2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber_la2, MAX(la1.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_la1, MIN(la2.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt_la2, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS people_names FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON (lp1.peopleid = p.personid OR lp2.peopleid = p.personid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON (la1.id = sf.actid OR la2.id = sf.actid) WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2005-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '100' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 39 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) < '0' ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, sum_outnumber_la1 DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_year_links, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber2, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate1, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate2, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON (lp1.peopleid = p.personid OR lp2.peopleid = p.personid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON (la1.id = sf.actid OR la2.id = sf.actid) WHERE la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 19 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, same_year_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.startdate, l.outnumber, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 33 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_people_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '1990-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 662.84 AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.status = 'Final') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38.11 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 7.88 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 1 AND p.court = l.court ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 11 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 70 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 4 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 30 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.casenumber) AS min_casenumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 103.6 AND la.outnumber < 722.66 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2009.44 AND 2010.37 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND SUM(la.actnumber) > 8979.14 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 155.87 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 280.69 AND l.yearhighercourt < 1903.88 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14.45 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS recent_acts_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_outnumber_by_judge_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_motivedate_in_court, MIN(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.status) AS earliest_senddate_by_judge_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > '0' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15 AND AVG(l.outnumber) > '0' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY num_people DESC, num_fixes DESC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 2 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 11;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 73 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 111.59 AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR la.highcourt IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 83.94 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_act_number DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_since_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.casenumber > 335.13 THEN la.id END) AS high_case_number_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN 2021.73 AND 2001.0 AND la.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (la.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 26.06 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5.16 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS avg_active_actnumber, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 772.28 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2012.81 AND 2014.46 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 45.19 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 62.22 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, rolling_30day_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_acts) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS max_acts FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la2.judge) sub) AS max_judge_acts_in_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la_linked ON ll.actid2 = la_linked.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 84 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = la.id) >= 28 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 12 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS court_legaldate_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear > '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.judge IS NOT NULL) AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber AS actnumber1, la2.actnumber AS actnumber2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS actyear1, la2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fix_count2, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_actnumber2, MAX(la1.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt1, MIN(la2.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 7421.75 AND la2.actnumber < 16405.59 AND la1.yearhighercourt >= 1960.43 AND la2.yearhighercourt <= 2032.19 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la2.actnumber, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.legaldate, la2.legaldate, la1.yearhighercourt, la2.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 140.37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 425.3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 90.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) <= 59.98 ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear ASC, unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 ASC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '500' ORDER BY num_people DESC, sum_actnumbers ASC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 21615) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 189.25 AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 677.61 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 57 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 779 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, 0 AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 1 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_status_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_after_year, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990') AS avg_actnumber_in_period FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 35 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 39 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 25 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8894.39 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.79 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 4 OR COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_senddate_by_court_judge, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8401.18 AND l.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.senddate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16.03 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, AVG(la.actid2) AS avg_linked_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2625.19 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.84 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_scrapefix_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_people_per_act_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 791.4 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 77.35 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, cumulative_scrapefix_by_court DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear, l.typeofdocument) AS max_legaldate_by_year_doctype, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 4784.32 AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt < 2001.0) AND (l.outnumber IS NULL OR l.outnumber >= 940.77) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 3.45 AND (COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) = 0 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 7.47) ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 222.58 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 990.77 AND 911.24 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 13.01 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 41 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l.id AND lp.peopleid > 44) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC LIMIT 46;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 11 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 154.98 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.06 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge FROM legalacts l WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE lp.actid = l.id AND p.jury = 1 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.actnumber DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 448.14 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2015.47 AND 2000.28 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 20.08 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 12665)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 35 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp_outer ON l.id = lp_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 6 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 216.16 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.05 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_people_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 7 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_latest_start FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') OR (l.senddate IS NOT NULL AND l.senddate < '2000-01-01') ) AND ( (l.actnumber > 523.32 AND l.actyear = 2009.38) OR (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.status IN ('Final', 'Appealed')) OR (l.judge IS NOT NULL AND l.casekind <> 'Civil') ) AND NOT ( l.resultofappeal = 'Dismissed' OR (l.highcourt IS NULL AND l.yearhighercourt < 2010.89) ) AND p.jury > 5.8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 70.75 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 463.25 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2001-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber < '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '5' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 957.13 AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8.45 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l1.startdate DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actyear AS act_year, l1.court AS court_name, l1.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS num_people_in_act, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY num_people_in_act DESC, act_year ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 5 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 5) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 443 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 240 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS p75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber > '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 948 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 392 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_date) FROM (SELECT MAX(sf.actid) AS max_id, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_date FROM legalacts la2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear GROUP BY la2.court, la2.actyear) sub) AS max_legaldate_in_court_year, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 942.18 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2006.04 AND 2000.05 AND (p.court = la.court OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 28.5 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 4930.25 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_highcourt_actkind, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 2644.74 AND la.casenumber > 7682.44 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 18.78 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND ( la.id IN ( SELECT lal_inner.actid1 FROM legalact_link lal_inner WHERE lal_inner.actid2 IN ( SELECT la_inner.id FROM legalacts la_inner WHERE la_inner.court = la.court AND la_inner.actyear = la.actyear AND la_inner.actnumber > '1' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT lp_inner.actid FROM legalact_people lp_inner WHERE lp_inner.peopleid IN ( SELECT p_inner.personid FROM people p_inner WHERE p_inner.jury > 6 AND p_inner.court = la.court ) ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 36 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subsequent_acts_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_popularity_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS court_legaldate_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear > '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.judge IS NOT NULL) AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_actnumber, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber_by_kind, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_outnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 698.32 AND la.outnumber < 374.7 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 2006.54 AND la.casenumber <= 7978.87 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 2.77 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30d, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_fixes_10row FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 995.05 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 1.57 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS total_fix_actid_sum FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.actyear > '2000' AND la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 37 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS total_fix_actid_sum FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la2.actyear < '2000' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING SUM(sf2.actid) < 26398 ORDER BY actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;
