SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS court_total_involved, MAX(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.judge) AS max_act_per_judge_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p1.name, ', ' ORDER BY p1.name) AS people_names, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 31 INTERSECT SELECT la2.id AS act_id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS court_total_involved, MAX(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.judge) AS max_act_per_judge_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p2.name, ', ' ORDER BY p2.name) AS people_names, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la3.motivedate <= '1990-01-01' AND la2.actyear < '1900' GROUP BY la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(sf2.actid) < 15 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS act_year1, la2.actyear AS act_year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la1.actnumber) AS median_actnumber1, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber2, AVG(la1.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber1, AVG(la2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber2, MIN(la1.startdate) AS earliest_startdate1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_startdate2, COUNT(sf1.actid) AS scrapefix_count1, COUNT(sf2.actid) AS scrapefix_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals1, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 346.02 AND la2.actnumber < 399.01 AND la1.outnumber >= 28.51 AND la2.outnumber <= 14.98 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 46.59 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 27.33 AND AVG(la1.outnumber) >= 38.23 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) <= 16.26 ORDER BY unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 ASC;

WITH court_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber < '50' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.act_count, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_act_number, la.linked_acts_count, la.fixed_acts_count, la.max_act_number, (ca.act_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.unique_people, 0)) AS acts_per_person FROM court_acts ca FULL OUTER JOIN linked_acts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear WHERE (ca.act_count > 207 OR la.linked_acts_count > 98) AND (ca.avg_act_number < '10' OR la.max_act_number > '100') ORDER BY ca.actyear DESC, ca.act_count DESC;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT la.judge) AS unique_judges, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 55 ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT p.court, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_people, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 17 ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT la1.court, la1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_links, AVG(la2.actnumber - la1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.casekind = la2.casekind THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_casekind_links, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.highcourt, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_judges, ca.avg_act_number, ca.final_acts, ca.latest_legal_date, ca.court_rank, NULL::integer AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'court_aggregates' AS source_type FROM court_aggregates ca WHERE ca.court_rank <= 2 UNION ALL SELECT pa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, NULL::smallint AS actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, pa.acts_involved, pa.total_people, pa.avg_act_number_people, pa.latest_send_date, pa.granted_appeals, 'people_aggregates' AS source_type FROM people_aggregates pa UNION ALL SELECT laa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, laa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, laa.total_links AS acts_involved, NULL::integer AS total_people, laa.avg_act_number_diff AS avg_act_number_people, laa.max_linked_legal_date AS latest_send_date, laa.same_casekind_links AS granted_appeals, 'linked_acts' AS source_type FROM linked_acts_analysis laa WHERE laa.total_links > 15 UNION ALL SELECT sa.court, NULL::character varying AS highcourt, sa.actyear, NULL::bigint AS total_acts, NULL::bigint AS unique_judges, NULL::numeric AS avg_act_number, NULL::bigint AS final_acts, NULL::date AS latest_legal_date, NULL::bigint AS court_rank, sa.total_fixes AS acts_involved, sa.unique_contributors AS total_people, sa.avg_fix_length AS avg_act_number_people, NULL::date AS latest_send_date, NULL::integer AS granted_appeals, 'scrapefix_analysis' AS source_type FROM scrapefix_analysis sa WHERE sa.total_fixes >= 7 ORDER BY court, source_type, actyear DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actnumber <= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 1 UNION ALL SELECT 'linked' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count >= 0 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actyear > '1990' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.highcourt IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(l.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_by_court, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_dense_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 10 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_by_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 112.0 AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.highcourt LIKE '%High%') AND l.typeofdocument ~ '^Judgment' AND l.status IS NOT NULL AND p.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 36.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 6.89 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_senddate_by_court_judge, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 7231.61 AND l.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.senddate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 33.57 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_case, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 371.43 AND (l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 4.6 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 954.14 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.13 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE lp.actid IS NULL AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.actnumber DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = '' AND jury > 0 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Active') AS active_status_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND p2.jury > 0 ) AND l.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(*) > 6) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS acts_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS acts_court2, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court1, SUM(l2.outnumber) AS total_outnumber_court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_court2, MAX(sf1.fix_description) AS latest_fix_court1, MIN(p2.jury) AS min_jury_court2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.casenumber = l2.casenumber AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 76.84 AND l2.outnumber < 383.82 AND p1.jury > 1.64 GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 86.05 AND SUM(l2.outnumber) < 6296.29 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) BETWEEN 460.14 AND 612.17 ORDER BY year DESC, total_outnumber_court2 ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS actyear1, l2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.startdate) AS latest_start1, MAX(l2.startdate) AS latest_start2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 996.42 AND l2.actnumber > 593.55 AND p1.jury > 9.79 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 38.71 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 728.1 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, latest_start1 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_root, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ') AS linked_courts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_fixes_in_links, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l2.actnumber) AS median_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS total_jury_in_linked_people, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS total_acts_per_court_window FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id AND l2.actyear >= '1900' LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = l2.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor LIKE 'A' WHERE l1.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND l1.court IN ('A', 'A') AND l1.status = 'A' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 345 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 97 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_year ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER(PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear > '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 2 ) ) ) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_highercourt_by_highcourt_actkind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_act_sequence FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casenumber, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 33 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) > '0' ORDER BY link_rank, court_act_sequence;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 187 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS actkind_list, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'CourtA' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 46 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN la.actnumber END) AS avg_final_act_number, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 341 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, (SELECT SUM(sf2.actid) FROM legalact_link lal JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON lal.actid2 = sf2.actid WHERE lal.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_fix_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf_outer ON la.id = sf_outer.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber < '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY rolling_30day_people DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_recent_acts_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '1') AND la.court IN (SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(personid) > 89) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 2 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_indicator, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_yearhighercourt_by_court_actkind, MAX(CASE WHEN la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' THEN la.motivedate ELSE NULL END) AS max_motivedate_filtered, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS jury_member_names, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN la.id ELSE NULL END) AS accepted_appeals_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NOT NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 7 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate DESC LIMIT 9975;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_status, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind) AS max_legaldate_by_judge_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 98.19 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2003.78 AND 2019.13 AND la.outnumber < 12.13 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 53.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 12.77 ORDER BY total_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)) AS avg_years_between_start_legal, MAX(la.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 921 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 606 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC LIMIT 5294;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_scrapefix_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND la.status IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury = 0 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 67 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actlink) AS avg_actlink FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND p1.jury = 46 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 18 AND SUM(sf1.actid) < 822779 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actlink) AS avg_actlink FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear < '2000' AND p2.jury = 89 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) < 27 AND SUM(sf2.actid) > 972194 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND p1.jury > 31 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < '500' AND p2.jury < 3 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.id HAVING SUM(sf2.actid) < 51772 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, actyear;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 16 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < '1000' INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber > '1' AND la4.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 8 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) < '1000' ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.casenumber DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS actkind_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 100 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY ra.num_people DESC, ra.num_related_acts DESC ) AS complexity_rank, LAG(ra.casenumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS prev_case_number, LEAD(ra.startdate) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actkind, ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS next_start_date FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.court_rank <= 79 AND ra.num_people >= 19 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind, COUNT(*) AS high_complexity_acts, SUM(ca.num_people) AS total_people_involved, SUM(ca.num_related_acts) AS total_related_acts, AVG(ca.complexity_rank) AS avg_complexity, MAX(ca.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.num_people) AS median_people FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.complexity_rank <= 252 AND ca.total_acts > 132 GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) >= 48 AND SUM(ca.num_people) > 49 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, high_complexity_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT l.judge) AS distinct_judges, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.judge) > 42 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 65 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 77 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '0' OR l.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 955 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_startdate, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 6 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id LIMIT 1 OFFSET 479 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_court_judge FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 10 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_motivedate DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_legaldate_by_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 439.57 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 881.75 AND 262.37 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 1.08 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_fixes DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, court_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 101 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate)) AS avg_year_diff, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear > '1990' AND l2.actyear < '1990' AND l1.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT peopleid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY peopleid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT actid) > 38 ) ) GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 12 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate)) BETWEEN 0.22 AND 33.59 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, avg_year_diff ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER(PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear > '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 5 ) ) ) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 63 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) AS people_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 8 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN la.actnumber END) AS avg_final_act_number, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 62 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS active_cases_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 944.45 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12.95 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 391.77 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(sub.people_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp_inner.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalact_people lp_inner GROUP BY lp_inner.actid) sub WHERE people_count > 41.03) ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 339.85 AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = 2011.22 ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.83 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_people_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = la.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate > '2020-01-01')) AS count_linked_future_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 117.87 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 800.75 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS distinct_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), people_activity AS ( SELECT lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT l.actyear) AS activity_years, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_num_participated, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_participation, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_participation FROM legalact_people lp JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY lp.peopleid, p.name, p.court ), act_link_network AS ( SELECT l1.id AS source_act, l2.id AS target_act, l1.court AS source_court, l2.court AS target_court, l1.legaldate AS source_date, l2.legaldate AS target_date, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link ll JOIN legalacts l1 ON ll.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.legaldate, l2.legaldate, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrapefix_analysis AS ( SELECT s.actid, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(s.fix_description) AS fix_count, LENGTH(s.fix_description) AS fix_length, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(s.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid, l.court, l.judge ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_acts, cjs.distinct_years, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.granted_appeals, pa.involved_acts, pa.activity_years, pa.avg_act_num_participated, aln.source_act, aln.target_act, aln.source_court, aln.target_court, aln.act_number_diff, aln.common_people_count, sf.fix_count, sf.fix_length, sf.unique_contributors, sf.avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank, LAG(cjs.total_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY cjs.court ORDER BY cjs.latest_legal_date) AS prev_total_acts, LEAD(pa.involved_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY pa.court ORDER BY pa.last_participation) AS next_involved_acts FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN people_activity pa ON cjs.court = pa.court AND cjs.judge = pa.name LEFT JOIN act_link_network aln ON cjs.court = aln.source_court LEFT JOIN scrapefix_analysis sf ON cjs.court = sf.court AND cjs.judge = sf.judge WHERE cjs.total_acts > 186 AND pa.involved_acts >= 258 ORDER BY cjs.total_acts DESC, pa.involved_acts DESC, aln.common_people_count DESC LIMIT 224;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 6 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) < 8.94 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid) FROM legalact_people WHERE actid IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_act_sum_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_act_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE ( l.actnumber > '1' OR l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN ( SELECT p2.personid FROM people p2 WHERE p2.jury > 3 ) ) OR l.id IN ( SELECT sf2.actid FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE LENGTH(sf2.fix_description) > 4111 GROUP BY sf2.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 25 ) ) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 13 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '0' ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(sf.actid) AS avg_scraped_act_id FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id LIMIT 55 OFFSET 47 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 1 ORDER BY people_count ASC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 80 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 5) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 19 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 1 = 1) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 525 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court, start_quarter;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, lp.peopleid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > '1') AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '0' AND (la.motivedate IS NULL OR la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, lp.peopleid, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 1 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.casenumber) AS min_casenumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS court_caseyear_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_count_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber BETWEEN '0' AND '51' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = '2000' AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) IN ('1', '1') AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court') GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 86 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, start_year, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber) AS running_total FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.actnumber > '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 18 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, cumulative_people_by_court DESC, recency_rank_in_court_year;

WITH aggregated_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31 ), court_analysis AS ( SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, aa.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS court_total_acts, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC) AS people_rank FROM aggregated_acts aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE la.senddate <= '1990-01-01' ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ca.*, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_in_range FROM court_analysis ca LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON ca.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id GROUP BY ca.id, ca.num_people, ca.num_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.recent_acts_count, ca.court, ca.judge, ca.court_total_acts, ca.people_rank ), people_stats AS ( SELECT la.*, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, MAX(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_jury FROM linked_acts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY la.id, la.num_people, la.num_fixes, la.avg_act_number, la.recent_acts_count, la.court, la.judge, la.court_total_acts, la.people_rank, la.num_linked_acts, la.linked_acts_in_range ) SELECT court, judge, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(num_people) AS total_people_involved, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, MAX(num_linked_acts) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(linked_acts_in_range) AS total_linked_in_range, SUM(recent_acts_count) AS total_recent_acts, AVG(avg_act_number) AS overall_avg_act_number, SUM(has_jury) AS jury_cases_count FROM people_stats WHERE num_fixes > 1 AND linked_acts_in_range >= 91 GROUP BY court, judge HAVING SUM(num_people) > 501 AND COUNT(*) >= 58 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, unique_people_count DESC;
SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND s.actid > 83746 GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > 340.27 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.casekind = l.casekind AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > 1633.45 ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 726.57 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 22.55 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 9 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;
