SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND MAX(l.legaldate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 7805 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 0)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 2 ) GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 3 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, p.name FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND lp.actid IS NULL ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.actnumber DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 100 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) AS year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS acts_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS acts_court2, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_court1, SUM(l2.outnumber) AS total_outnumber_court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_court1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_court2, MAX(sf1.fix_description) AS latest_fix_court1, MIN(p2.jury) AS min_jury_court2, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.casenumber = l2.casenumber AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 258.15 AND l2.outnumber < 974.64 AND p1.jury > 0.31 GROUP BY l1.court, l2.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 41.05 AND SUM(l2.outnumber) < 4299.92 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) BETWEEN 208.28 AND 828.63 ORDER BY year DESC, total_outnumber_court2 ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 23 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 9 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) <= 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 26 ORDER BY act_id1, act_id2;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, l2.legaldate AS linked_legaldate FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l2.actnumber, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(*) > 9 ORDER BY l1.legaldate DESC, l2.legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE ( (la.actyear > '2000' AND la.actnumber < '1') OR (la.court = 'Supreme Court' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015') OR (la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2010-01-01') ) AND la.status IS NOT NULL AND NOT (la.casenumber = '1') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, avg_actnumber_per_court_year ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_act_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT MAX(sf.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.name, la.id, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 62 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 95 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_actnumber_count, AVG(la.casenumber) AS avg_casenumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court, la.actkind), (la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court), (la.actyear), (la.actkind), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 45 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court LIKE '%Court%' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, lp.peopleid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > '1') AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '0' AND (la.motivedate IS NULL OR la.motivedate < '2000-01-01') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, lp.peopleid, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 55 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS total_links, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_actnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la_linked1 ON ll1.actid2 = la_linked1.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la_linked2 ON ll2.actid1 = la_linked2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 387.2 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 2.88) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.actid = la.id AND lp_sub.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = la.court)) > 3.52 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.08 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 1.39 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' OR la.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' ) AND ( la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber < '1' OR la.outnumber = '1' ) AND ( EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.court = la.court AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT lap2.actid FROM legalact_people lap2 JOIN people p2 ON lap2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE p2.jury > 97 GROUP BY lap2.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 44 ) OR la.id NOT IN ( SELECT sf2.actid FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(sf2.fix_description) > 1919 ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 21 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2015' THEN 'RECENT' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2005' AND '2005' THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'OLD' END AS age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la1.actnumber AS act_number1, la1.legaldate AS legal_date1, la1.court AS court1, la2.id AS act_id2, la2.actnumber AS act_number2, la2.legaldate AS legal_date2, la2.court AS court2, p.personid AS person_id, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description AS scrape_fix, sf.contributor AS fix_contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(la1.actnumber + la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_actnumbers, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumbers, MAX(la1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind) AS max_actyear_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '1' AND la1.actyear >= '1990' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.casekind, la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.legaldate, la2.court, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 33 ORDER BY la1.legaldate DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 23 AND SUM(sf.actid) < 93195 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > 2000.23 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_in_group FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= 1909.75 AND l.actyear <= 2010.85 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 52.67 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 43.29 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 20 ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT personid) > 36 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND MAX(l.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > l.yearhighercourt THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS year_diff_count_by_court_casekind, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_judge_status, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 774.01 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 705.9 AND 1537.11 AND l.actyear >= 2008.0 AND l.yearhighercourt <= 2021.15 AND l.outnumber >= 349.49 AND (l.motivedate IS NULL OR l.motivedate >= SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, MAX(l.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_actyear_per_court, p.name, p.jury FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.court LIKE 'Supreme%' AND l.judge LIKE 'J%' AND l.actkind LIKE 'Ruling%' AND l.actnumber > 379.24 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2007.21 AND 2000.94 AND (l.status = 'Active' OR l.resultofappeal = 'Affirmed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 16.28 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 279.61 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 9783 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 ) ) AND p.court = l.court GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury > 9.29 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 0) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.76 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 9842.67 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14.74 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 839.48 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14.93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 51.3 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_act_sum_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_outnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 20.01 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 159.59 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.54 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_root, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ') AS linked_courts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_fixes_in_links, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l2.actnumber) AS median_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS total_jury_in_linked_people, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS total_acts_per_court_window FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id AND l2.actyear >= '1900' LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = l2.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor LIKE 'A' WHERE l1.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' AND l1.court IN ('A', 'A') AND l1.status = 'A' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 901 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 89 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_year ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 0 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 71 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS yearly_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, ', ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people_list, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 2 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '0' OR la.actnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 10 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 5 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_quarter, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) = 3 GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 14 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_avg_actnumber_per_casekind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt ORDER BY la.senddate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '180 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_180day_max_yearhighercourt_per_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 382.34 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2012.07 AND 2003.75 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.casekind, la.highcourt, la.senddate, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 21.78 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_in_future_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 3 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE (la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.startdate <= '2000-01-01') AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.casenumber < '1') AND NOT (la.yearhighercourt = '2000' AND la.outnumber = '1') AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury != 1) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) <= 49 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 > 4295) AS related_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = la.id AND lp.peopleid > 1070) AS people_count FROM legalacts la WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, related_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid > 4601) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 34 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 358.06 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 10.36 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.actkind LIKE '%Judgment%' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.56 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 102.65 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0.23 ORDER BY total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 4))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 190.45 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43.54 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, 0 AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_outnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_motivedate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON l.court = p.court WHERE l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber < 801.04 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber, l.motivedate, l.senddate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) BETWEEN 12.22 AND 42.46 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 59513) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 12 ORDER BY people_count DESC, link_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_linked_acts_running, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_max_startdate, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2020-01-01')) AS subquery_linked_future_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2011-01-01' AND l.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 5 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_legal_acts_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.startdate AS root_start_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT lp.name, ', ' ORDER BY lp.name) AS involved_people_names FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON l1.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 5 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_start_date;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_highercourt_year_by_court, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_outnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, la.legaldate, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 11 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, running_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send_date, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_act_kinds, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.resultofappeal, ', ') AS aggregated_appeal_results FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge), (la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind), (la.actyear, la.court), (la.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 568 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 83 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_year_per_court, MAX(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.status = 'Active') AS max_active_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 293.56 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1994.88 AND 2017.04 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 507.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20.85 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_higher_court_year, MIN(la.motivedate) AS earliest_motive_date, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > 30304.92 OR la.outnumber < 7900.06) AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR la.motivedate IS NOT NULL) AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind), (la.court, la.casekind), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 383286.16 AND AVG(la.outnumber) BETWEEN 26996.88 AND 28788.65 ORDER BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON lal2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 449.85 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 7.21) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 6.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 14.25 ORDER BY la.court, recency_rank, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_years_duration, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 12 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, avg_years_duration ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(la.legaldate) AS max_legaldate_in_group FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 6363.0 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) <= 37.08 AND MAX(la.actyear) >= 2017.18 ORDER BY people_count DESC, max_legaldate_in_group DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.casekind) AS max_casenumber_per_year_casekind FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 351.87 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15.75 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 8.64 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS active_acts_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS total_fixes, (SELECT MAX(sf2.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS last_fix_description, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf_main ON la.id = sf_main.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 788.59 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 808.76 AND 1802.91 AND la.actyear >= 2006.0 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court of Appeals') AND la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.actkind IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury = 0.68 OR p.court = 'District Court') AND sf_main.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 17.63 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > 46.18 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 537.71 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 6.7) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 15.12 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON p.court = la.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 841.84 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(lal.actid2) > 37.36 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) AS start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) - la.actyear) <= 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 38 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, start_month;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_year_by_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)) AS acts_per_judge_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 50 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY court_year_total_links DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(*) > 24 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 50 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 96 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_send_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 55 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate UNION ALL SELECT sf.actid AS act_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, COUNT(*) AS people_count, 0 AS recent_acts_flag FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 63370) GROUP BY sf.actid;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS yearly_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2.07 AND l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 40975.7) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.05 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_fixes_applied, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6195.97 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.78 ) AND l.casenumber IN ( SELECT l2.casenumber FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.court = l.court GROUP BY l2.casenumber HAVING COUNT(*) > 18.03 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15.06 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 11.79 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_years_between_start_motive FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( l.actyear > '2000' OR l.startdate < '1900-01-01' OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 = l.id AND ll_sub.actid2 IN ( SELECT l_sub.id FROM legalacts l_sub WHERE l_sub.court = l.court AND l_sub.actyear = '2000' ) ) OR l.id IN ( SELECT lp_sub.actid FROM legalact_people lp_sub JOIN people p_sub ON lp_sub.peopleid = p_sub.personid WHERE p_sub.jury > 99 GROUP BY lp_sub.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 42 ) ) AND l.motivedate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) BETWEEN 47.18 AND 37.19 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actyear > '1990' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.highcourt IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_scrapefix_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3971.71 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 176.39 AND 96.77 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13.64 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 13.59 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS latest_motivedate_by_court_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS avg_casenumber_by_highcourt, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC) AS legaldate_rank, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1)) AS jury_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_after_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND l.actyear IN (SELECT actyear FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '1990' GROUP BY actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 593) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = 8760 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 150.37 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.66 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;
