SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC) AS recent_act_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id OR ll2.actid1 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 894.65 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') AND l.judge IS NOT NULL AND p.jury > 3.52 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.79 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 6.15 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;
SELECT l.id, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id OR ll2.actid2 = l.id) AS link_count, (SELECT MAX(p.jury) FROM people p WHERE p.personid IN (SELECT lp2.peopleid FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id)) AS max_jury_in_act FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.actyear ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > '500' ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 68 ) AND p.jury > 5 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 24 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.72 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear AND la.actnumber > '1' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 0 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.actyear = l.actyear AND l3.actnumber > '1' ORDER BY l3.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 60661 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 49 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 4 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_act_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS linked_acts_count, (SELECT MAX(sf.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.name, la.id, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 58 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '10' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 608 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) FILTER (WHERE sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS distinct_fixed_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 AND ll.actid2 != lp.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 380 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) >= 385 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, distinct_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 691.26 AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR la.highcourt IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) HAVING COUNT(*) > 53.3 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_act_number DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 53 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 13 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber BETWEEN '0' AND '51' AND la.yearhighercourt > '1900' GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 12 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 727.47 ORDER BY act_count DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(la.outnumber) AS total_out_numbers FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 OR la.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, distinct_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.yearhighercourt ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.yearhighercourt, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30days, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_year_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 659.47 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1998.8 AND 2016.12 AND p.jury = 0.77 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45.85 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 15.11 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la2.actyear >= '2000' AND p1.jury = 53 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 43 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < '1000' INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la4.actyear <= '2000' AND p2.jury = 35 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 33 AND SUM(la4.actnumber) > '1000' ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_act_sum ASC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_act1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count_act1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count_act2, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate_act1, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate_act2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 404.26 AND la2.actnumber > 767.98 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 36.56 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 338.41 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate_act1 DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS actyear1, la2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, MAX(la1.senddate) AS latest_senddate1, MAX(la2.senddate) AS latest_senddate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.actyear = la2.actyear AND la1.id <> la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 345.3 AND la2.actnumber > 798.13 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5.8 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 75.26 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, latest_senddate1 DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_act_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2011-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ), court_yearly_stats AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(aa.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(aa.num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, SUM(aa.high_act_count) AS high_act_total, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.court ORDER BY aa.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr_acts FROM act_aggregates aa GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid = sf.contributor::integer WHERE p.jury > 3 GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts, MAX(pc.acts_involved) AS max_acts_per_person, AVG(pc.fixes_contributed) AS avg_fixes_per_contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS active_people_count FROM court_yearly_stats cys LEFT JOIN people_contributions pc ON cys.court = pc.court WHERE cys.total_acts > 535 AND cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts > 8.83 GROUP BY cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 56 ORDER BY cys.total_acts DESC, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts DESC;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_case_date, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_case_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 99 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, l1.actnumber AS actnum1, l2.actnumber AS actnum2, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrape_fix_summary AS ( SELECT s.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, STRING_AGG(s.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.senddate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5 ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) AS linked_cases_count, AVG(laa.act_number_diff) AS avg_act_number_diff, MAX(laa.common_people_count) AS max_common_people, COUNT(sfs.actid) AS fixed_cases_count, SUM(sfs.fix_count) AS total_fixes_applied FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN linked_act_analysis laa ON l.id IN (laa.actid1, laa.actid2) LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_summary sfs ON l.id = sfs.actid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 444 AND (cjs.granted_appeals >= 40 OR cjs.unique_people_involved > 11) AND NOT (cjs.court LIKE '%Supreme%' AND cjs.avg_act_number < '1') GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) > 9 AND SUM(sfs.fix_count) >= 14 ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, avg_act_number_diff DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE people_count >= 9 AND linked_acts_count > 27 GROUP BY court ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ra.has_fix = 1 THEN lap.actid END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(ra.linked_acts_count) AS avg_linked_per_act FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN ranked_acts ra ON lap.actid = ra.id WHERE ra.court_rank <= 654 AND ra.people_count BETWEEN 44 AND 30 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pa.acts_with_fixes) AS max_fixes_by_person, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people_count FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court JOIN people_analysis pa ON cs.court = pa.court WHERE cs.total_acts > 4951 AND cs.avg_people_per_act >= 2.45 AND pa.acts_participated > 29 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 233 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 18.99 AND SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) > 47383 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.casenumber DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS actkind_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 15 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( ORDER BY ra.num_people DESC, ra.num_related_acts DESC ) AS complexity_rank, LAG(ra.casenumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS prev_case_number, LEAD(ra.startdate) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actkind, ra.court ORDER BY ra.legaldate ) AS next_start_date FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.court_rank <= 86 AND ra.num_people >= 10 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind, COUNT(*) AS high_complexity_acts, SUM(ca.num_people) AS total_people_involved, SUM(ca.num_related_acts) AS total_related_acts, AVG(ca.complexity_rank) AS avg_complexity, MAX(ca.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.num_people) AS median_people FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.complexity_rank <= 365 AND ca.total_acts > 34 GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) >= 30 AND SUM(ca.num_people) > 75 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, high_complexity_acts DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS court_year_rank, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, AVG(ra.fix_count) AS avg_fixes, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 15 AND ra.people_count > 11 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2015' AND '2015' THEN lap.actid ELSE NULL END) AS recent_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY p.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lap.actid = la.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2010-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT ra.id, ra.actnumber, ra.startdate, ra.legaldate, ra.court, ra.judge, ra.people_count, ra.fix_count, ra.linked_acts_count, ra.court_year_rank, ra.avg_people_per_court_year, ra.cumulative_people_court, cm.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cm.total_people AS court_total_people, cm.avg_fixes AS court_avg_fixes, cm.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked_acts, cm.median_people AS court_median_people, pa.acts_involved, pa.recent_acts, pa.overall_rank, pa.court_rank, CASE WHEN ra.people_count > cm.median_people * 1.54 THEN 'HIGH_PEOPLE' WHEN ra.fix_count > cm.avg_fixes * 1.54 THEN 'HIGH_FIXES' ELSE 'NORMAL' END AS complexity_category FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_metrics cm ON ra.court = cm.court AND ra.actyear = cm.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ra.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON lap2.peopleid = pa.personid WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 45 AND ra.people_count >= 17 ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people_court DESC, ra.court_year_rank, pa.overall_rank LIMIT 350;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber <= '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 70 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date_in_hierarchy FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 50 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '0' OR la.actnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) AS start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_senddate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber < '10' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind), (la.court, la.casekind), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 42 AND (AVG(la.outnumber) < 259.04 OR AVG(la.outnumber) IS NULL) ORDER BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, start_year DESC, start_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ) SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, AVG(num_fixes) AS avg_fixes_per_act, AVG(avg_processing_years) AS avg_processing_time FROM act_aggregates WHERE num_people > 9 AND num_related_acts >= 5 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(num_fixes) > 0.92 ORDER BY court, actyear DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_year_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.typeofdocument ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.motivedate DESC ) AS doc_type_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_links, SUM(ra.fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(ra.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_links_per_act, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 10 AND ra.doc_type_sequence <= 36 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 56 AND SUM(ra.people_count) > 487 AND AVG(ra.people_count) > 6.93 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.typeofdocument, ca.actkind, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.max_links_per_act, ca.median_people, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM complex_aggregates ca ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC, overall_rank;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(*) > 19 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 98717)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 50 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49 ORDER BY people_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag_count, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_by_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 16 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 385.05 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8.09) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 43.6 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS moving_avg_fixes, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear > '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_rolling, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 620.34 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 5004.41 AND 2790.06 AND l.actyear IN (2022.33, 2004.58, 1997.0) AND (l.status = 'Active' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 48.4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 18.51 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 370.39 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 976.87 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2006.82 AND 2022.92 AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 5.38 ORDER BY num_linked_acts DESC, l.startdate ASC LIMIT 549.76;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 9;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 7;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 17 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) AS send_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) ORDER BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_quarterly_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 485.5 AND la.outnumber < 900.2 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2021.69 AND 2014.1 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) = 2002.6 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 37.28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16.98 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < 8593.43 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC, court_act_rank;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'CourtA' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 723 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS act_kinds_list, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 9) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 15 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.court IS NOT NULL OR 0 = 1) GROUP BY CUBE (la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.casekind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 73 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) = 10 GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 39 ORDER BY act_count DESC, start_year;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 636.63 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.94 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 683.07 AND la.outnumber < 342.68 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2002.8 AND 1998.26 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casekind, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36.76 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 16.71 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor = 'A') AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 221.51 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND casekind = la.casekind AND actyear >= 2020.37) ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, unique_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.motivedate IS NOT NULL ) ) AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_linked_acts_by_casekind, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_in_court_year, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS earliest_startdate_in_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal_sub WHERE lal_sub.actid1 = la.id AND lal_sub.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01')) AS count_linked_acts_after_date, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.actid IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 = la.id)) AS people_in_linked_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 3828.93 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2037.78 AND 1965.45 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 71.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 44.45 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people DESC, total_linked_acts DESC LIMIT 5102.06;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' AND la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Supreme Court' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 11;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, avg_actnumber1 DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_links, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC ) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS running_people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS judge_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '51' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.casekind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.num_people) AS total_people, AVG(ra.num_links) AS avg_links, MAX(ra.running_people_count) AS max_running_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.actnumber) AS median_actnumber FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 47 AND ra.judge_avg_actnumber > 26.28 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 493 AND SUM(ra.num_people) >= 2754 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.total_people DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.total_acts, 1) OVER (ORDER BY cs.court, cs.actkind) AS prev_court_acts FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court AND cs.actkind = ra.actkind JOIN legalact_people lp ON ra.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 0 WHERE ra.num_people >= 1 AND ra.num_links > 6 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.actkind, cs.total_acts, cs.total_people, cs.avg_links, cs.max_running_people, cs.median_actnumber ORDER BY activity_rank, cs.court, cs.actkind;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 87 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 907.26 AND l.yearhighercourt >= 2017.0 GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)), (l.court, l.actkind), (l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 570.33 ORDER BY l.court, l.actkind, legal_year DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS max_jury_person_id FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42 UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(p2.personid) FILTER (WHERE p2.jury = 1) AS max_jury_person_id FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll.actid2 = l3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid WHERE l2.actyear >= '2000' AND l3.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' AND l3.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l2.court, l2.actyear, l2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.contributor) > 7 ORDER BY court_total_acts DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS max_actyear_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 816.56 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2006.48 AND 2019.6 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.casekind, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 38.96 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.05 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court DESC, legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 138.64 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 26 ORDER BY people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.actnumber > '500' ORDER BY l2.actnumber DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 33 ) AND p.jury > 7 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 19 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_act_sum_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_outnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 11.68 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 363.01 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.08 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 516.11 ) ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 7829.12 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 49.95 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.yearhighercourt, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.yearhighercourt) AS highcourt_year_max_outnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lpe ON l.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON ll1.actid2 = lp2.actid1 AND ll2.actid1 = lp2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') OR (l.senddate IS NOT NULL AND l.senddate < '2000-01-01') ) AND ( (l.actnumber > '1' AND l.outnumber < '1') OR (l.yearhighercourt = '2000' AND l.casenumber <> '1') OR (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL) ) AND NOT ( l.typeofdocument = 'Decree' OR l.casekind IN ('Civil', 'Civil') OR (l.resultofappeal = 'Upheld' AND l.status = 'Active') ) AND p.jury > 9 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.yearhighercourt, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, l.casekind, l.highcourt, l.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) >= 48 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS latest_start_by_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 13 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 629.27 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 18.34 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;
