SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date, MIN(la.legaldate) AS earliest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 237 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 33.66 ORDER BY distinct_acts DESC, latest_start_date DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 122.95 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(sub.people_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp_inner.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalact_people lp_inner GROUP BY lp_inner.actid) sub WHERE people_count > 10.49) ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_case_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_year_status, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 58 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.actnumber > '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 46 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 6 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, cumulative_people_by_court DESC, recency_rank_in_court_year;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 924.16 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.54 AND p.court = la.court ) AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 24.42 ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16.33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 18.18 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, p.name, sf.fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, SUM(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.legaldate) AS running_act_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, la1.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank, AVG(la2.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS avg_outnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 101.97 AND la2.outnumber IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 2.92) GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.outnumber, p.name, p.personid, sf.fix_description HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) >= 23.69 AND AVG(la2.outnumber) > 22.42 ORDER BY la1.court, la1.actyear DESC, act_rank;

SELECT l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber ORDER BY people_count DESC;
SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND s.actid > 67321 GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_legaldate, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(l.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.outnumber > '0' OR l.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 823 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 107 OR MAX(l.outnumber) < '0') ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.actyear, l.court;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 172.97) AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 72.41 UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, NULL AS actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND l2.yearhighercourt > 2029.01 GROUP BY l2.court HAVING AVG(l2.outnumber) < 33.94 ORDER BY court, actyear NULLS LAST;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_legal_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2010' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 9))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_fixes_applied, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3122.92 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.16 ) AND l.casenumber IN ( SELECT l2.casenumber FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.court = l.court GROUP BY l2.casenumber HAVING COUNT(*) > 34.69 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 35.83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 2.96 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS court_casekind_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear, l.status) AS year_status_avg_linked_acts, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(l.casenumber) AS avg_casenumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 0 AND SUM(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.yearhighercourt > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS higher_court_cases FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 48 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) > 9.56 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(s.actid) AS avg_scraped_act, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_start FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid > 3867 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '1990-01-01') AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5.47 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 6 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 43;

SELECT l1.court AS court_name, l1.actyear AS act_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS total_acts, SUM(l1.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, MIN(l1.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 312 AND SUM(l1.actnumber) < '1000' UNION ALL SELECT p.court AS court_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate)::smallint AS send_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(l.outnumber) AS sum_out_numbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motive_date, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_send_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND p.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate)::smallint HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 91 AND SUM(l.outnumber) < '1000' ORDER BY court_name, act_year;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 6) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 65 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 36 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_since_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.casenumber > 337.01 THEN la.id END) AS high_case_number_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN 2013.27 AND 2012.0 AND la.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (la.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 57.5 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 12.94 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

num_scrapefix, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) <= 46.57 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 5.12 ORDER BY legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_start_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.typeofdocument LIKE '%Act%' OR la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND la.actnumber > 784.05 AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.court LIKE '%Supreme%') AND (sf.fix_description LIKE '%fix%' OR sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.22 AND AVG(la2.actnumber) > 225.82 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ll.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 838.51 AND (la.casenumber < 76.54 OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) >= 38.14 AND COUNT(*) > 50.54 ORDER BY court_year_total_acts DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id DESC) AS recency_rank_in_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS acts_per_judge_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpe2 ON la2.id = lpe2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lpe2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 425.44 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 19.33 ORDER BY cumulative_linked_acts_by_court_year DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_document_types, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id DESC) AS court_act_rank, LAG(la.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) >= 58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 28 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, linked_people_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) > 43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 9 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, la.resultofappeal, la.status, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS latest_startdate_per_highcourt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE la.resultofappeal IS NOT NULL) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS non_null_appeals_per_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id OR ll2.actid1 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 960.12 AND (la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.highcourt LIKE '%High%') AND la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%' AND p.name LIKE '%A%' AND (sf.fix_description LIKE '%error%' OR sf.contributor LIKE '%admin%') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.judge, la.resultofappeal, la.status, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 25.34 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 150.43 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS median_jury, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS percentile_75_actnumber, SUM(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS total_outnumber_by_court_case, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.status) AS avg_casenumber_by_year_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 756.5 AND la.outnumber < 4.7 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2003.82 AND 2015.83 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 9.82 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) > 8.76 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_actkind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE ( la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND ( la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE court = la.court AND actyear = la.actyear - 1 AND actnumber > '1' ) ) OR la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 AND court = la.court ) ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 17 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_actkind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 495.84 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 43.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 8.41 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, cumulative_people_by_court DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT lal.actid1, lal.actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.fix_description) AS shared_fixes_count FROM legalact_link lal JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON lal.actid1 = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON lal.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON lal.actid1 = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON lal.actid2 = sf2.actid GROUP BY lal.actid1, lal.actid2 ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.judge) AS unique_judges, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ), people_networks AS ( SELECT p.personid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT an.actid2) AS network_connections, COUNT(DISTINCT la.court) AS courts_worked_in, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actkind) AS act_kinds_handled, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN act_networks an ON la.id = an.actid1 WHERE p.jury > 7 AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 99 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) AS active_network_people, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.network_connections) AS distinct_network_sizes, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.courts_worked_in) AS court_mobility_levels, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.act_kinds_handled) AS expertise_diversity, AVG(pn.involved_acts) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pn.avg_higher_court_year) AS max_avg_higher_court_year FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people p ON cm.court = p.court JOIN people_networks pn ON p.personid = pn.personid WHERE cm.total_acts > 264 AND cm.unique_people >= 271 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) > 7 AND AVG(pn.involved_acts) < 178 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, active_network_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_actyear_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 10 GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 4 ORDER BY total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 5 GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0 ORDER BY total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id_1, l2.id AS act_id_2, l1.actyear AS act_year_1, l2.actyear AS act_year_2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, l1.id, l2.id;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS judge_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 6 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON p.court = la.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 767.32 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(lal.actid2) > 22.07 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM court_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_size FROM linked_acts_analysis laa JOIN legalacts l ON laa.court = l.court AND laa.actyear = l.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 6 GROUP BY laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number ) SELECT pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS sample_fix_description FROM people_analysis pa JOIN legalacts l ON pa.court = l.court AND pa.actyear = l.actyear LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) > 21 AND pa.total_acts >= 851 ORDER BY pa.total_acts DESC, pa.linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM court_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_size FROM linked_acts_analysis laa JOIN legalacts l ON laa.court = l.court AND laa.actyear = l.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 9 GROUP BY laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number ) SELECT pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS sample_fix_description FROM people_analysis pa JOIN legalacts l ON pa.court = l.court AND pa.actyear = l.actyear LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) > 32 AND pa.total_acts >= 393 ORDER BY pa.total_acts DESC, pa.linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) AS start_quarter, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), l.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actyear IS NOT NULL) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 630.73 AND p.jury = 0.19 GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate), l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 95.68 ORDER BY start_year DESC, start_quarter, l.court;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) AS fixed_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 13 AND SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) < 43 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS judge_names, MIN(l.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 55 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_startdate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY total_people DESC, latest_startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, 0 AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 2 ORDER BY legalact_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_in_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 119.96 AND (l.casenumber < 724.38 OR l.actyear = 2020.97) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 0.11)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = l.id AND sf2.contributor = 'A')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18.05 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 372.3 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.highcourt LIKE '%High%') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2.25 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND SUM(s.actid) >= 36 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 100 ORDER BY num_people DESC, num_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 132.99 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7.42 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.court = l.court AND l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.startdate <= l.startdate AND l2.actnumber > '1' ORDER BY l2.startdate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 7162 ) AND p.jury > 72 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 6 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_avg_actnumber, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS act_link_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 49.77 AND (l.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR l.yearhighercourt < 2008.84) AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury = 0.21) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 13.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18.35 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge2 FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 18 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_court_judge2 FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 14 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 45 ORDER BY act_id1, act_id2;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 29 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_highcourt_actkind, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 21 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 74 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS related_acts, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2020' THEN 'RECENT' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2010' THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'OLD' END AS act_age_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 THEN 'HIGH_PARTICIPATION' ELSE 'LOW_PARTICIPATION' END AS participation_level, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS acts_per_year_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury = 1) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 24 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_linked_avg FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear > '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 14 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

WITH act_hierarchy AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actnumber AS linked_act_number, l2.legaldate AS linked_legal_date, l2.motivedate AS linked_motive_date, CASE WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate > 133 THEN 'LONG_DELAY' WHEN l2.legaldate - l1.legaldate < 20 THEN 'SHORT_DELAY' ELSE 'NORMAL_DELAY' END AS processing_delay_category, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l2.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l1.legaldate) AS years_between_acts FROM legalacts l1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2011-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2011' ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS jury_members_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS involved_people_names FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON ah.linked_act_id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), scrape_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(sf.fix_description, 50), ' | ') AS fix_previews FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON ah.linked_act_id = sf.actid GROUP BY ah.root_act_id, ah.linked_act_id ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ah.*, pa.total_people_involved, pa.jury_members_count, pa.involved_people_names, sa.fix_count, sa.unique_contributors, sa.fix_previews, AVG(ah.years_between_acts) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court) AS avg_years_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY ah.processing_delay_category, ah.root_court) AS delay_count_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ah.root_court ORDER BY ah.years_between_acts DESC) AS years_rank_in_court FROM act_hierarchy ah LEFT JOIN people_analysis pa ON ah.root_act_id = pa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = pa.linked_act_id LEFT JOIN scrape_analysis sa ON ah.root_act_id = sa.root_act_id AND ah.linked_act_id = sa.linked_act_id ) SELECT root_court, processing_delay_category, COUNT(*) AS total_linkages, AVG(years_between_acts) AS avg_years_between, MAX(years_between_acts) AS max_years_between, SUM(total_people_involved) AS total_people_across_links, AVG(jury_members_count) AS avg_jury_per_link, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(unique_contributors) AS avg_contributors_per_link, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT LEFT(involved_people_names, 30), '; ') AS sample_people FROM window_analysis WHERE years_between_acts > 5 AND total_people_involved >= 6 AND fix_count <= 11 GROUP BY root_court, processing_delay_category HAVING COUNT(*) >= 19 AND AVG(years_between_acts) > 1.4 ORDER BY total_linkages DESC, avg_years_between DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 12 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS max_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 701.55 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27.71 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4.1 ORDER BY cumulative_people_by_court DESC, distinct_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS active_cases_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8232.36 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 19.2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description,
