SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 532.95 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.25 ORDER BY total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0.99 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY l.court, rank_in_court;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 6544 ) ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.yearhighercourt ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = 2001 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.yearhighercourt, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 31 ORDER BY total_people DESC, running_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' AND l2.court = 'Supreme Court' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY l.actyear, l.court;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS latest_startdate_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_after_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap2 WHERE lap2.actid = la.id) >= 34 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 405;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.name IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 5 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 752 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(*) > 26 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS highcourt_actkind_avg_links, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casenumber) AS max_actnumber_per_case FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON lal.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 856.29 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 47.93 AND 31.59 AND (la.highcourt = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 38.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 13.62 ORDER BY linked_people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 70.33 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1.45 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS avg_actnumber_excluding_current, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_year_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON lal2.actid1 = la3.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 371.34 AND la.yearhighercourt < 2002.15 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 33.51 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 8.92 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS later_acts_in_court_case, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.actkind) AS avg_processing_years_by_judge, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.yearhighercourt) AS max_outnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court') AND la.status != 'Dismissed' AND p.jury IS NOT NULL AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor != 'System') AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, la2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 5 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la2.court = 'Αρείου Πάγου' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actyear, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actyear, la2.actnumber, la2.court, la2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 65 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 32 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.court, la3.judge, la3.actyear, la4.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la4.court AS linked_court, la4.actyear AS linked_actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(la3.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court, la3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < '1' AND la4.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.court, la3.judge, la3.actyear, la4.actnumber, la4.court, la4.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 53 AND SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 20 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, linked_actnumber ASC;

SELECT la1.id AS root_act_id, la1.actnumber AS root_act_number, la1.startdate AS root_start_date, la1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 4546.73 AND la2.actyear = 2013.17 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.28 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, root_start_date;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value, 'people_count' AS metric_type FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 8 UNION ALL SELECT id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value, 'link_count' AS metric_type FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count > 8 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(ll.actid2) AS link_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actnumber <= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 5 UNION ALL SELECT 'linked' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, link_count AS metric_value FROM linked_acts WHERE link_count >= 0 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate UNION ALL SELECT sf.actid AS act_id, NULL AS actnumber, NULL AS startdate, COUNT(*) AS people_count, 0 AS recent_acts_flag FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 57221) GROUP BY sf.actid;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 76257)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 42 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_actyear, AVG(COALESCE(sub.avg_people_per_act, 0)) AS avg_people_per_act_in_court, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT l_inner.court, l_inner.id, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp_inner.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l_inner.court) AS avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts l_inner JOIN legalact_people lp_inner ON l_inner.id = lp_inner.actid WHERE l_inner.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l_inner.court, l_inner.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp_inner.peopleid) > 6.03 ) sub ON l.court = sub.court AND l.id = sub.id WHERE l.startdate BETWEEN '1990-01-01' AND '1990-01-01' AND l.actyear > 1969.9 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17.23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 17.46 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, legalact_id;
SELECT l.id, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear > '2000' AND s.fix_description IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id ORDER BY fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.84 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 368 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '0' ORDER BY num_people DESC, total_actnumber ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actyear AS act_year, l1.court AS court_name, l1.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS num_people_in_act, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS num_scrapefix_entries, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY num_people_in_act DESC, act_year ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_court_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number2, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date1, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date2, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l1.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count1, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l2.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear > l2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON (l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2) OR (l1.id = ll.actid2 AND l2.id = ll.actid1) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 127.95 AND l2.actnumber > 480.09 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.actyear, l2.actyear, l1.court, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 22.88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 28.83 ORDER BY l1.actyear DESC, l2.actyear DESC, unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS actyear1, l2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.senddate) AS latest_senddate1, MAX(l2.senddate) AS latest_senddate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS common_people_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 407.55 AND l2.actnumber > 13.56 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 16.43 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 254.66 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < 464.37 ORDER BY common_people_count DESC, l1.id, l2.id;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear = '1900' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_year_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, p.name, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 961232 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.legaldate ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_processing_years FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) > 2.27 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 92.45 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, avg_processing_years DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 68 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind, la.highcourt) AS avg_linked_acts_per_actkind_highcourt, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.court) AS max_casenumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 88 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.yearhighercourt ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.yearhighercourt, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 14 ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'DENIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS denied_appeals, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal NOT IN ('GRANTED', 'DENIED') OR la.resultofappeal IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS other_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL) AS avg_actnumber_highercourt, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(la.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 131.45 AND (la.yearhighercourt > 2014.3 OR la.yearhighercourt IS NULL) AND la.court LIKE 'Supreme' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 7.41 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 39.65 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, latest_senddate DESC LIMIT 881.99;

WITH court_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(*) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber < '50' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.act_count, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_act_number, la.linked_acts_count, la.fixed_acts_count, la.max_act_number, (ca.act_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(ca.unique_people, 0)) AS acts_per_person FROM court_acts ca FULL OUTER JOIN linked_acts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear WHERE (ca.act_count > 372 OR la.linked_acts_count > 350) AND (ca.avg_act_number < '10' OR la.max_act_number > '100') ORDER BY ca.actyear DESC, ca.act_count DESC;

WITH court_aggregates AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM court_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.court = la.court AND ca.actyear = la.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_act_number, ca.latest_legal_date ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, AVG(p.jury) AS avg_jury_size FROM linked_acts_analysis laa JOIN legalacts l ON laa.court = l.court AND laa.actyear = l.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 9 GROUP BY laa.court, laa.actyear, laa.total_acts, laa.total_people, laa.total_fixes, laa.linked_acts_count, laa.avg_linked_act_number ) SELECT pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS sample_fix_description FROM people_analysis pa JOIN legalacts l ON pa.court = l.court AND pa.actyear = l.actyear LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY pa.court, pa.actyear, pa.total_acts, pa.total_people, pa.total_fixes, pa.linked_acts_count, pa.avg_linked_act_number, pa.unique_judges, pa.avg_jury_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) > 50 AND pa.total_acts >= 554 ORDER BY pa.total_acts DESC, pa.linked_acts_count DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_linked_acts_3year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(people_count) AS total_people_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY linked_acts_count) AS median_linked_acts FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_year_rank <= 16 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(people_count) > 6.7 AND COUNT(*) >= 32 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_people_involved, cs.median_linked_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actyear ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people DESC, ra.people_count DESC ) AS yearly_people_rank, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate ) AS prev_year_people_count, (ra.people_count - LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate )) AS people_count_change FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.avg_linked_acts_3year > 1.22 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.id, ca.actnumber, ca.startdate, ca.legaldate, ca.people_count, ca.linked_acts_count, ca.has_fix, ca.court_year_rank, ca.cumulative_people, ca.avg_linked_acts_3year, ca.total_acts, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.total_people_involved, ca.median_linked_acts, ca.yearly_people_rank, ca.prev_year_people_count, ca.people_count_change, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.people_count DESC, ca.linked_acts_count DESC ) AS court_importance_rank, SUM(ca.people_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.actyear, ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS court_cumulative_people, AVG(ca.linked_acts_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actyear ORDER BY ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_linked_acts FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.yearly_people_rank <= 53 AND ca.people_count_change > -2 ORDER BY ca.court, ca.actyear DESC, ca.yearly_people_rank;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC ) AS court_year_rank, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.typeofdocument ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.motivedate DESC ) AS doc_type_sequence FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(ra.people_count) AS total_people, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_links, SUM(ra.fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(ra.people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.linked_acts_count) AS max_links_per_act, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people FROM ranked_acts ra WHERE ra.court_year_rank <= 46 AND ra.doc_type_sequence <= 9 GROUP BY ra.court, ra.actyear, ra.typeofdocument, ra.actkind HAVING COUNT(*) > 84 AND SUM(ra.people_count) > 273 AND AVG(ra.people_count) > 5.92 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.typeofdocument, ca.actkind, ca.total_acts, ca.total_people, ca.total_links, ca.total_fixes, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.max_links_per_act, ca.median_people, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC) AS overall_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM complex_aggregates ca ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, ca.total_people DESC, overall_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 964.76 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44.54 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 0 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.startdate) AS latest_start1, MAX(l2.startdate) AS latest_start2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.id <> l2.id AND l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 944.03 AND l2.actnumber > 11.43 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 31.19 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 36.12 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < 797.63 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, latest_start1 DESC, latest_start2 DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 16 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' ) ) AS total_people_linked FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 184 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS cumulative_fixes, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, COUNT(sf.actid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 5 ORDER BY court_rank, cumulative_fixes DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_year_links, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber2, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate1, MAX(la2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate2, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON (lp1.peopleid = p.personid OR lp2.peopleid = p.personid) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON (la1.id = sf.actid OR la2.id = sf.actid) WHERE la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 AND COUNT(sf.actid) < 18 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, same_year_links DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixed_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS linked_acts_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS act_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 617.99 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2005.55 AND 2014.69 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, sf.contributor), (l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt), (l.actyear, l.court), (l.actyear), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 6.0 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 7.92 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court IS NOT NULL OR p.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 9 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_total_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_distinct_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 597.24 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 93.64 AND 34.89 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 30.18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14.29 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_act FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 240.01 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 19.72 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_in_year, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 AND MAX(l.legaldate) < '2000-01-01' ORDER BY num_people DESC, latest_legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.court = l.court AND la.actyear = l.actyear AND la.actnumber > '1' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = p.jury THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS yearly_court_acts, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_case_status, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > 556.27 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2088.35 AND 2091.25 AND p.jury > 853793964.15 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 789709.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 877701.76 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_actkind, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.yearhighercourt < '0' AND la.casenumber >= '0' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, la.legaldate, la.outnumber, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 288040 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 378232 AND SUM(la.actnumber) < 11740 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, running_actnumber_sum ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(la.legaldate, la.startdate))) AS avg_processing_days FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear BETWEEN 2 AND 1 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber IS NOT NULL) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.startdate) AS latest_start_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.court LIKE '%Court%' AND la.actyear >= 2008.03 AND la.actkind IS NOT NULL AND (la.judge LIKE '%Judge%' OR la.judge IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 39.97 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casekind = 'Civil' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS civil_cases, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS delayed_legalizations, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_out_number, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_send_date FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 28 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, avg_act_number ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_quarter, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_outnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) = 3 GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 7 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, la.actyear, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.actnumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) > 8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 2 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

WITH act_relationships AS ( SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS related_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, CASE WHEN l1.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_act_link, CASE WHEN l1.motivelink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_motive_link FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 OR l1.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON (ll.actid1 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.actlink, l1.motivelink ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT lp.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT p.jury) AS unique_juries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS people_names FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 41 GROUP BY lp.actid ), scrape_metrics AS ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS max_fix_length FROM scrapefix sf WHERE LENGTH(sf.fix_description) > 491 GROUP BY sf.actid ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ar.act_id, ar.actnumber, ar.legaldate, ar.court, ar.actyear, ar.related_acts_count, ar.involved_people_count, ar.has_act_link, ar.has_motive_link, COALESCE(pa.unique_people, 0) AS unique_people, COALESCE(pa.unique_juries, 0) AS unique_juries, pa.people_names, SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id) AS link_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2010' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 2 OR COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_case_judge FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 3 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 14 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_total_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 902.9 AND l.outnumber < 943.84 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2008.92 AND 2020.86 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 39.67 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 41.36 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 665.74 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = p.jury THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS yearly_court_acts, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_case_status, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS max_legaldate_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber > 14047.9 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 1912.9 AND 1996.77 AND p.jury > 431328103.99 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 909541.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 514100.01 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l1.actnumber, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 7 INTERSECT SELECT l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l2.actnumber, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 6;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 90 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '0' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 19 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 927 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 519 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY total_acts DESC, court_year_total DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate) AS start_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.senddate) AS earliest_senddate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber < '10' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.startdate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge), (la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind), (la.court, la.casekind), (la.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 33 AND (AVG(la.outnumber) < 288.8 OR AVG(la.outnumber) IS NULL) ORDER BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, start_year DESC, start_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_act_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 28.75 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2020.48 AND 1999.29 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 20.54 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_year_by_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate)) AS acts_per_judge_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 29 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY court_year_total_links DESC, linked_acts_count DESC;
