SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casenumber, la.actyear) AS avg_case_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber >= '1' AND (la.actnumber >= '1' OR la.outnumber >= '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 31 AND AVG(la.actnumber) >= '10' ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC, la.legaldate DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND p.jury > 548 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 AND SUM(sf1.actid) < 886951 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp4.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear < '2000' AND p2.jury < 647 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) < 44 AND SUM(sf2.actid) > 541956 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear > '2000' AND p.jury > 686 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 34 AND SUM(sf1.actid) < 552538 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp4.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear < '2000' AND p2.jury < 576 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) < 27 AND SUM(sf2.actid) > 849284 ORDER BY actyear DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.casenumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear ORDER BY la1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people_10_acts, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.casekind ORDER BY la1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber_5_days, MAX(la1.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.highcourt, la1.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_highcourt_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 217.23 AND la2.actyear >= 2022.79 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.casenumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 21.89 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 9.03 ORDER BY la1.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.senddate) AS last_send_date FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2010-01-01' AND '2010-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2010' AND l.outnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) ), court_stats AS ( SELECT ca.court, ca.legal_year, SUM(ca.total_acts) AS yearly_acts, SUM(ca.total_people_involved) AS yearly_people, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ca.avg_act_number) AS median_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT ca.judge) AS active_judges FROM court_activity ca GROUP BY ca.court, ca.legal_year HAVING SUM(ca.total_acts) > 71 ) SELECT cs.court, cs.legal_year, cs.yearly_acts, cs.yearly_people, cs.median_act_number, cs.active_judges, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cs.legal_year ORDER BY cs.yearly_acts DESC) AS activity_rank, LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year) AS prev_year_acts, (cs.yearly_acts - LAG(cs.yearly_acts, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY cs.court ORDER BY cs.legal_year)) AS yoy_growth FROM court_stats cs WHERE cs.yearly_people >= 295 ORDER BY cs.legal_year DESC, activity_rank ASC;

SELECT l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS act_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 278.14 AND l.outnumber BETWEEN 6.64 AND 89.73 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate) = 2021.43 GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actkind, l.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM l.legaldate)) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 11.63 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 14.01 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 302.62 AND l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 26948.19) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1.59 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 1767.7 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 7.23 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid1 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_links_as_first, SUM(CASE WHEN ll.actid2 IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_links_as_second, AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS avg_jury_score, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate, MIN(l.motivedate) AS earliest_motivedate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS involved_people_names, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) AND (l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 8)) OR l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE legaldate < '2000-01-01'))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 52 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 21 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.id) AS recency_rank_in_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(CASE WHEN s.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND SUM(CASE WHEN s.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) < 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.actyear = '2000' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court') AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 OR COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 3 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS co_participant_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_latest_startdate FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid AND lp2.peopleid != lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 7 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_linked, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS total_links_as_first, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_links_as_second, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_with_startdate, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date, MIN(l2.motivedate) AS min_linked_motive_date, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, l.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank_by_date, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.actyear, l.casenumber) AS overall_dense_rank, LAG(l.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS prev_actnumber_in_court_year, LEAD(l.legaldate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS next_legaldate_in_casekind, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear, l.court) AS total_actnumber_per_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 OR l.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON (ll.actid1 = l2.id AND ll.actid1 != l.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND ll.actid2 != l.id) LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 586.74 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 75.25 AND 93.22 AND p.jury = 0.38 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.47 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) + COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 9.72 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_linked DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber AS act_number, l1.startdate AS start_date, l1.legaldate AS legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 829.3 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9.26 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.legaldate AS root_legal_date, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS root_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.status = 'ACTIVE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_linked_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p1.name, ', ' ORDER BY p1.name) AS root_people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS court_total_linkages FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND (l2.actyear IS NULL OR l2.actyear >= '2000') AND (p1.court IS NULL OR p1.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 23 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 2 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY root_people_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC LIMIT 842;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY num_people DESC, la.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 86 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 73 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_actnumber_positive, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names_agg FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '0' AND (la.outnumber < '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 684 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 68 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, start_quarter, legal_month, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_year, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_date) FROM (SELECT MAX(la2.legaldate) AS max_date FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actyear = la.actyear AND la2.legaldate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la2.court, la2.actyear) sub) AS latest_legaldate_in_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 AND la2.actyear >= '2000' AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 29 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 43 ORDER BY act_count DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actyear, la.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN la.actnumber ELSE 0 END) AS granted_actnumber_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 165.61) AS avg_actnumber_above_threshold, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate, SUM(CASE WHEN la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_send_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.contributor, ', ') AS contributors_list FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN 2012.34 AND 2002.55 AND la.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actyear, la.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 442.73 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 401.52 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link lal2 WHERE lal2.actid1 = la.id AND lal2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.motivedate IS NOT NULL ) ) AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 7 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor = 'A') AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'A' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_year_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.court = 'CourtA' OR la.highcourt = 'HighCourtA') AND la.status IN ('Status1', 'Status1', 'Status1') AND la.casenumber IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury > 6 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 18 AND AVG(la.outnumber) > 9.71 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear ORDER BY la.casenumber ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.casenumber, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l2.id AS linked_act_id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS network_size FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON l1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON lal.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 2 ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN la.court = p.court THEN la.id END) AS same_court_acts FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.personid, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) >= 14 ), complex_aggregates AS ( SELECT an.root_act_id, an.network_size, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS unique_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT la.highcourt) AS high_court_variety, AVG(an.shared_people_count) AS avg_shared_people, SUM(pc.total_acts) AS total_network_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_fix_contributors FROM act_networks an JOIN legalacts la ON an.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people_contributions pc ON lp.peopleid = pc.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND an.network_size > 15 GROUP BY an.root_act_id, an.network_size HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) >= 1 ) SELECT ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS direct_links, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes FROM complex_aggregates ca JOIN legalacts la ON ca.root_act_id = la.id JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 0 GROUP BY ca.root_act_id, la.actnumber, la.court, ca.network_size, ca.unique_contributors, ca.case_kind_variety, ca.high_court_variety, ca.avg_shared_people, ca.total_network_acts, ca.unique_fix_contributors HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 13 ORDER BY ca.network_size DESC, ca.unique_contributors DESC LIMIT 100;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge ), act_link_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1 ), people_contribution AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON lp.actid = sf.actid WHERE p.jury > 5 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = cjs.court AND l3.judge = cjs.judge AND l3.legaldate > cjs.latest_legal_date AND l3.actnumber > '100') AS recent_high_number_cases, (SELECT AVG(sf2.fix_description_length) FROM (SELECT actid, LENGTH(fix_description) AS fix_description_length FROM scrapefix WHERE actid IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid = pc.personid) AND LENGTH(fix_description) > 3817) sf2) AS avg_fix_length FROM court_judge_stats cjs JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN act_link_analysis ala ON l.id = ala.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people_contribution pc ON lp2.peopleid = pc.personid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 178 AND cjs.unique_people_count >= 58 AND (ala.linked_acts_count IS NULL OR ala.linked_acts_count > 20) GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.latest_legal_date, cjs.unique_people_count, ala.linked_acts_count, ala.avg_linked_act_number, pc.acts_involved, pc.fixed_acts_count, pc.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 15 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '500' ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, cjs.unique_people_count DESC;

WITH recent_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2020-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2020' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ), fixed_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2018-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2018' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear ) SELECT 'recent' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, people_count AS metric_value FROM recent_acts WHERE people_count > 7 UNION ALL SELECT 'fixed' AS source_type, id, actnumber, startdate, court, judge, actyear, fix_count AS metric_value FROM fixed_acts WHERE fix_count > 1 ORDER BY metric_value DESC, startdate DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid IN (SELECT lp.actid FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.peopleid = p.personid)) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 73 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 4 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_out_number_per_year, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motive_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid1 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) < 3 ORDER BY court_total DESC, act_count ASC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dated_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.startdate) AS latest_start, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_send, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.actkind, ', ') AS act_kinds, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS overall_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court LIKE 'A' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge, p.name), (l.court, l.actyear, l.judge), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 8 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_members_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_actkind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 915.22 AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND l.actkind IS NOT NULL AND l.status = 'Final' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 6.11 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 715.05 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5.96 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_future_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 13 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 21 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 574.71 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5.01 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 16.12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 88174)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 29.49 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1.72 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 773.01 AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.judge IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44.18 OR COUNT(sf.actid) > 16.47 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 17 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id AS act_id, l3.actnumber, l3.legaldate, l3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l4.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_per_court_year FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid2 = l4.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actnumber < '1' AND p2.jury < 64 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.legaldate, l3.court, l3.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 50 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30days, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.judge ORDER BY l1.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_linked_acts_10rows, MAX(l1.actyear) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS max_actyear_court FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 ORDER BY l1.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 60 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 14 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS judge_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 16 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 300.94 AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < 804.85) GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 32.57 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_quarter DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 457.06 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.55 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS active_cases_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 767.63 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 40.38 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_court_actkind, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_court_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 10 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 549.32 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16.17 ORDER BY total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 6691.52 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1996.2 AND 2009.22 AND la.outnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 37.72 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casenumber, la.actyear) AS avg_case_actnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber >= '1' AND (la.actnumber >= '1' OR la.outnumber >= '1') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 39 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 62 AND AVG(la.actnumber) >= '10' ORDER BY people_count DESC, linked_acts_count DESC, la.legaldate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS reciprocal_link_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.actyear) AS max_startdate_per_judge_year, MIN(la.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS min_legaldate_per_court_status FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND (la.outnumber > '0' OR la.outnumber IS NULL) AND (p.jury = 895193 OR p.jury IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 953946 AND (AVG(la.actnumber) < '0' OR AVG(la.actnumber) IS NULL) ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber AS actnumber1, la2.actnumber AS actnumber2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS actyear1, la2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_count2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fix_count2, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year1, SUM(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court ORDER BY la2.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_actnumber2, MAX(la1.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt1, MIN(la2.yearhighercourt) AS min_yearhighercourt2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 110.71 AND la2.actnumber < 3565.83 AND la1.yearhighercourt >= 2023.13 AND la2.yearhighercourt <= 1948.87 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la2.actnumber, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.legaldate, la2.legaldate, la1.yearhighercourt, la2.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 236.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 476.44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) >= 77.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) <= 80.44 ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear ASC, unique_people_count1 DESC, unique_people_count2 ASC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid WHERE la1.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 INTERSECT SELECT la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 27;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.actyear AS actyear1, la2.actyear AS actyear2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2, MAX(la1.senddate) AS latest_senddate1, MAX(la2.senddate) AS latest_senddate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.actyear = la2.actyear AND la1.id <> la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 40.56 AND la2.actnumber > 854.57 GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id, la1.court, la2.court, la1.actyear, la2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 32.29 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 198.74 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, latest_senddate1 DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actnumber > '5' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_act_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2011-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court ), court_yearly_stats AS ( SELECT aa.court, aa.actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(aa.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, AVG(aa.num_related_acts) AS avg_related_acts, SUM(aa.num_fixes) AS total_fixes, SUM(aa.high_act_count) AS high_act_total, AVG(COUNT(*)) OVER ( PARTITION BY aa.court ORDER BY aa.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_3yr_acts FROM act_aggregates aa GROUP BY aa.court, aa.actyear ), people_contributions AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid = sf.contributor::integer WHERE p.jury > 4 GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts, MAX(pc.acts_involved) AS max_acts_per_person, AVG(pc.fixes_contributed) AS avg_fixes_per_contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) AS active_people_count FROM court_yearly_stats cys LEFT JOIN people_contributions pc ON cys.court = pc.court WHERE cys.total_acts > 481 AND cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts > 450.31 GROUP BY cys.court, cys.actyear, cys.total_acts, cys.avg_people_per_act, cys.avg_related_acts, cys.total_fixes, cys.high_act_total, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pc.personid) > 81 ORDER BY cys.total_acts DESC, cys.moving_avg_3yr_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 147.12 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 2.53 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS avg_linked_acts_per_actkind, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 94.76 AND l.casenumber < 4038.54 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43.31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 2.55 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_linked_avg, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_max_startdate, MIN(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS highcourt_year_min_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 20 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS cross_link_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate)) AS judge_year_avg_casenumber, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.startdate DESC) AS startdate_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON p.personid = lp2.peopleid AND lp2.actid != l.id LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 301.76 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 75.49 AND 22.82 AND p.jury = 0.44 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 42.46 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 93.71 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate DESC LIMIT 8816.25;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_sample FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 2) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 5 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 10) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 60 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '0' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 972 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS max_casenumber_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 585.12 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AND p.jury > 3.64 AND la2.court = la.court AND la3.court = la.court GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.44 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' AND (la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' AND court = 'CourtA')) OR la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 2))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix WHERE actid = la.id AND fix_description ILIKE '%error%') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 8 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC LIMIT 509;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 933.58 AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 4.15 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 564.49 AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = 2000.48 ) ) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.97 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 93.93 AND (la.court LIKE '%Court%' OR la.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND la.typeofdocument IS NOT NULL AND la.status IN ('final', 'appealed') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 1.4 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.judge AS linked_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS primary_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS primary_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS primary_fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS linked_fix_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_primary_actnumber, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.resultofappeal = la2.resultofappeal THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matching_result_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' AND la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND la2.actnumber < '1' GROUP BY la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 88 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) >= 44 ORDER BY primary_act_count DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(has_fix) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE people_count >= 45 AND linked_acts_count > 77 GROUP BY court ), people_analysis AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.name, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ra.has_fix = 1 THEN lap.actid END) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(ra.linked_acts_count) AS avg_linked_per_act FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lap ON p.personid = lap.peopleid JOIN ranked_acts ra ON lap.actid = ra.id WHERE ra.court_rank <= 722 AND ra.people_count BETWEEN 36 AND 5 GROUP BY p.personid, p.name, p.court ) SELECT cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS
