active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pa.acts_with_fixes) AS max_fixes_by_person, SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY ra.people_count) AS median_people_count FROM court_stats cs JOIN ranked_acts ra ON cs.court = ra.court JOIN people_analysis pa ON cs.court = pa.court WHERE cs.total_acts > 4674 AND cs.avg_people_per_act >= 11.55 AND pa.acts_participated > 9 GROUP BY cs.court, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.max_linked_acts, cs.total_fixes HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 65 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) >= 10.79 AND SUM(ra.linked_acts_count) > 87457 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 16 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY l.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 33 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_future_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 19 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l2.id = ll2.actid1 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid2 = l3.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 482.39 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 38.04 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 16.53 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS total_unique_people, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.actyear) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalacts l_secondary ON ll.actid2 = l_secondary.id JOIN legalact_link ll_secondary ON l_secondary.id = ll_secondary.actid1 JOIN legalacts l_tertiary ON ll_secondary.actid2 = l_tertiary.id WHERE l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.yearhighercourt > 2046.61 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 59.45 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) <= 44.98 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_total_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_distinct_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 537.97 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 68.07 AND 5.8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35.25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 3.7 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 50861) AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.casenumber > '1' OR l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 5 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS distinct_linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people_total_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 267.48 AND l.outnumber < 396.66 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1996.96 AND 2013.29 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22.16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 28.44 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 612.69 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, total_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS cross_link_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_outnumber_avg, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS highcourt_max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.outnumber < '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND l.casenumber >= '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 48 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 77 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 296 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 3 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'Granted' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS acts_with_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_since_date, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN p.personid END) AS jury_members_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.senddate IS NOT NULL AND la.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_both_dates FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.legaldate IS NULL OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 5 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '2000')) AS linked_acts_in_future_year, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_involved, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id AND la2.actyear < la.actyear WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (la.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.jury > 8) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_with_startdate_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(la.legaldate, la.startdate))) AS avg_years_between_start_legal, MAX(la2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(la2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_act_document_types, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS court_legalact_running_total, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS recent_case_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la2.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.motivedate IS NULL OR la.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.senddate) = 2014.54 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2010.25 AND 2009.77 AND la.yearhighercourt > 47.44 AND la.outnumber < 174.62 AND (la.update >= '2000-01-01 00:00:00' OR la.update IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) >= 40.88 AND AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(la.legaldate, la.startdate))) > 46.6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 41.56 ORDER BY court_legalact_running_total DESC, avg_years_between_start_legal DESC, linked_people_count DESC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) + 4 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30d, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_fixes_10row FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 728.83 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.81 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 16.85 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_active_by_court_kind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_by_court_casekind, CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1996' THEN 'Period_A' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2001' AND '2006' THEN 'Period_B' ELSE 'Other_Period' END AS actyear_period, CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt > '2010' THEN 'High_Year_Court' WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NULL THEN 'No_Higher_Court_Year' ELSE 'Standard_Year_Court' END AS highercourt_year_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13 THEN 'High_People_Involvement' WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) = 0 THEN 'No_People_Involved' ELSE 'Moderate_People_Involvement' END AS people_involvement_category FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1995-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '10') AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.highcourt, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 1 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '50' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2010' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag, AVG(CASE WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' THEN la.actnumber ELSE NULL END) AS avg_actnumber_in_range FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '1990' AND la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf1.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND p1.jury > 87 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 29 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf2.actid) AS scrape_sum, AVG(la3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp3.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE la3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < '500' AND p2.jury < 98 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.id HAVING SUM(sf2.actid) < 189800 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, actyear;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.typeofdocument, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.motivedate, la1.senddate, la1.update, la1.casenumber, la1.outnumber, la1.yearhighercourt, la1.hash, la1.actlink, la1.motivelink, la2.actnumber AS linked_actnumber, la2.actyear AS linked_actyear, la2.court AS linked_court, la2.judge AS linked_judge, la2.startdate AS linked_startdate, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_linked_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actyear) AS same_year_links_per_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_people, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt, MAX(la2.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.judge) AS max_linked_startdate_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 508.94 AND la2.actyear >= 2007.77 AND p.jury > 0.36 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.typeofdocument, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.motivedate, la1.senddate, la1.update, la1.casenumber, la1.outnumber, la1.yearhighercourt, la1.hash, la1.actlink, la1.motivelink, la2.actnumber, la2.actyear, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.startdate, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 27.13 AND AVG(la2.actnumber) > 243.73 ORDER BY total_linked_people DESC, la1.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.contributor IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS contributed_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE ( (l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 352.53) OR (l.senddate < '1990-01-01' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court') ) AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') AND (l.actyear BETWEEN 2008.63 AND 2005.52) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 45.71 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 122.35 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.74 AND p.court = l.court ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 38.18 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 92.03 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS max_jury_involved, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT l2.id FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.court = l.court ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.casenumber, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 40 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 12 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 2 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, l1.judge AS root_judge, l1.startdate AS root_startdate, l1.legaldate AS root_legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.court = l1.court THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_same_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ' ORDER BY l2.court) AS all_linked_courts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS all_people_names, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate > l1.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_startdate_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_count_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 4 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < 119.14 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_startdate ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.legaldate, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.actyear, la.court, cumulative_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS rank_in_casekind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 16 ORDER BY la.court, la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS active_cumulative_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 14 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_in_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.judge) AS active_cases_per_judge, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury > 4 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l1.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 6 AND COUNT(*) > 81 EXCEPT SELECT l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l3.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actyear) AS latest_legaldate_in_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN l3.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.judge) AS active_cases_per_judge, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_year, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON l3.id = lp3.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid1 = l4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON l4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp4.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l3.outnumber > '1' AND p2.jury > 4 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.actyear, l3.court, l3.judge, l3.legaldate, l3.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) > 49 AND COUNT(*) > 45 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_number, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 81 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 7.74 ORDER BY act_count DESC, total_act_number DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.legaldate IS NOT NULL) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description LIKE '%error%') AS error_fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 97 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY act_count DESC, court_year_total ASC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 3884.75 AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) >= 7.38 ORDER BY people_count DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 158838 ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_with_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' ) ) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 852 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS linked_act_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber_la1, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) AS median_actnumber_la2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actyear = la2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS same_year_count, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la1.startdate)) AS p75_startyear_la1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS max_fix_description FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la1.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 496.97 AND la2.actnumber > 649.74 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la1.startdate) BETWEEN 2007.79 AND 2002.98 GROUP BY la1.court, la2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) > 201.97 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) < 497.35 AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actnumber) > 203.45 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, court1, court2;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 71 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lpp.peopleid) AS total_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_total_court_case FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_link lp ON la.id = lp.actid1 AND ll.actid2 <> lp.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpp ON la.id = lpp.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 849.46 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 14.16 AND 124.25 AND la.senddate <= '2001-01-01' AND p.jury > 8.3 GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 738.73 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 89.32 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 34563) AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 33 ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actyear AS year, l.court AS court_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court UNION ALL SELECT p.personid AS act_id, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE) AS year, p.court AS court_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ap.actid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS active_acts FROM people p LEFT JOIN legalact_people ap ON p.personid = ap.peopleid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON ap.actid = sf.actid WHERE p.jury > 1 GROUP BY p.personid, p.court;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 723.82 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.35 UNION SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber <= 529.05 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) >= 3.8 ORDER BY legalact_id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_fixes_per_act_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS scrapefix_descriptions, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS rank_by_people_involved FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 3 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND startdate <= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_in_date_range, (SELECT MAX(actnumber) FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.court = la.court AND la2.actkind = la.actkind AND la2.startdate < la.startdate) AS prev_max_actnumber_same_court_kind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 15538.93 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 126.66 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 409.59 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la2.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 885.06 GROUP BY la1.actnumber, la1.actyear, la1.court, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 21.79 AND SUM(la2.actnumber) < 85145.46 INTERSECT SELECT la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(la4.actnumber) AS linked_act_sum, AVG(la4.actyear) AS avg_linked_year FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actnumber < 327.0 GROUP BY la3.actnumber, la3.actyear, la3.court, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 15.85 AND AVG(la4.actyear) > 1998.47 ORDER BY actnumber DESC, actyear;

WITH court_judge_stats AS ( SELECT l.court, l.judge, COUNT(*) AS total_cases, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(l.legaldate) AS first_case_date, MAX(l.legaldate) AS last_case_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(*) > 6 ), linked_act_analysis AS ( SELECT la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, l1.actnumber AS actnum1, l2.actnumber AS actnum2, ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber) AS act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS common_people_count FROM legalact_link la JOIN legalacts l1 ON la.actid1 = l1.id JOIN legalacts l2 ON la.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.actid1, la.actid2, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear, l1.actnumber, l2.actnumber ), scrape_fix_summary AS ( SELECT s.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, STRING_AGG(s.fix_description, '; ') AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT s.contributor) AS unique_contributors FROM scrapefix s JOIN legalacts l ON s.actid = l.id WHERE l.senddate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY s.actid HAVING COUNT(*) >= 1 ) SELECT cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) AS linked_cases_count, AVG(laa.act_number_diff) AS avg_act_number_diff, MAX(laa.common_people_count) AS max_common_people, COUNT(sfs.actid) AS fixed_cases_count, SUM(sfs.fix_count) AS total_fixes_applied FROM court_judge_stats cjs LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cjs.court = l.court AND cjs.judge = l.judge LEFT JOIN linked_act_analysis laa ON l.id IN (laa.actid1, laa.actid2) LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_summary sfs ON l.id = sfs.actid WHERE cjs.total_cases > 372 AND (cjs.granted_appeals >= 37 OR cjs.unique_people_involved > 65) AND NOT (cjs.court LIKE '%Supreme%' AND cjs.avg_act_number < '1') GROUP BY cjs.court, cjs.judge, cjs.total_cases, cjs.avg_act_number, cjs.granted_appeals, cjs.unique_people_involved HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT laa.actid1) > 17 AND SUM(sfs.fix_count) >= 3 ORDER BY cjs.total_cases DESC, avg_act_number_diff DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court AS people_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.judge, '; ') AS judge_list FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 649.45 AND l.outnumber BETWEEN 32.62 AND 16.9 AND l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND l.court IS NOT NULL AND p.jury > 9.69 GROUP BY CUBE(l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.court) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 99.92 AND AVG(l.outnumber) < 74.95 ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_linked_acts_by_case_status, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.actkind) AS judge_actkind_latest_start FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2548.73 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31.5 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 6.0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 > 66689)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 5 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year;

SELECT la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS fiscal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY la.actyear, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 70 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, fiscal_quarter ASC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS active_acts_per_court_year, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS total_fixes, (SELECT MAX(sf2.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS last_fix_description, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank_in_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf_main ON la.id = sf_main.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 310.86 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 9.7 AND 1577.39 AND la.actyear >= 2001.03 AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court of Appeals') AND la.judge IS NOT NULL AND la.actkind IS NOT NULL AND (p.jury = 0.21 OR p.court = 'District Court') AND sf_main.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 15.07 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > 79.71 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS cross_references, AVG(ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber)) AS avg_act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.court) AS referenced_courts_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actyear ), people_engagement AS ( SELECT p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS activity_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS active_people, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS acts_per_person_avg, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_members FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id WHERE l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) ), scrape_fix_metrics AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_processing_years, ca.granted_appeals, ca.max_act_number, COALESCE(laa.cross_references, 0) AS cross_references, COALESCE(laa.avg_act_number_diff, 0) AS avg_act_number_diff, COALESCE(laa.referenced_courts_count, 0) AS referenced_courts_count, COALESCE(pe.active_people, 0) AS active_people, COALESCE(pe.acts_per_person_avg, 0) AS acts_per_person_avg, COALESCE(pe.jury_members, 0) AS jury_members, COALESCE(sfm.fixes_count, 0) AS fixes_count, COALESCE(sfm.unique_contributors, 0) AS unique_contributors, COALESCE(sfm.avg_fix_length, 0) AS avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_activity ca LEFT JOIN linked_acts_analysis laa ON ca.court = laa.court AND ca.actyear = laa.actyear LEFT JOIN people_engagement pe ON ca.court = pe.court AND ca.actyear = pe.activity_year LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_metrics sfm ON ca.court = sfm.court AND ca.actyear = sfm.actyear WHERE ca.total_acts > 515 AND ca.avg_processing_years < 5.25 ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, court_rank ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000') AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 4 ORDER BY num_people DESC, legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_involvement_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 2327.81 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4.03 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 6.88 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON l.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 747.63 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40.77 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 16.57 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 13 ) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS recent_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l3 WHERE l3.court = l.court AND l3.actkind = l.actkind AND l3.legaldate > l.legaldate ORDER BY l3.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 480 ) AND p.jury > 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 37 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid1) AS total_links, SUM(CASE WHEN la.legaldate >= '2020-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_legal_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.motivedate >= '2019-01-01' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_motive_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt > 0 THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_higher_court_year, MAX(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN la.senddate ELSE NULL END) AS latest_active_senddate, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_act_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) DESC) AS global_fix_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people lp ON lap.peopleid = lp.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 OR la.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND la.outnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, lp.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 28 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, total_fixes DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.actnumber) AS median_actnumber, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la.outnumber) AS percentile_75_outnumber, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NULL OR la.yearhighercourt <= '0') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 823 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MIN(sf.fix_description) AS sample_fix, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS linked_act_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15 ORDER BY rolling_30day_people DESC, la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag, AVG(CASE WHEN la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL THEN la.yearhighercourt::numeric ELSE NULL END) AS avg_year_higher_court, MAX(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN la.senddate ELSE NULL END) AS latest_active_senddate, SUM(CASE WHEN la.casenumber > '100' THEN la.outnumber ELSE 0 END) AS high_casenumber_outnumber_sum, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_legaldate_rank, LAG(la.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate) AS prev_actnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL OR la.casenumber IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 6 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, legalact_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 40 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, AVG(p.jury) FILTER (WHERE p.jury IS NOT NULL) AS avg_jury_score FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') ) AND l.casenumber > 242.18 AND (l.typeofdocument = 'Decision' OR l.casekind = 'Civil') AND NOT (l.status = 'Dismissed') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1.1 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;
