SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 685.66 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 21.78 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 7.08 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS later_acts_in_court_case, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.actkind) AS avg_processing_years_by_judge, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.yearhighercourt) AS max_outnumber_in_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND la.outnumber < '0' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court') AND la.status != 'Dismissed' AND p.jury IS NOT NULL AND (sf.contributor IS NULL OR sf.contributor != 'System') AND la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.actlink, la.motivelink, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, la2.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 83 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 26 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, linked_act_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_fix, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, la.legaldate DESC ) AS court_year_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear RANGE BETWEEN 1 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING ) AS avg_linked_acts_3year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, sf.actid ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, SUM(people_count) AS total_people_involved, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY linked_acts_count) AS median_linked_acts FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_year_rank <= 49 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING AVG(people_count) > 9.18 AND COUNT(*) >= 26 ), complex_analysis AS ( SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act, cs.total_people_involved, cs.median_linked_acts, DENSE_RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.actyear ORDER BY ra.cumulative_people DESC, ra.people_count DESC ) AS yearly_people_rank, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate ) AS prev_year_people_count, (ra.people_count - LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER ( PARTITION BY ra.court ORDER BY ra.actyear, ra.startdate )) AS people_count_change FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actyear = cs.actyear WHERE ra.avg_linked_acts_3year > 3.88 ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.id, ca.actnumber, ca.startdate, ca.legaldate, ca.people_count, ca.linked_acts_count, ca.has_fix, ca.court_year_rank, ca.cumulative_people, ca.avg_linked_acts_3year, ca.total_acts, ca.avg_people_per_act, ca.total_people_involved, ca.median_linked_acts, ca.yearly_people_rank, ca.prev_year_people_count, ca.people_count_change, RANK() OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.people_count DESC, ca.linked_acts_count DESC ) AS court_importance_rank, SUM(ca.people_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.actyear, ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS court_cumulative_people, AVG(ca.linked_acts_count) OVER ( PARTITION BY ca.court, ca.actyear ORDER BY ca.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING ) AS moving_avg_linked_acts FROM complex_analysis ca WHERE ca.yearly_people_rank <= 74 AND ca.people_count_change > -1 ORDER BY ca.court, ca.actyear DESC, ca.yearly_people_rank;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_per_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1 ) GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) > 3 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 0 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_casekind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 396.87 AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 6.27 ) GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) >= 36.99 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.82 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 91.76 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON la.id = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap2.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 9230.4 AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 2.69 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_total_people_30days, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_fixes_10acts, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_actnumber_per_court_case FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 743.68 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 24.17 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 18.41 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;
SELECT l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count FROM legalacts l JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND s.actid > 13548 GROUP BY l.actyear ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 50 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, 0 AS scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court, MIN(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS earliest_motivedate_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON l.judge = p.name AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND l.outnumber < '0' AND l.judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 41 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '30 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge ORDER BY l.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '90 days' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_90day_avg_scrapefix, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS max_actnumber_per_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 749.19 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2016.46 AND 1998.63 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 13.05 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 19.57 ORDER BY rolling_30day_people_count DESC, total_linked_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.judge = l.judge AND l2.court = l.court AND l2.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' ORDER BY l2.legaldate DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 13 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 496 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_judge, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 609.11 AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid HAVING COUNT(peopleid) > 34.49 ) AND l.court IN ( SELECT court FROM people WHERE jury = 1 GROUP BY court HAVING COUNT(personid) >= 53.12 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 12.87 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 458.92 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_startdate_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 20 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 38.85 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.92 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS cumulative_people_by_court_actkind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS rank_linked_acts_per_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_scrapefix_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 926.82 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 2.04 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, rank_linked_acts_per_court ASC;

WITH aggregated_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_related_acts, MAX(la.actnumber) AS max_act_number, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 AND AVG(la.yearhighercourt) < '1990' ) SELECT aa.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actkind, aa.num_people, aa.num_related_acts, aa.max_act_number, aa.avg_higher_court_year, aa.num_fixes, p.name AS primary_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) AS total_references, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_related_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM aggregated_acts aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY aa.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.actkind, aa.num_people, aa.num_related_acts, aa.max_act_number, aa.avg_higher_court_year, aa.num_fixes, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) > 87 AND MAX(la.outnumber) < '1' ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_related_acts DESC, court_rank LIMIT 3507;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_actyear_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.motivedate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_motivedate_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 5 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '100' ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND l.motivedate < '2000-01-01') ) AND l.actnumber > 626.54 AND NOT (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.judge IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22.64 OR COUNT(sf.actid) > 17.51 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS cross_link_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_actnumber_sum, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_outnumber_avg, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS highcourt_max_yearhighercourt FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.outnumber < '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' AND l.casenumber >= '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 33 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 16 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, l1.judge AS root_judge, l1.startdate AS root_startdate, l1.legaldate AS root_legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, MAX(l2.actyear) AS max_linked_act_year, MIN(l2.actyear) AS min_linked_act_year, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.court = l1.court THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_acts_same_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.court, ', ' ORDER BY l2.court) AS all_linked_courts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS all_people_names, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.startdate > l1.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS later_startdate_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) DESC) AS link_count_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_count_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND AVG(l2.actnumber) < 294.51 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_startdate ASC LIMIT 1000;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) > 71 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.startdate > la.startdate THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS subsequent_acts_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS linkage_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.yearhighercourt > '0' AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < '1') AND la.casenumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 38 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) >= 20 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, avg_case_duration_years_by_court_kind DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_document_types, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber) AS year_case_dense_rank, LAG(la.startdate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS prev_startdate_same_court, LEAD(la.legaldate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS next_legaldate_same_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS acts_per_year_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.yearhighercourt < '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 368 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate DESC, la.id;

SELECT la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2015' THEN 'RECENT' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2005' AND '2005' THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'OLD' END AS age_category, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt, l1.actyear, l1.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, SUM(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actkind) AS court_actkind_total, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.highcourt, l1.actyear) AS highcourt_year_avg, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp WHERE lp.actid = l1.id) AS people_count, (SELECT MAX(sf.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l1.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l1.id OR ll.actid2 = l1.id) AS total_link_count, p.name AS primary_judge, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) AS distinct_people_in_court FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON (l1.id = ll.actid1 OR l1.id = ll.actid2) JOIN legalacts l2 ON ((ll.actid1 = l2.id AND ll.actid1 != l1.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND ll.actid2 != l1.id)) JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.jury = 1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l1.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid AND p2.court = l1.court WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 961.71 AND l1.actyear BETWEEN 2016.29 AND 2015.6 AND (l1.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l1.highcourt = 'High Court') GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt, l1.actyear, l1.actnumber, l1.id, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 41.19 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 490.19 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, court_actkind_total DESC LIMIT 829.27;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, lp.peopleid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS involved_people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate)) AS running_total_acts FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 956.39 AND la.outnumber < 914.02 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2019.73 AND 1994.53 GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.judge, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), lp.peopleid) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 152.85 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 812.55 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) AS linked_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total_linked_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_casekind_judge, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS latest_startdate_per_highcourt, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind) AS total_acts_per_actkind FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap2 ON ll.actid2 = lap2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 881.14 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2020.05 AND 2022.09 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap2.peopleid) > 8.14 ORDER BY court_year_total_linked_people DESC, linked_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 245 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear > l.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS newer_linked_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 1))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 6830.43 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8.29 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) > 55 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) AS distinct_actnumbers, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS distinct_contributors FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.actnumber) > 94 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.actid AS scrapefix_actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, lal.actid1, lal.actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scrapefix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid1) + COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_link_references, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court_year, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_count_rank, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 391.68 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 88.0 AND 85.85 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 2013.57 AND la.casenumber < 65.16 AND la.actyear = 2014.96 AND p.jury = 0.2 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.actlink, la.motivelink, lp.peopleid, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, sf.actid, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, lal.actid1, lal.actid2 HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 47.02 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 9.19 ORDER BY distinct_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 98 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS latest_legaldate_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, 0 AS scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_outnumber_per_court, MIN(l.motivedate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS earliest_motivedate_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON l.judge = p.name AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND l.outnumber < '0' AND l.judge IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.outnumber, l.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 24 ORDER BY legalact_id, startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 342.57 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 5.83) AND l.casenumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 6.49 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 414.61 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 9.26 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) + 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000') ) AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 13 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(la.legaldate, la.startdate))) AS avg_processing_days FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) - la.actyear BETWEEN 2 AND 2 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.casenumber, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY avg_processing_days DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.casenumber) AS min_casenumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS fix_descriptions, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate)) AS court_caseyear_total, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_count_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.outnumber BETWEEN '0' AND '51' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = '2000' AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) IN ('1', '1') AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court') GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 79 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '10' AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 17 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, start_year, start_quarter;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN la2.actyear ELSE 0 END) AS sum_linked_act_years, AVG(la2.actyear) AS avg_linked_act_year, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) AS median_linked_act_year, PERCENTILE_DISC(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) AS percentile_75_linked_act_year, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS total_scrapefix_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_act_types FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear > '1990' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND p.jury > 91 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.hash, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid2) > 163 AND AVG(la2.actyear) < '1990' AND PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY la2.actyear) BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' ORDER BY linked_acts_count DESC, sum_linked_act_years DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE (la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' AND (la.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000' AND court = 'CourtA')) OR la.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 5))) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix WHERE actid = la.id AND fix_description ILIKE '%error%') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 2 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC LIMIT 329;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_sum_actnumber, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber_by_kind, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_outnumber_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 90.16 AND la.outnumber < 449.89 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 1997.81 AND la.casenumber <= 9867.45 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.13 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 6.19 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN lal.actid1 = la.id THEN lal.actid2 ELSE NULL END) AS linked_acts_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.startdate DESC) AS court_act_rank, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate RANGE BETWEEN INTERVAL '1 year' PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_people_1year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 OR la.id = lal.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), court_stats AS ( SELECT court, actkind, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(people_count) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(linked_acts_count) AS max_linked_acts, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes FROM ranked_acts WHERE court_act_rank <= 50 AND cumulative_people > 446 GROUP BY court, actkind HAVING AVG(people_count) > 48.26 AND COUNT(*) >= 212 ) SELECT ra.*, cs.total_acts AS court_total_acts, cs.avg_people_per_act AS court_avg_people, cs.max_linked_acts AS court_max_linked, cs.total_fixes AS court_total_fixes, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY cs.total_acts DESC, cs.avg_people_per_act DESC) AS court_importance_rank, PERCENT_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.people_count DESC) AS people_percentile, LAG(ra.people_count, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY ra.court, ra.actkind ORDER BY ra.legaldate) AS prev_people_count FROM ranked_acts ra JOIN court_stats cs ON ra.court = cs.court AND ra.actkind = cs.actkind WHERE ra.court_act_rank <= 6 AND ra.avg_people_1year > 8.75 ORDER BY court_importance_rank, ra.court_act_rank, ra.people_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 493 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.status = 'Active') AS avg_active_act_number, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 41 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '500' UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court ORDER BY l2.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, AVG(l2.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l2.status = 'Closed') AS avg_closed_act_number, MAX(s2.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll.actid2 = l3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s2 ON l3.id = s2.actid WHERE l2.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actnumber < '1' AND l2.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l2.court, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 26 AND COUNT(DISTINCT p2.personid) > 26 ORDER BY court, actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear = '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS acts_in_year_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_kind FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' AND (l.court = 'Court A' OR l.actkind = 'Kind A') AND l.actyear > '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 39 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 704.97 AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44.83 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 WHERE (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' OR l.casenumber > '1') AND (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' OR l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') AND NOT (l.yearhighercourt = '2000' AND l.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 0 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 4 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' OR l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01') AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = 'Court A')) OR l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000'))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 15 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 10 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.actyear ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS court_judge_total_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(l.senddate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS latest_senddate_in_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 39.94 AND p.jury > 1.31 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.actyear, lp.peopleid, p.name, p.jury HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 31.95 ORDER BY court_judge_total_fixes DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l1.court AS court_name, l1.actyear AS act_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS total_acts, SUM(l1.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, MIN(l1.startdate) AS earliest_start_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 244 AND SUM(l1.actnumber) < '1000' UNION ALL SELECT p.court AS court_name, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate)::smallint AS send_year, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(l.outnumber) AS sum_out_numbers, AVG(l.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motive_date, MIN(l.senddate) AS earliest_send_date, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) DESC) AS rank_by_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND p.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.senddate)::smallint HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 613 AND SUM(l.outnumber) < '1000' ORDER BY court_name, act_year;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actyear AS act_year, l1.court AS court, l1.judge AS judge, l2.id AS linked_act_id, l2.actyear AS linked_act_year, l2.court AS linked_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS max_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l1.id = sf.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 27 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, max_linked_legal_date DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 200.26 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 39.16 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

WITH act_aggregates AS ( SELECT la.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id ) SELECT aa.id, aa.num_people, aa.num_fixes, aa.avg_act_number, la.court, la.actkind FROM act_aggregates aa JOIN legalacts la ON aa.id = la.id WHERE aa.num_people > 7 AND aa.num_fixes >= 0 ORDER BY aa.num_people DESC, aa.num_fixes DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 4 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, 0 AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) < 5 ORDER BY legalact_id;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, latest_senddate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_fixes_per_judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = l.id) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 550.87 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.court IS NULL) AND l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 0.55)) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 11.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 52.89 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 3 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_linked_start, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_linked_legal_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 17 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, root_act_id;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_highercourt_year_by_court, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_outnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.yearhighercourt > '2000' AND la.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '100' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, lp.peopleid, p.name, la.legaldate, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 25 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 10 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, running_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumbers, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 54 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_3yr FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 9 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 170.15 AND (la.outnumber IS NULL OR la.outnumber < 907.76) GROUP BY la.court, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 95.78 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_quarter DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 972.42 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10.48 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 914.41 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.84 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Judge%' AND l.actyear >= 2005.03 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9.49 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19 AND SUM(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id ORDER BY sf.actid LIMIT 1 OFFSET 399 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 8 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear = '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(sf.actid) = 0 ORDER BY people_count DESC, l.startdate DESC;
