SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_casekind, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt) AS max_yearhighercourt_by_highcourt FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 57.69 AND l.outnumber < 474.99 AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2015.35 AND 2014.36 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44.98 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 7.1 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 47.13 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS act_volume_rank FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 78 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear) AS cumulative_acts_per_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 6) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 38 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 0 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury > 0 GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0 ORDER BY total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 6150 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = 2009 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY people_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 7976.6 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 6.65 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_people_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS related_acts, CASE WHEN la.actyear >= '2020' THEN 'RECENT' WHEN la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2010' THEN 'MIDDLE' ELSE 'OLD' END AS act_age_category, CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 THEN 'HIGH_PARTICIPATION' ELSE 'LOW_PARTICIPATION' END AS participation_level, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS acts_per_year_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury = 0) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.court, la.judge, la.actyear, la.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 0 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, total_people DESC;

WITH act_relationships AS ( SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS related_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, CASE WHEN l1.actlink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_act_link, CASE WHEN l1.motivelink IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS has_motive_link FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 OR l1.id = ll.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON (ll.actid1 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) OR (ll.actid2 = l2.id AND l1.id != l2.id) LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actyear, l1.actlink, l1.motivelink ), people_aggregates AS ( SELECT lp.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT p.jury) AS unique_juries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ') AS people_names FROM legalact_people lp JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE p.jury > 45 GROUP BY lp.actid ), scrape_metrics AS ( SELECT sf.actid, COUNT(*) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, MAX(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS max_fix_length FROM scrapefix sf WHERE LENGTH(sf.fix_description) > 116 GROUP BY sf.actid ), window_analysis AS ( SELECT ar.act_id, ar.actnumber, ar.legaldate, ar.court, ar.actyear, ar.related_acts_count, ar.involved_people_count, ar.has_act_link, ar.has_motive_link, COALESCE(pa.unique_people, 0) AS unique_people, COALESCE(pa.unique_juries, 0) AS unique_juries, pa.people_names, COALESCE(sm.fix_count, 0) AS fix_count, COALESCE(sm.unique_contributors, 0) AS unique_contributors, COALESCE(sm.max_fix_length, 0) AS max_fix_length, SUM(ar.related_acts_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court, ar.actyear) AS court_year_total_relations, AVG(ar.involved_people_count) OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court ORDER BY ar.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_people, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ar.court ORDER BY ar.related_acts_count DESC, ar.involved_people_count DESC) AS court_rank FROM act_relationships ar LEFT JOIN people_aggregates pa ON ar.act_id = pa.actid LEFT JOIN scrape_metrics sm ON ar.act_id = sm.actid WHERE ar.related_acts_count > 25 AND ar.involved_people_count >= 15 ) SELECT court, actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(related_acts_count) AS total_relations, SUM(involved_people_count) AS total_people_involved, AVG(unique_people) AS avg_unique_people, AVG(unique_juries) AS avg_unique_juries, SUM(fix_count) AS total_fixes, AVG(max_fix_length) AS avg_max_fix_length, MAX(court_rank) AS max_court_rank, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY moving_avg_people) AS median_moving_avg_people FROM window_analysis WHERE court_year_total_relations > 497 AND moving_avg_people > 1.58 GROUP BY court, actyear HAVING COUNT(*) > 40 AND SUM(related_acts_count) >= 274 ORDER BY total_relations DESC, total_people_involved DESC LIMIT 99;

SELECT l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 40715) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixed_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 76 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 530 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 23 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, SUM(s.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND SUM(s.actid) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casenumber ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_running FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id AND ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear = '2000' ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC LIMIT 708 OFFSET 7807 ) ) AND l.casenumber IN ( SELECT DISTINCT l2.casenumber FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.actyear = l.actyear AND l2.court = l.court AND l2.actnumber > '0' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 11 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 4 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_acts_per_court_pair, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS max_actnumber_per_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, p.name, p.court, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 5 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS total_people_in_act2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_acts_per_court_pair, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year, MAX(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS max_actnumber_per_court2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, p.name, p.court, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) <= 31 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 47 ORDER BY act_id1 DESC, act_id2 DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la2.actyear IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS linked_act_year_count, AVG(la2.actyear) FILTER (WHERE la2.actyear IS NOT NULL) AS avg_linked_act_year, MAX(la2.startdate) AS max_linked_startdate, MIN(la2.legaldate) AS min_linked_legaldate, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.typeofdocument, ', ') AS linked_document_types, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS link_rank, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY la.actyear, la.casenumber) AS year_case_dense_rank, LAG(la.startdate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS prev_startdate_same_court, LEAD(la.legaldate, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS next_legaldate_same_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS acts_per_year_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.outnumber > '0' AND la.yearhighercourt < '0' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.motivedate, la.senddate, la.update, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.yearhighercourt, la.outnumber, la.hash, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court, p.jury, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 741 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 15 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate DESC, la.id;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS latest_startdate_in_court_year, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS acts_per_judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8036.21 AND l.actyear BETWEEN 2014.74 AND 2021.83 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = l.id AND sf2.fix_description LIKE '%error%') AND (ll1.actid2 IS NOT NULL OR ll2.actid1 IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 35.54 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 4.23 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) AS act_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber, SUM(CASE WHEN l2.actyear > l1.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS future_linked_acts FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l1.id) > 71 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actkind ORDER BY l1.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(l1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_highcourt FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 81.69 GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.startdate, l1.legaldate, l1.court, l1.actkind, l1.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 7.48 UNION SELECT l3.id AS act_id, l3.actnumber, l3.startdate, l3.legaldate, l3.court, l3.actkind, l3.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf3.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.court, l3.actkind ORDER BY l3.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_kind, AVG(l3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l3.highcourt) AS avg_actnumber_highcourt FROM legalacts l3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON l3.id = lp3.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf3 ON l3.id = sf3.actid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts l4 ON ll2.actid1 = l4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON l4.id = lp4.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf4 ON l4.id = sf4.actid JOIN people p3 ON lp3.peopleid = p3.personid JOIN people p4 ON lp4.peopleid = p4.personid WHERE l3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l3.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l3.actnumber > 243.18 GROUP BY l3.id, l3.actnumber, l3.startdate, l3.legaldate, l3.court, l3.actkind, l3.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) > 43.55 ORDER BY act_id;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS num_links, MAX(la.legaldate) AS max_legaldate, MIN(la.motivedate) AS min_motivedate FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.motivedate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.outnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 8 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '10' ORDER BY num_people DESC, sum_actnumber ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Closed' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS closed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 92 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_actnumber, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 456.91 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 29.26 ORDER BY total_actnumber DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19 UNION ALL SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear < '1990' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS older_acts_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 0 ORDER BY startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 AND SUM(sf.actid) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_people DESC, fix_sum DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l2.id AS act_id2, l1.court AS court1, l2.court AS court2, l1.actyear AS year1, l2.actyear AS year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(l1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count2, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate1, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate2, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank, LAG(l1.actnumber, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court ORDER BY l1.legaldate) AS prev_actnumber1 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON l1.court = l2.court AND l1.actyear = l2.actyear AND l1.id <> l2.id JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 AND l2.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid AND lp1.peopleid = lp2.peopleid JOIN people p ON lp1.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > 20027.23 AND l2.actnumber > 14541.42 GROUP BY l1.id, l2.id, l1.court, l2.court, l1.actyear, l2.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 765.55 AND AVG(l1.actnumber) < 7601.08 ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate1 DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 457 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 179.5 AND (la.casenumber < 1.97 OR la.casenumber IS NULL) AND la.typeofdocument = 'Decree' AND la.court IN ('Supreme Court', 'Appeals Court') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 11.9 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1.7 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS casekind_status_avg_links, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_latest_startdate, MIN(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS highcourt_year_earliest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 833.57 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 99.29 AND 524.14 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 42.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 14.31 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, total_linked_acts DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_actnumber FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 3138.99 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 31.43 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14.54 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 6 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, people_count ASC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER(PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear > '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 3 ) ) ) GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > (SELECT AVG(actnumber) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = la.actyear) ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_acts_per_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.actnumber > 0) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 89 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.court, legal_quarter;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_out_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_list, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixes_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.contributor, ', ' ORDER BY sf.contributor) AS contributors_list FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 18.77 AND la.outnumber < 913.28 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2005.97 AND 2017.7 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 64.66 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 599.54 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, sum_act_numbers DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_linked_total, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS latest_startdate_by_judge FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lpe ON la.id = lpe.actid JOIN people p ON lpe.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lpe2 ON la2.id = lpe2.actid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lpe2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la.id = lp2.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (la.typeofdocument LIKE '%Act%' OR la.casekind LIKE '%Civil%') AND la.status NOT LIKE '%Draft%' AND (p.name LIKE '%John%' OR p.court LIKE '%Supreme%') AND la.actnumber > 110.44 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 33.44 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > 193.44 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap_outer ON la.id = lap_outer.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap_outer.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 92.08 AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) <= 42.78 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 287.35 AND la.outnumber < 740.67 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 19.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 9.08 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 2950 ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_links_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS max_actnumber_in_court_case FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.judge IS NOT NULL OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 45 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, MIN(l.legaldate) AS earliest_legaldate, MAX(l.senddate) AS latest_senddate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind), (l.court, l.actyear), (l.court), () ) ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear, l.actkind;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE actid > 5415 ) AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.court = 'Supreme Court' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS supreme_court_acts_per_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 794.95 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ORDER BY ll.actid2 LIMIT 1 OFFSET 67.23 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 20.43 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_involved, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 28 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < '0' ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS rolling_30day_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 390.96 AND p.jury > 2.42 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45.43 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC, rolling_30day_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge, la.casekind) AS judge_casekind_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_max_casenumber FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 423.69 AND la.casenumber < 2978.71 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2004.05 AND 2022.86 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44.27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 7.95 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) < 54.5 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(la.actid2) AS total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(l.yearhighercourt) AS max_year_higher_court, MIN(l.casenumber) AS min_case_number, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS jury_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link la ON l.id = la.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt < '1990' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 44 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '100' AND MAX(l.yearhighercourt) >= '2000' ORDER BY judge_count DESC, total_links DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Smith%' AND l.actyear >= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS judge_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' AND p.jury = 1 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 4 ORDER BY judge_rank;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_fixes FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 79 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(CASE WHEN s.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS num_fixes FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8.46 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) AS start_quarter, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted_appeals, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.outnumber) AS max_out_number, MIN(la.yearhighercourt) AS min_year_higher_court, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS total_scrape_fixes, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS involved_people_names, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS court_case_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 534.23 AND la.outnumber < 303.83 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2060.98 AND 2044.57 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) >= 2019.26 AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) IN (3.21, 2.86) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate), EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 27.32 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.36 AND SUM(CASE WHEN la.resultofappeal = 'ACCEPTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 51.97 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, start_year DESC, start_quarter DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS final_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 1) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 144 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind ORDER BY l.actyear, l.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_case, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_linked_acts_per_judge, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS latest_startdate_in_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 12 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 2 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count ASC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(l2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_linked_startdate FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 3 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 4 UNION ALL SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total, AVG(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_out_number_per_year, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motive_date FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid2 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid1 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear <= '2000' AND l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.outnumber < '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) < 46 ORDER BY court_total DESC, act_count ASC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS distinct_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS distinct_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS distinct_scraped_acts FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 198 ORDER BY l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_actkind, MAX(l.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS max_legaldate_per_court, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS people_names FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND l.actkind IN ('Decree', 'Decision', 'Order') AND l.status = 'Active' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) BETWEEN 2 AND 16 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, legaldate ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_act_flag_sum FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid INNER JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 936.66 AND (l.motivedate IS NULL OR l.motivedate >= '2000-01-01') AND l.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 32.92 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 821.51 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 73 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_act_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 936.5 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 18.38 AND 78.15 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) = 2002.64 GROUP BY CUBE(la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 937.5 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 23.65 ORDER BY legal_year DESC, legal_month DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_by_highcourt_kind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.id) AS recency_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.casenumber > '1' AND (la.highcourt IS NOT NULL OR la.court IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 46 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 9 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS descendant_count, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_descendant_date, MAX(l2.legaldate) AS latest_descendant_date, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 81 ORDER BY descendant_count DESC, root_act_id;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS acts_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 605.3 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_30days, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_actnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_year_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 388.63 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1990.51 AND 1994.75 AND p.jury = 0.4 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.yearhighercourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 16.63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 17.62 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_legaldate, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber, MAX(l.outnumber) AS max_outnumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l.casekind, ', ') AS casekinds FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND (l.outnumber > '0' OR l.outnumber IS NULL) GROUP BY CUBE(l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, lp.peopleid, p.name) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 2 AND (SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 173 OR MAX(l.outnumber) < '0') ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.actyear, l.court;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_scrapefixes, SUM(COUNT(sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_fixes_by_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_people_per_case_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 699.27 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4.6 ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actkind) AS court_actkind_total_links, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_fixes_per_judge, MAX(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate)) AS max_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8825.2 AND (l.court LIKE '%Court%' OR l.judge LIKE '%Judge%') AND l.actkind IS NOT NULL AND p.name IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, l.actkind, p.name HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 28.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14.4 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.legaldate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_judge, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_linked_acts_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll_sub WHERE ll_sub.actid1 IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people p_sub WHERE p_sub.court = l.court))) AS total_linked_acts_in_court_network FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 173.5 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6.84 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 857.72 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 53 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, '; ' ORDER BY sf.fix_description) AS all_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_involved, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid2 = la3.id WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la3.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 7 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 112.17 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS active_cases_per_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS num_links_as_source, (SELECT AVG(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid > la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS avg_scrapefix_id_higher, MAX(p.jury) AS max_jury_value FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll1.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 964.74 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2005.34 AND 2002.14 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 23.11 AND MAX(p.jury) IS NOT NULL ORDER BY num_people_involved DESC, la.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrape_fixes_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN 30 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_people_count_30_days, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.legaldate ROWS BETWEEN 10 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS moving_avg_linked_acts_10_rows, MAX(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt ORDER BY la.motivedate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS max_scrape_fixes_to_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.casenumber >= '1' AND la.actnumber >= '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.motivedate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 36 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 9 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la1.court AS court_name, la1.actyear AS act_year, la1.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_involved, MAX(la1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.casekind, ', ') AS case_kinds FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.court, la1.actyear, la1.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 73 AND MAX(la1.legaldate) <= '2000-01-01' UNION SELECT la3.court AS court_name, la3.actyear AS act_year, la3.judge AS judge_name, COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp3.peopleid) AS people_involved, MAX(la3.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date, SUM(CASE WHEN la3.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(la3.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la3.casekind, ', ') AS case_kinds FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp3 ON la3.id = lp3.actid JOIN people p3 ON lp3.peopleid = p3.personid JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la3.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON ll2.actid1 = la4.id JOIN legalact_people lp4 ON la4.id = lp4.actid JOIN people p4 ON lp4.peopleid = p4.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.actyear >= '2000' AND la3.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la3.court, la3.actyear, la3.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la3.id) > 76 AND MAX(la3.legaldate) <= '2000-01-01' ORDER BY act_count DESC, latest_legal_date DESC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE l.actnumber > 276.84) AS avg_actnumber_filtered, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 42.42 UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, NULL AS actyear, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l2.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT l2.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 WHERE l2.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' AND l2.yearhighercourt > 2078.65 GROUP BY l2.court HAVING AVG(l2.outnumber) < 10.74 ORDER BY court, actyear NULLS LAST;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > (SELECT AVG(actyear) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear IS NOT NULL AND actyear > '1990') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_avg_year_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 0 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_root_legal_date, MIN(l2.startdate) AS earliest_linked_start_date FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l2.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) > 2 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 548.37 AND p.jury = 0.69 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 15.35 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < 460.34 ORDER BY act_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS num_people_involved, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id) AS count_linked_acts_as_source, (SELECT AVG(sf.actid) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid > la.id AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS avg_scrapefix_id_higher FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '1990' AND '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 23 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.actnumber DESC) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank, AVG(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS avg_outnumber_by_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 749.47 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 97.63 AND 64.15 AND la.yearhighercourt >= 2017.16 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, la.casekind, la.outnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1.91 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 14.98 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_people, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_actyear) FROM (SELECT la.court, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_actyear FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear > '2000' GROUP BY la.court) sub WHERE sub.court = l.court) AS max_actyear_in_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND l.court = p.court JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id AND l2.actyear > '1990' LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l2.id = ll2.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid2 = l3.id AND l3.startdate >= '2000-01-01' WHERE l.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND l.legaldate IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 31 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 94 ORDER BY total_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS related_acts, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.yearhighercourt ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS running_actnumber_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.yearhighercourt BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) = 2013 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, l.yearhighercourt, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 41 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) >= 71 ORDER BY total_people DESC, running_actnumber_sum DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.actyear = '2000' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN ( SELECT actid FROM scrapefix WHERE contributor = 'A' ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY judge_count DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT la1.id AS root_act_id, la1.actyear AS root_year, la1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_linked_act_number, MAX(la2.actyear) AS max_linked_year FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link lal ON la1.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la2.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la2.id = sf.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actyear, la1.court ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT an.root_court, COUNT(*) AS total_networks, SUM(an.linked_acts_count) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(an.involved_people_count) AS total_people, AVG(an.avg_linked_act_number) AS court_avg_act_number, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.75) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY an.max_linked_year) AS court_75p_linked_year FROM act_networks an GROUP BY an.root_court ), people_activity AS ( SELECT p.personid, p.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.actid) AS acts_participated, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixes_contributed, MIN(la.startdate) AS first_activity_date, MAX(la.legaldate) AS last_activity_date FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid =
