la.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON p.personid::text = sf.contributor WHERE la.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.personid, p.court ) SELECT cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year, COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) AS active_people_count, AVG(pa.acts_participated) AS avg_acts_per_person, SUM(pa.fixes_contributed) AS total_fixes, PERCENTILE_CONT(0.9) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY pa.acts_participated) AS people_90p_activity FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people_activity pa ON cm.root_court = pa.court WHERE cm.total_linked_acts > 4567 AND cm.court_75p_linked_year >= '2000' GROUP BY cm.root_court, cm.total_networks, cm.total_linked_acts, cm.total_people, cm.court_avg_act_number, cm.court_75p_linked_year HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pa.personid) > 99 AND AVG(pa.acts_participated) > 35 ORDER BY cm.total_linked_acts DESC, active_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(CASE WHEN la.actkind = 'Final' THEN la.actnumber END) AS avg_final_act_number, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.casenumber IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 64 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(CASE WHEN sf.actid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fixed_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (p.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 461 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 12 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 4 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, court_rank;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS rank_in_casekind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 48 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 14 ORDER BY la.court, la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.actnumber > '1' OR l.id IN ( SELECT ll.actid1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid2 IN ( SELECT la.id FROM legalacts la WHERE la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ) )) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 41 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ') AS aggregated_actkinds, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.actid IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'A') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 63 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 13 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.legaldate) AS latest_legaldate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 14 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, latest_legaldate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.startdate <= '1995-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) - EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.startdate) >= 8 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 9078.5 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = l.id ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3.72 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS total_people_in_court, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_fixes_per_judge, (SELECT MAX(sub.max_actyear) FROM (SELECT la.court, MAX(la.actyear) AS max_actyear FROM legalacts la WHERE la.actyear > '1900' GROUP BY la.court) sub WHERE sub.court = l.court) AS max_actyear_in_court_filtered FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND p.court = l.court LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '1900-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '0' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 600757 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 766283 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.actkind ORDER BY la.actnumber DESC) AS act_rank_by_kind, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 8275.96 AND la.casenumber < 1387.05 AND la.actyear BETWEEN 2013.74 AND 1999.87 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 25.42 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 0.74 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS act_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12 ORDER BY people_rank, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 4 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE l.id IN ( SELECT DISTINCT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 54 ) ) AND l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 11 ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) AS start_year, COUNT(*) AS total_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la.court, la.casekind, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.startdate) HAVING COUNT(*) > 14 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear) AS total_people_per_year, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.id, la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS avg_casenumber_per_judge FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.casenumber > '1' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0 ) AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM legalacts l2 WHERE l2.id = ll.actid2 AND l2.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 27 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 0 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid1 = la.id) AS link_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid = la.id) AS people_count, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid2) AS linked_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_actnumber_by_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la.id = lal1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la.id = lal2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.yearhighercourt < '1990' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) > 9 ORDER BY link_count DESC, unique_people DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.judge) AS max_actnumber_by_judge FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.casenumber BETWEEN '1' AND '50' AND la.actyear >= '2010' AND (la.status = 'Active' OR la.court = 'Supreme Court') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 3 AND SUM(la.actnumber) > '100' ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l INNER JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

WITH ranked_acts AS ( SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, la.actnumber DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind ), linked_acts AS ( SELECT ra1.id AS act_id1, ra2.id AS act_id2, ra1.court AS court1, ra2.court AS court2, ra1.legaldate AS date1, ra2.legaldate AS date2, ABS(ra1.num_people - ra2.num_people) AS people_diff FROM ranked_acts ra1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll ON ra1.id = ll.actid1 INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra2 ON ll.actid2 = ra2.id WHERE ra1.court <> ra2.court AND ra1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, AVG(ra.num_people) AS avg_people_per_act, MAX(ra.num_fixes) AS max_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS unique_judges, SUM(CASE WHEN la.actkind = '{{p5}}' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS specific_act_count FROM legalacts la INNER JOIN ranked_acts ra ON la.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN people p ON la.court = p.court AND p.jury = 3 WHERE la.motivedate IS NOT NULL AND la.senddate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 8128 AND AVG(ra.num_people) >= 24.15 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) AS cross_court_links, AVG(la.people_diff) AS avg_people_difference, MAX(ra.court_rank) AS max_court_rank, SUM(CASE WHEN ra.num_fixes > 8 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS high_fix_acts FROM court_metrics cm LEFT JOIN legalacts l ON cm.court = l.court LEFT JOIN ranked_acts ra ON l.id = ra.id LEFT JOIN linked_acts la ON l.id = la.act_id1 WHERE l.yearhighercourt IS NOT NULL AND l.outnumber >= '1' GROUP BY cm.court, cm.total_acts, cm.avg_people_per_act, cm.max_fixes, cm.unique_judges, cm.specific_act_count HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.act_id1) > 423 AND AVG(la.people_diff) <= 24.07 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, cross_court_links DESC LIMIT 475;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.motivedate, la1.senddate, la1.actyear, la1.casenumber, la1.outnumber, la1.yearhighercourt, la1.typeofdocument, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal1.actid2) AS link_count, SUM(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court ORDER BY la1.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la1.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_kind FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid JOIN legalact_link lal1 ON la1.id = lal1.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal1.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > '1' AND p1.jury = 9 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.motivedate, la1.senddate, la1.actyear, la1.casenumber, la1.outnumber, la1.yearhighercourt, la1.typeofdocument, la1.court, la1.casekind, la1.resultofappeal, la1.status, la1.judge, la1.actkind, la1.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 18 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) < 5 INTERSECT SELECT la3.id AS act_id, la3.actnumber, la3.startdate, la3.legaldate, la3.motivedate, la3.senddate, la3.actyear, la3.casenumber, la3.outnumber, la3.yearhighercourt, la3.typeofdocument, la3.court, la3.casekind, la3.resultofappeal, la3.status, la3.judge, la3.actkind, la3.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fix_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lal2.actid1) AS link_count, SUM(la3.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.court ORDER BY la3.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la3.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la3.casekind) AS avg_casenumber_by_kind FROM legalacts la3 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid JOIN legalact_link lal2 ON la3.id = lal2.actid2 JOIN legalacts la4 ON lal2.actid1 = la4.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la3.id = sf2.actid WHERE la3.motivedate >= '2000-01-01' AND la3.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la3.outnumber > '1' AND p2.jury = 6 GROUP BY la3.id, la3.actnumber, la3.startdate, la3.legaldate, la3.motivedate, la3.senddate, la3.actyear, la3.casenumber, la3.outnumber, la3.yearhighercourt, la3.typeofdocument, la3.court, la3.casekind, la3.resultofappeal, la3.status, la3.judge, la3.actkind, la3.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 19 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) < 2 ORDER BY act_id DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, MAX(l.motivedate) AS latest_motivedate FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 8921.98 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) < 8.68 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 3.76 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE (l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' OR l.startdate >= '2000-01-01') AND l.casenumber > '1' AND NOT (l.status = '{{p5}}' AND l.actkind = '{{p6}}') GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 1 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.highcourt, la.actkind) AS avg_casenumber_by_highcourt_actkind, ( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll2 WHERE ll2.actid1 = la.id AND ll2.actid2 IN ( SELECT la2.id FROM legalacts la2 WHERE la2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la2.court = la.court ) ) AS linked_acts_count, ( SELECT MAX(p.jury) FROM people p WHERE p.personid IN ( SELECT lap2.peopleid FROM legalact_people lap2 WHERE lap2.actid = la.id ) AND p.court = la.court ) AS max_jury_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lap ON la.id = lap.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts la_linked ON ll.actid2 = la_linked.id LEFT JOIN people p ON lap.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '1990-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 990.17 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 267.41 AND 535.51 AND la.actyear IN (2013.07, 2019.8, 2003.81) AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.highcourt = 'High Court') GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) > 6.58 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 18.65 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people DESC;

SELECT l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(*) AS act_count, SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) AS fixed_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(*) > 45 AND SUM(s.fix_description IS NOT NULL::int) < 46 ORDER BY l.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > '2000' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS recent_acts_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber BETWEEN '1' AND '500' AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR l.judge IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 1 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS running_actnumber_sum_by_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 37.48 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 21.92 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_quarter, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) AS send_month, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.court ORDER BY EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate)) AS cumulative_acts_by_quarter, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) DESC) AS rank_by_act_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 647.5 AND la.outnumber < 368.98 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 1999.76 AND 2005.62 AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) = 2001.33 GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.senddate) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 36.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 12.22 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 90.49 ORDER BY total_acts DESC, legal_quarter ASC, send_month ASC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.actyear > (SELECT AVG(actyear) FROM legalacts WHERE actyear IS NOT NULL AND actyear > '1990') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS above_avg_year_flag FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 3 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, SUM(sf.actid) AS fix_sum FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 > 81166) AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 2 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actyear, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS num_fixes, AVG(l.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id, l.actyear, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY num_people DESC, l.actyear;

SELECT la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_year, EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate) AS legal_month, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_act_count, SUM(la.actnumber) AS total_act_numbers, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.senddate) AS latest_send, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS people_names FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON la.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 314.89 AND la.outnumber BETWEEN 30.03 AND 62.54 AND la.startdate <= '1990-01-01' GROUP BY CUBE( la.court, la.casekind, la.actkind, la.highcourt, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM la.legaldate), EXTRACT(MONTH FROM la.legaldate), p.court ) HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 42.59 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 53.57 ORDER BY act_count DESC, legal_year, legal_month;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 1 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_member_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_year, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' OR l.motivedate <= '2000-01-01') AND l.actnumber > '1' AND (l.id IN (SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = 'Court A')) OR l.id IN (SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link WHERE actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear = '2000'))) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 AND SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) >= 6 ORDER BY unique_people_count DESC, l.actyear ASC;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, SUM(CASE WHEN la.status = 'Active' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS active_acts, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 45 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, total_acts DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year, AVG(la.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.casekind, la.status) AS avg_casenumber_by_casekind_status, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = la.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT p.personid FROM people p WHERE p.jury = 1)) AS jury_people_count, (SELECT MAX(sf2.fix_description) FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = la.id AND sf2.contributor IS NOT NULL) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 186.3 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 853.29 AND 137.52 AND la.actyear = 2019.05 AND la.court = 'Supreme Court' AND la.casekind = 'Civil' AND la.status = 'Pending' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 39.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 15.92 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 2.25 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, cumulative_actnumber_by_court_year ASC LIMIT 738.33;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.actkind ORDER BY la1.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la1.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court, la1.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la1.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la1.court) AS max_outnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 115.86 GROUP BY la1.id, la1.actnumber, la1.startdate, la1.legaldate, la1.court, la1.judge, la1.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 49.89 UNION SELECT la2.id AS act_id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.actkind ORDER BY la2.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court, la2.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la2.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la2.court) AS max_outnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll.actid2 = la3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp2.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la2.legaldate <= '1990-01-01' AND la3.actyear = 2011.99 AND p.jury IS NOT NULL GROUP BY la2.id, la2.actnumber, la2.startdate, la2.legaldate, la2.court, la2.judge, la2.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) < 61.56 ORDER BY act_id DESC, startdate;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(p.personid) FILTER (WHERE p.jury = 1) AS max_jury_person_id FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear, l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 17 UNION ALL SELECT l2.court, l2.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT l2.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS court_total_acts, AVG(l2.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS avg_act_number_per_year, MAX(p2.personid) FILTER (WHERE p2.jury = 1) AS max_jury_person_id FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l2.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll.actid2 = l3.id JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l3.id = lp2.actid JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l3.id = sf2.actid WHERE l2.actyear >= '2000' AND l3.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND l2.actnumber > '1' AND l3.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l2.court, l2.actyear, l2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.contributor) > 2 ORDER BY court_total_acts DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate DESC) AS recent_act_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id OR ll2.actid1 = l2.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 433.14 AND (l.court = 'Supreme Court' OR p.court = 'Supreme Court') AND l.judge IS NOT NULL AND p.jury > 2.85 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 32.53 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 12.03 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court AS person_court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_total_links, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status, MAX(l.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge) AS judge_latest_start FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE ( (l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01') OR (l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01') OR (l.senddate IS NOT NULL AND l.senddate < '2000-01-01') ) AND ( (l.actnumber > 461.75 AND l.actyear = 2015.98) OR (l.court = 'Supreme Court' AND l.status IN ('Final', 'Appealed')) OR (l.judge IS NOT NULL AND l.casekind <> 'Civil') ) AND NOT ( l.resultofappeal = 'Dismissed' OR (l.highcourt IS NULL AND l.yearhighercourt < 2014.14) ) AND p.jury > 4.95 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.name, p.jury, p.court, sf.fix_description, sf.contributor HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) >= 95.84 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < 183.45 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, l.startdate;
