SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.judge, l.court) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid FROM legalact_people WHERE peopleid IN ( SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury > 0 ) ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 43 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber, MAX(la.yearhighercourt) AS max_yearhighercourt, MIN(la.casenumber) AS min_casenumber, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, ', ') AS people_names, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT sf.fix_description, ' | ') AS fix_descriptions FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 613.7 AND la.outnumber < 150.15 AND la.yearhighercourt BETWEEN 2011.04 AND 2020.49 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.typeofdocument, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > (SELECT AVG(peopleid_count) FROM (SELECT actid, COUNT(DISTINCT peopleid) AS peopleid_count FROM legalact_people GROUP BY actid) sub) AND SUM(la.actnumber) > 5347.8 AND AVG(la.outnumber) < 213.31 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, sum_actnumber DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS avg_actnumber_per_court_kind, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate DESC) AS recent_rank_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 749.07 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 0.19) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 22.12 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) > 1.47 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la1.actyear AS year1, la2.actyear AS year2, la1.court AS court1, la2.court AS court2, la1.judge AS judge1, la2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) AS acts_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) AS acts_count_year2, SUM(CASE WHEN la1.actnumber > la2.actnumber THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acts_number_greater_count, AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year1, AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) AS avg_actnumber_year2, MAX(la1.startdate) AS latest_start_year1, MAX(la2.startdate) AS latest_start_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS unique_people_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS unique_people_year2, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.actid) AS fixes_count_year1, COUNT(DISTINCT sf2.actid) AS fixes_count_year2, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la1.actkind, ', ') AS actkinds_year1, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la2.actkind, ', ') AS actkinds_year2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON la1.court = la2.court AND la1.judge = la2.judge AND la1.actyear < la2.actyear LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la1.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la2.id = ll2.actid2 WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actnumber > 518.7 AND la2.actnumber < 47.98 GROUP BY la1.actyear, la2.actyear, la1.court, la2.court, la1.judge, la2.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la1.id) > 76.86 AND COUNT(DISTINCT la2.id) > 99.68 AND AVG(la1.actnumber::numeric) < AVG(la2.actnumber::numeric) ORDER BY la1.actyear DESC, la2.actyear DESC, acts_number_greater_count DESC;

SELECT la1.id AS act_id1, la2.id AS act_id2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, AVG(la1.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber1, AVG(la2.actnumber) AS avg_actnumber2, SUM(CASE WHEN sf1.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count1, SUM(CASE WHEN sf2.fix_description IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS fix_count2 FROM legalacts la1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON la1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON la1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON la2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON la1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON la2.id = sf2.actid WHERE la1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la2.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la1.actyear >= '2000' AND la2.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la1.id, la2.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 10 AND AVG(la1.actnumber) > '1' ORDER BY shared_people_count DESC, avg_actnumber1 DESC;

WITH act_networks AS ( SELECT lal.actid1, lal.actid2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS shared_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf1.fix_description) AS shared_fixes_count FROM legalact_link lal JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON lal.actid1 = lp1.actid JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON lal.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON lal.actid1 = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON lal.actid2 = sf2.actid GROUP BY lal.actid1, lal.actid2 ), court_metrics AS ( SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS fixed_acts_count, COUNT(DISTINCT la.judge) AS unique_judges, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(DISTINCT la.casekind) AS case_kind_variety FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.senddate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear ), people_networks AS ( SELECT p.personid, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS involved_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT an.actid2) AS network_connections, COUNT(DISTINCT la.court) AS courts_worked_in, COUNT(DISTINCT la.actkind) AS act_kinds_handled, AVG(la.yearhighercourt) AS avg_higher_court_year FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts la ON lp.actid = la.id LEFT JOIN act_networks an ON la.id = an.actid1 WHERE p.jury > 4 AND la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' GROUP BY p.personid HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 93 ) SELECT cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) AS active_network_people, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.network_connections) AS distinct_network_sizes, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.courts_worked_in) AS court_mobility_levels, COUNT(DISTINCT pn.act_kinds_handled) AS expertise_diversity, AVG(pn.involved_acts) AS avg_acts_per_person, MAX(pn.avg_higher_court_year) AS max_avg_higher_court_year FROM court_metrics cm JOIN people p ON cm.court = p.court JOIN people_networks pn ON p.personid = pn.personid WHERE cm.total_acts > 49 AND cm.unique_people >= 87 GROUP BY cm.court, cm.actyear, cm.total_acts, cm.unique_people, cm.fixed_acts_count, cm.unique_judges, cm.avg_act_number, cm.case_kind_variety HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT pn.personid) > 47 AND AVG(pn.involved_acts) < 251 ORDER BY cm.total_acts DESC, active_network_people DESC;

WITH court_activity AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, AVG(EXTRACT(YEAR FROM AGE(l.legaldate, l.startdate))) AS avg_processing_years, SUM(CASE WHEN l.resultofappeal = 'GRANTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS granted_appeals, MAX(l.actnumber) AS max_act_number FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid WHERE l.legaldate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ), linked_acts_analysis AS ( SELECT l1.court, l1.actyear, COUNT(*) AS cross_references, AVG(ABS(l1.actnumber - l2.actnumber)) AS avg_act_number_diff, COUNT(DISTINCT l2.court) AS referenced_courts_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l1.senddate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.court, l1.actyear ), people_engagement AS ( SELECT p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) AS activity_year, COUNT(DISTINCT p.personid) AS active_people, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS acts_per_person_avg, SUM(CASE WHEN p.jury = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS jury_members FROM people p JOIN legalact_people lp ON p.personid = lp.peopleid JOIN legalacts l ON lp.actid = l.id WHERE l.motivedate BETWEEN '2000-01-01' AND '2000-01-01' GROUP BY p.court, EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) ), scrape_fix_metrics AS ( SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fixes_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.contributor) AS unique_contributors, AVG(LENGTH(sf.fix_description)) AS avg_fix_length FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.update >= '2020-01-01 00:00:00' GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear ) SELECT ca.court, ca.actyear, ca.total_acts, ca.unique_people, ca.avg_processing_years, ca.granted_appeals, ca.max_act_number, COALESCE(laa.cross_references, 0) AS cross_references, COALESCE(laa.avg_act_number_diff, 0) AS avg_act_number_diff, COALESCE(laa.referenced_courts_count, 0) AS referenced_courts_count, COALESCE(pe.active_people, 0) AS active_people, COALESCE(pe.acts_per_person_avg, 0) AS acts_per_person_avg, COALESCE(pe.jury_members, 0) AS jury_members, COALESCE(sfm.fixes_count, 0) AS fixes_count, COALESCE(sfm.unique_contributors, 0) AS unique_contributors, COALESCE(sfm.avg_fix_length, 0) AS avg_fix_length, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ca.court ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC) AS court_rank FROM court_activity ca LEFT JOIN linked_acts_analysis laa ON ca.court = laa.court AND ca.actyear = laa.actyear LEFT JOIN people_engagement pe ON ca.court = pe.court AND ca.actyear = pe.activity_year LEFT JOIN scrape_fix_metrics sfm ON ca.court = sfm.court AND ca.actyear = sfm.actyear WHERE ca.total_acts > 968 AND ca.avg_processing_years < 8.87 ORDER BY ca.total_acts DESC, court_rank ASC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS num_linked_acts, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS max_outnumber_per_court_casekind FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 964.14 AND la.outnumber < 29.79 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.outnumber, la.casekind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3.8 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 6.09 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, s.fix_description, s.contributor, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, SUM(CASE WHEN l.legaldate IS NOT NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_legal_count, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_casekind, MAX(l.outnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.highcourt, l.actyear) AS max_outnumber_by_highcourt_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.motivedate) = 2016 AND (l.senddate - l.startdate) > 13 AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND l.yearhighercourt > '0' AND l.casenumber < '1' AND l.outnumber >= '0' AND l.actlink IS NOT NULL AND l.motivelink IS NOT NULL AND l.hash IS NOT NULL AND l.typeofdocument IN ('TypeA', 'TypeA', 'TypeA') AND l.court LIKE 'Court%' AND l.casekind = 'KindA' AND l.resultofappeal <> 'ResultA' AND l.status = 'StatusA' AND l.judge LIKE 'Judge%' AND l.actkind = 'ActKindA' AND l.highcourt LIKE 'HighCourt%' AND p.jury = 1 AND p.court = 'CourtA' AND s.contributor IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.update, l.actyear, l.yearhighercourt, l.casenumber, l.outnumber, l.actlink, l.motivelink, l.hash, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.jury, p.name, p.court, s.fix_description, s.contributor, l.court, l.actyear, l.casekind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 93 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 44 AND AVG(l.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, involved_people_count DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, COUNT(sf.actid) AS total_fixes FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ( (la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind), (la.court, la.actyear), (la.court), () ) ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actkind;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id OR ll.actid2 = la.id) AS total_links, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.startdate) AS cumulative_actnumber_by_court, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS max_actnumber_in_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la_linked1 ON ll1.actid2 = la_linked1.id LEFT JOIN legalacts la_linked2 ON ll2.actid1 = la_linked2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 523.74 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 4.6) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_people lp_sub WHERE lp_sub.actid = la.id AND lp_sub.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE court = la.court)) > 5.12 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10.73 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) < 9.56 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court) AS avg_acts_per_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.casenumber > '1' OR la.outnumber < '1') GROUP BY la.actnumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 10 AND COUNT(sf.actid) <= 2 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count ASC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, AVG(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER ( PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.actyear, la.actnumber ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW ) AS moving_avg_people FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.actyear <= '2000' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 8 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear, la.actnumber;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = l.id AND sf.fix_description IS NOT NULL ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 6 ORDER BY people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(s.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 3 ORDER BY judge_count DESC, fix_count DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND p.court = 'Supreme Court' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 95 AND AVG(la.actnumber) < '1' ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY l.legaldate) AS cumulative_people_by_court, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS people_rank_in_court FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 5776.05 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 21.08 ORDER BY l.court, people_rank_in_court;

SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 9 OR COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 32 EXCEPT SELECT l1.id AS act_id1, l1.actnumber AS act_number1, l1.actyear AS act_year1, l1.court AS court1, l1.judge AS judge1, l2.id AS act_id2, l2.actnumber AS act_number2, l2.actyear AS act_year2, l2.court AS court2, l2.judge AS judge2, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS people_count1, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS people_count2, SUM(CASE WHEN l1.actyear = l2.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l2.court) AS same_year_pairs, AVG(l1.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court) AS avg_actnumber_court1, AVG(l2.actnumber::numeric) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court) AS avg_actnumber_court2, MAX(l1.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l1.court, l1.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year1, MAX(l2.legaldate) OVER (PARTITION BY l2.court, l2.actyear) AS max_legaldate_court_year2 FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN people p1 ON lp1.peopleid = p1.personid LEFT JOIN people p2 ON lp2.peopleid = p2.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf1 ON l1.id = sf1.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf2 ON l2.id = sf2.actid WHERE l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l1.actnumber > '1' AND l2.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court, l1.judge, l1.legaldate, l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.actyear, l2.court, l2.judge, l2.legaldate HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) <= 24 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) <= 42 ORDER BY act_id1, act_id2;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (sf.fix_description IS NULL OR sf.contributor = 'admin') GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 375 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS total_acts, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT la.actkind, ', ' ORDER BY la.actkind) AS aggregated_actkinds, SUM(la.actnumber) AS sum_actnumber, AVG(la.outnumber) AS avg_outnumber FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 13 ORDER BY la.court, la.actyear;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS court_year_people_sum, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_in_year FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON l.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON l.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts l2 ON ll1.actid2 = l2.id LEFT JOIN legalacts l3 ON ll2.actid1 = l3.id WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 267.07 AND (l.casenumber < 19.53 OR l.actyear = 2004.22) AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM legalact_people lp2 WHERE lp2.actid = l.id AND lp2.peopleid IN (SELECT personid FROM people WHERE jury = 0.79)) OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM scrapefix sf2 WHERE sf2.actid = l.id AND sf2.contributor = 'A')) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 28.74 AND AVG(l.actnumber) > 404.95 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, l.startdate ASC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_casekind_status, MAX(l.casenumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear) AS max_casenumber_by_court_year FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 910.33 AND l.casenumber BETWEEN 7156.52 AND 2559.25 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 48.65 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 18.82 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name AS person_name, p.court AS person_court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM l.legaldate) = l.actyear THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.casekind) AS yearly_court_case_match, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate)) AS avg_actnumber_by_court_quarter, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY l.legaldate DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS recency_rank FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON ll.actid2 = lp2.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actyear BETWEEN '2000' AND '2000' AND EXTRACT(QUARTER FROM l.startdate) = 2 AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.motivedate, l.senddate, l.actyear, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, p.personid, p.name, p.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.actid) > 20 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) >= 9 ORDER BY recency_rank, linked_act_count DESC, scrapefix_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY la.court ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.legaldate, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 5 ORDER BY la.legaldate DESC, people_count DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_people_by_court_act, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND startdate <= '2000-01-01')) AS linked_acts_in_date_range, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL INNER JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 INNER JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 INNER JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id INNER JOIN legalacts la3 ON ll2.actid1 = la3.id WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.startdate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 16 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 12 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT la.id AS legalact_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, STRING_AGG(DISTINCT p.name, '; ' ORDER BY p.name) AS involved_people_names, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.casekind) AS court_casekind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.actyear, la.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_year_status, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) DESC) AS rank_by_linked_acts FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2005-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 805.89 AND la.casenumber BETWEEN 253.19 AND 628.47 GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.casenumber, la.actyear, la.court, la.casekind, la.resultofappeal, la.status, la.judge, la.actkind, la.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 45.34 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) > 74.9 ORDER BY total_linked_acts DESC, total_people_involved DESC;

SELECT la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT la.id)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actyear) AS court_year_total, AVG(la.actnumber) FILTER (WHERE la.legaldate IS NOT NULL) AS avg_act_number, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM scrapefix sf WHERE sf.actid = la.id AND sf.fix_description LIKE '%error%') AS error_fix_count FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY la.court, la.actyear, la.judge, la.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 14 AND AVG(la.actnumber) > '10' ORDER BY act_count DESC, court_year_total ASC;

SELECT l.court, l.actyear, COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people, MAX(s.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix s ON l.id = s.actid WHERE l.actyear >= '2000' AND l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.court IS NOT NULL GROUP BY l.court, l.actyear HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT l.id) > 25 ORDER BY act_count DESC, l.court, l.actyear;

SELECT la.actyear, la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) AS act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS unique_people_count, AVG(la.actnumber) AS avg_act_number, MIN(la.startdate) AS earliest_start, MAX(la.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear >= '2000' AND la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND (la.court = 'Supreme Court' OR la.court IS NULL) GROUP BY la.actyear, la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 64 ORDER BY la.actyear DESC, act_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS judge_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS fix_count, SUM(l.actnumber) AS total_acts FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' AND p.jury = 0 GROUP BY l.id, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 10 AND COUNT(sf.actid) >= 0 ORDER BY total_acts DESC;

SELECT l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l1 JOIN legalact_people lp1 ON l1.id = lp1.actid WHERE l1.actyear = '2000' AND l1.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp1.peopleid) > 3 INTERSECT SELECT l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) AS involved_people_count FROM legalacts l2 JOIN legalact_people lp2 ON l2.id = lp2.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON l2.id = sf.actid WHERE l2.actyear = '2000' AND l2.startdate >= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l2.id, l2.actnumber, l2.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp2.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_acts_count, MAX(sf.fix_description) AS latest_fix_description, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY l.court, l.actyear ORDER BY l.startdate) AS cumulative_people_by_court_year, AVG(l.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY l.casekind, l.status) AS avg_actnumber_by_case_status FROM legalacts l JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link ll ON l.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 504.34 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM people p WHERE p.personid = lp.peopleid AND p.jury = 0.14 AND p.court = l.court ) AND l.id IN ( SELECT actid1 FROM legalact_link GROUP BY actid1 HAVING COUNT(actid2) > 25.07 ) GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.casenumber, l.actyear, l.typeofdocument, l.court, l.casekind, l.resultofappeal, l.status, l.judge, l.actkind, l.highcourt HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 18.56 AND COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) < 33.9 ORDER BY l.startdate DESC, involved_people_count DESC;

SELECT l.id AS legalact_id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC, l.startdate DESC) AS people_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > 389.57 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.startdate, l.legaldate, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) >= 38.42 ORDER BY people_rank, l.startdate DESC;

SELECT la.id AS act_id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS total_people_involved, COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) AS total_linked_acts, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS total_scrapefix_entries, SUM(COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid)) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS court_actkind_total_people, AVG(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.judge ORDER BY la.startdate ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS avg_actnumber_per_judge_court, MAX(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.status) AS max_actnumber_per_court_status, MIN(la.startdate) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind) AS earliest_startdate_per_court_actkind FROM legalacts la JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid JOIN legalact_link lal ON la.id = lal.actid1 JOIN legalacts la2 ON lal.actid2 = la2.id LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE la.startdate >= '2000-01-01' AND la.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' AND la.actnumber > 682.8 AND la2.actnumber < 856.21 AND (p.jury IS NULL OR p.jury > 8.91) GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, la.status HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 46.2 AND COUNT(DISTINCT lal.actid2) >= 14.98 ORDER BY total_people_involved DESC, la.startdate ASC;

SELECT court_stats.court, court_stats.total_acts, court_stats.avg_people_per_act, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC) as court_rank FROM ( SELECT la.court, COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) as total_acts, AVG(people_count.people_cnt) as avg_people_per_act FROM legalacts la JOIN ( SELECT lap.actid, COUNT(DISTINCT lap.peopleid) as people_cnt FROM legalact_people lap WHERE lap.actid IN ( SELECT DISTINCT lal.actid1 FROM legalact_link lal WHERE lal.actid2 > 2689 ) GROUP BY lap.actid ) people_count ON la.id = people_count.actid JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid WHERE la.actyear BETWEEN '2010' AND '2015' AND la.legaldate >= '2010-01-01' GROUP BY la.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT la.id) > 48 ) court_stats ORDER BY court_stats.total_acts DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, COUNT(sf.actid) AS scrapefix_count FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON l.id = sf.actid WHERE l.court LIKE '%Court%' AND l.judge LIKE '%Judge%' AND l.actyear >= 2018.44 GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.actyear, l.court, l.judge HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 7.03 ORDER BY involved_people_count DESC, l.actyear DESC;

SELECT la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS num_people, COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) AS num_fixes, SUM(la.actnumber) OVER (PARTITION BY la.court, la.actkind ORDER BY la.startdate) AS running_actnumber_by_court_kind, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM legalact_link ll WHERE ll.actid1 = la.id AND ll.actid2 IN (SELECT id FROM legalacts WHERE actyear > '1900')) AS linked_acts_in_later_year FROM legalacts la LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON la.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid AND la.court = p.court LEFT JOIN scrapefix sf ON la.id = sf.actid AND sf.contributor IS NOT NULL LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll1 ON la.id = ll1.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll2 ON la.id = ll2.actid2 LEFT JOIN legalacts la2 ON ll1.actid2 = la2.id OR ll2.actid1 = la2.id WHERE la.startdate >= '1900-01-01' AND la.actnumber > '1' AND la.actyear BETWEEN '1900' AND '1900' GROUP BY la.id, la.actnumber, la.startdate, la.legaldate, la.court, la.judge, la.actkind HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 22057 AND COUNT(DISTINCT sf.actid) <= 189863 ORDER BY la.startdate DESC, num_people DESC;

SELECT l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS people_count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY l.court ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) DESC) AS court_rank FROM legalacts l LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l.id = lp.actid LEFT JOIN people p ON lp.peopleid = p.personid WHERE l.legaldate >= '2000-01-01' AND l.actnumber > '1' GROUP BY l.id, l.actnumber, l.legaldate, l.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) > 9 ORDER BY l.court, court_rank;

SELECT l1.id AS root_act_id, l1.actnumber AS root_act_number, l1.actyear AS root_act_year, l1.court AS root_court, COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) AS linked_act_count, COUNT(DISTINCT lp.peopleid) AS involved_people_count, MAX(l1.legaldate) AS latest_legal_date_in_hierarchy FROM legalacts l1 LEFT JOIN legalact_link ll ON l1.id = ll.actid1 LEFT JOIN legalact_people lp ON l1.id = lp.actid WHERE l1.actyear >= '2000' AND l1.legaldate <= '2000-01-01' GROUP BY l1.id, l1.actnumber, l1.actyear, l1.court HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ll.actid2) > 10 ORDER BY linked_act_count DESC, root_act_year DESC;
